Hayk was always punctual for meetings and delivered what was quoted. Our project came in at the quoted cost, and he was conscientious about keeping expenses down where possible without compromising quality. He and his team worked efficiently without sacrificing quality, and they were respectful of our space throughout the process. He was very receptive to any feedback along the way, and the workmanship has held up well.

Overall, working with Cedarland Renovation was a great experience, and we would not hesitate to recommend him to anyone looking for a reliable and skilled contractor.

I especially love watching the older kids lead and mentor the younger kids.

Matt Clarke is an excellent instructor! I've been training combat sports for 20 years and can tell this is a great community/club to train with!

That being said it's super beginner friendly! Good exercise without having a high fitness requirement.

Highly recommend to anyone looking to get into a low risk, high reward combat sport!

reviews.text: My 14 year old daughter started at Okanagan Freestyle Fencing in September and she has found the perfect fit. The club provides fitness, self reliance, competitiveness, and friendly camaraderie, with the added bonus of coach Matt and every other coach and member being incredibly welcoming, kind, fun and respectful. Matt sets the expectations and boundaries of the club clearly and consistently, and he is wonderful with people of all ages. His humor, along with that of many others, makes it so there is always laughter and fun mixed in with the games, skill building, and learning of the sport. We are so happy my daughter has found her place! As Matt said to us at the beginning, "It's so fun!!!" Highly recommend!

After comparing several quotes, we decided to go with Quality Chain Link Fencing for our backyard project, and we couldn’t be happier with the choice. Our yard has a slope and uneven stone/rock walls, which made the job more challenging. Kelvin came out to take measurements, patiently answered all our questions, and helped us settle on a plan that met our needs while staying cost-effective.

The wait for materials was short, and the installation was handled by Kolby and his team. They were polite, professional, and kept me informed throughout the process. The project required three visits — partly because the concrete needed time to set, and partly because our yard’s landscape meant three tricky spots needed custom work. Kolby went above and beyond, welding and customizing parts for those areas so the fence not only fit perfectly but also blended seamlessly with the rest of the yard.

Both sides of our neighbors are thrilled with the outcome as well. Overall, the workmanship, communication, and professionalism exceeded our expectations. I would highly recommend Quality Chain Link Fencing to anyone looking for a reliable and detail-oriented fencing company.

reviews.author: Huw
reviews.text:
Poor customer service and product support.
I decided to replace my wooden fence with a vinyl one as the irrigation system was causing an understandable amount of rotting in the wooden one.
I was told that this wouldn’t be a problem with a vinyl fence and was given a story about how a house had been sold because the prospective buyers were so impressed with it’s vinyl fence which was still looking emaculate after many years.
The person who erected the fence was excellent and the fence looked great and I was pleased that I had made a good decision and this fence would outlive me.
However I noticed after an about four years that the vinyl was beginning to break down along some seams and again it appeared that it was the irrigation that was causing the problem.
I told Rite-Way of my concerns but have only been given the run around since.
They basically told me that the problem was not theirs but the provider of the vinyl fence.
It seems to me that if you hire someone to install a fence, they should assume responsibility for any issues that crop up and ensure that their customers are satisfied with both their work and the products they use.
While the problem is not extensive now, it will only get worse and the company appears to be washing their hands of it.

Our decision to go with Rite-Way Fencing was based largely on our confidence in the salesperson Shayla.  She was knowable, professional and had a good grasp of the work required based on her experience previously as an installer. The Rite-Way installers were also excellent.  Mike and Rick and their crews showed up early each day and just got the job done.

Overall great customer service!

There was an issue with the fence a few days after the installation was complete however Shayla was prompt in coming on site to understand the issue and Rite-Way and their installers quickly rectified the situation.

There is a lot of completion in the Kelowna marketplace for chain link fencing. My advice is get several quotes, do your homework and take a close look at Rite-Way Fencing.

reviews.author: Diana McMurtry
reviews.text: The IGuard stove monitor is the most amazing tool ever.  My mom has dementia and lived in our cottage for 8 years basically on her own but next door to our main house so this tool kept me feeling very safe knowing that if she forgot the stove on it would automatically turn off in 10 minutes all on its own.  I would highly recommend  this tool to anyone who is worried about an elderly parent that uses a stove.  We were able to lock off the oven so that mom only had access to the stove top which gave her some independence, but also notified me every time the stove turned on and if it ever needed to do a forced turn off as well.  Then I could phone her to make sure she was ok.  I can't say enough great things about this incredible tool.

reviews.author: Gary Kean
reviews.text:
The iGuard device was a huge help to my family as we navigated through our Mom being home alone with short-term memory issues.
Whenever I told anyone, particularly medical professionals, about it and how it worked, they were amazed and said they never knew there was such a device.
I particularly liked the text messages notifying me when she had turned on the stove so I could monitor if she had turned it off.
She was also known to sometimes turn all four stove dampers on to quickly warm the house up in the mornings. There was one time when I could tell from the high-temperature alert that she had likely done just that and had forgotten they were still on full blast. I called her and she turned them off, telling me she did forget she had left them on.
The ability to simply sense motion, even without using the stove, was also helpful in gaining some insight into how early - or late  - she was getting up in the morning or during the night. It also gave us an idea of how often she may have been eating or even if she possibly had a visitor.
My family is extremely grateful that we had this device as it  has allowed our mom to remain safely in her home for much longer than she probably would have without it.

reviews.author: Kevin Spaulding
reviews.text: This is a great product that helped my mother, who was experiencing the early signs of dementia, to  maintain her independence for almost a year longer than we expected.  One unexpected bonus was the sentry feature that alerted us when she entered the kitchen each day and reported back if the temperature had gone over or under our pre-sets. A great way to passively keep track of a loved one without them feeling like they are being watched every day.

reviews.author: vicki duckett
reviews.text:
On two separate occasions iGuard alerted me that my mother had not appeared in the kitchen around her normal waking time. She had fallen in her bathroom and was not able to get up. If it was not for iGuard, I would not have rushed to her home to help her.
Also, my mother loves to cook and iGuard gives us comfort in knowing that she can do so safely.
I would highly recommend this product. The owner of the company, and staff members, provide excellent support as well.

reviews.author: Carolyn Watts
reviews.text: My Mom has (had!) a habit of turning the stove on High "for just a minute", but then falling asleep.  Final straw was when we came home from the grocery store and found her asleep in her chair, dogs freaking out in the back yard, smoke alarm beeping its brains out and the house full of smoke.  We got the iGuard a few years ago, and this device is awesome!! I cannot tell you how many times it has saved my sweet Mom from burning the house down!  My sis and I can leave the house and not worry, and it even alerts us when she turns the stove on, or is wandering at night!! Get one! NOW!

reviews.text:
This was the letter I sent out this afternoon after been threatened that if I excersise my rights to publicise my experience, I can expect the same kind of service.

Hi Mike; I trust this email will serve you well. I received a phone call this morning from one of your installers. He asked when a good time for him would be to come out and fix the carpet. I replied what is a good time for you, he said any time. I looked at my calendar and decided 2pm this afternoon. He replied that it works, and he would see me then.

I left my office shortly after 1pm to meet him for 2. Low and behold, he was not at our home. I was there at 1:50pm. I patiently waited until 2:30 before I tried to call your store and his number. There were no answers on either.

I stayed until 3pm and had to go back to work. I called your store a total of 4 times. Brendan called me back from the number left at the store. I explained that I am not happy because I wasted my time and money meeting someone that did not even have the tenacity to call me to say they would not be there. He was with no regards to empathize my circumstances; he just said you were not in the office, and he had no idea of what I was talking about.

I can appreciate all that; however, I explained that it is unacceptable to treat customers this way and that I would in return write a review with my experience on google. To my surprise, he then said “if I write a review, I can expect the same kind of service” I quickly replied with a question if he was serious and if he was threatening me for wanting to publicise the truth. He went on with derogatory remarks and I hung up the phone.

At the end of the day Mike, I like you, I have purchased flooring and carpet from you for 2 homes and my business. I have sent many people your way. I also recall when we had the carpet and hard wood installed 2 years ago. It was a nightmare then. We were persevering and understanding. I am not sure why I have been treated this way. I have sat as a Board Member for the Chambers, BBB and many other influential organizations. I have 2 businesses and have been running business for the better part of my life. I do not remember any times that I have been treated the way I have with your staff.

If you make a promise you should stand by it and not tell me about your bad day when I just wasted 3 hours of my time because your staff making that promise. If you are not prepared to do anything as Brendan expressed because of my statement to write a review. Then at least let me know so I can take this to someone who may matter.

reviews.text: We recently had new carpet and underlay installed in a renovated bedroom.  I visited the showroom on McCurdy in Kelowna and was impressed with their selection and the ample parking.  Selina's expertise helped me choose the right carpet and underlay.  Before I arrived home that day I received a phone call from Cory, the carpet installer, and we scheduled measurement for the same day and installation later in the same week. Cory was punctual, thorough and efficient.  In addition to the carpet installation, Cory assisted with securing the closet doors, and offered suggestions to make repairs to existing flooring in the laundry room.  I am very pleased with the transformation of the bedroom and am grateful to Selina and Cory for their assistance.

reviews.author: Tim Laurie
reviews.text:
We first contacted Flooring Superstore when we were looking for new hardwood flooring.  Selena was very responsive, gave great insight and showed us the options that matched our desired criteria of color, quality, variation and price.

Our first choice of hardwood was actually found at another Flooring store in Kelowna, but when that store messed-up our order with the supplier (setting our home reno behind by a few weeks), Shawn and Selena did an amazing job in finding the hardwood we wanted, in our needed quantity, all of the same dye lot, and at a better price!   The contractor they use for floor nosings and flush mounts also did a great job. We couldn't be happier with the end result.

reviews.author: Marilyn Wilson
reviews.text:
We cannot say enough about what a positive experience it was for us to work with Kelowna Flooring Superstore to have our carpeting replaced.  The staff are very friendly and knowledgeable.   They were flexible and patient while we made our choices and offered the best prices with the best service we could find in the city.
Installation happened as scheduled and even the installer was really skilled, pleasant and thoughtful throughout the process.
We've had a steady stream compliments from guests to our home and in fact, have revisited the gang at Kelowna Flooring Superstore to get info for friends who are looking for this quality of service for their own home.  And they remembered us!  Gotta love it!
Thanks for making the whole experience very positive.

reviews.author: Marina Orlovski
reviews.text:
I purchased a condo in Kelowna that had been used as a rental and the hardwood floors were a mess...scratches, gouges...and cleaning it was a nightmare!  I also needed carpet for the master bedroom as it was very stained.
After checking out many other shops, I landed on Kelowna Flooring Superstore.  The owner was onsite and was extremely helpful in offering many different options for the flooring and carpet and I took a lot of samples with me.
I decided on a beautiful laminate for the main living area and a lovely, comfy carpet for the bedroom. The installers were amazing, cleaning up after themselves and disposing of all garbage, which I greatly appreciated.
The office staff, Selina in particular, are so knowledgeable and offered me an excellent price.  Another place in town was over double the price for just the flooring!
I would highly recommend Kelowna Flooring Superstore for all your flooring needs.
(The flooring colour is Monsoon Maple and the carpet is Beige Clay.)

reviews.text: My experience with Anthony and his installing team was awesome! Prompt service and communication, always up to answer my questions (I'm new to the Reno world). The team was respectful in my home with my little bunny, and I can't wait to have my full kitchen up and running to really enjoy my new "cold foam" floors! thanks again!

reviews.author: D H
reviews.text:
Best selection of sheet vinyl (aka linoleum) in the central Okanagan.  Since this was a small job and used "cheap" material, I found most other flooring stores I went to in the Okanagan to feel judgy when I told them about the product I was seeking and the attention of the staff at other places immediately dropped when I said the word "linoleum".   These other store's customer service varied from disinterested to rude.

On the opposite end of the spectrum, Kelowna Floors has friendly and attentive staff, great selection and prices.  They have a huge selection of flooring from budget-conscious to high end products.

I received especially good service from Tony, regardless of the scale of the project.   He was timely in getting comprehensive quotes for materials and work, tried to schedule work with my timeline and provided excellent communication throughout the process.  Lucas and team did an impressive job preparing the site and installing the flooring and completed the project well ahead of the estimated time.   I am very happy with how this project turned out and the cost.

I will go no where else for my future flooring needs!   Call Tony today!

When we had questions about style recommendations, she was incredibly helpful. The installers were polite, prompt, and clean. I really appreciated that they made every effort to get the job done to a high standard, as quickly as possible. We'll plan to use Kelowna Floors again as we continue our remodel.

You can't go wrong using Kelowna Floors

reviews.text: We had a wonderful experience using Okanagan Hardwood Flooring. They supplied and installed all of our wood floors. In addition, their tile setter did a fabulous job in our kitchen, laundry, entry hall and bathrooms. Would highly recommend this company!

reviews.text: It doesn’t take long to know who you are dealing with when you visit their flooring showroom. reviews.author: Terry Newman
reviews.text: After years of dreaming of renovating and installing site finished hardwood floors, we finally had it completed, the floors turned out so beautiful. It is a great feeling to love the floors you wake up to every day! Huge thanks to Al, Deni, Heather and the entire team at Okanagan Hardwood for the amazing professional job transforming our home!

reviews.author: Colin Banfield
reviews.text: Well done Okanagan Hardwood and Tile. What really impressed us was that they took control and managed the whole seven-week project - from arranging the removal of 1800 sq ft of existing porcelain tile and carpet to the supply and installation of new oak hardwood. This involved managing all the sub-contractors (primarily Winmar) to pack, move and store our furniture and possessions, tent the rooms in poly to prevent dust, remove and refit a glass staircase, refit and paint all new baseboard, clean and paint walls where necessary and move and place our furniture and possessions, including books and wall art. They were the only flooring company we could find in Kelowna with the skills to manage this complex project. Congratulations to Otto, Heather, Greg, Pat, Andy, Chuck, Phil, Andreas, Bob and the rest of the team at Okanagan Hardwood, and the team at Winmar, for a job well done.

reviews.author: C
reviews.text:
Great if you are a contractor and have an account with them, but now terrible pricing-wise without an account as their new policy doesn't allow discounts without an account. Looking at previous receipts and the discount ranged from 25-47% so a pretty big difference.

Example: Purchased grout for $18 with discount vs. $37 without discount (exact same product)

Lots of selection and helpful employees at least.

reviews.author: Cory
reviews.text: Been installing 28 years. Will not shop there anymore. Prices are way too high. Don't carry common things like extended TCAP track so they make you buy the regular track and a plastic extension that blows out as soon as you try and put your TCAP in. Cost $45 for those two pieces where the other store did carry extended TCAP track and their prices $18 for a length. Want to charge you $55 for a rubber mallet which is three times the price of the exact same one on amazon. Just to give you an example. Probably have seven people at least working at any given time but if you don't pick the right time it'll only be two people waiting to take your money so you're going to be waiting there. Sorry guys you lost my business a while back

We’ve worked with Small’s Tile and Flooring on two builds now, and they’ve been outstanding both times. Their showroom has a huge selection, and Shelley’s help during the selection process made our decisions simple instead of overwhelming.
The installation team was incredible as well. Any questions we had were handled right away without the need to follow up, which says a lot about their service and attention to detail. They took care of all our tile work, hardwood flooring and our fireplaces, and everything turned out beautifully.
Choosing them again for this build was an easy decision after how happy we were with our first experience in Wilden. We highly recommend Small’s Tile and Flooring for anything from a full build to a renovation. They’re a great team and deliver excellent results.

reviews.text:
It is with great disappointment that I have decided to share my experience with Smalls. After initially installing a new floor in my home, I noticed several issues with the workmanship. Despite my attempts to reach out to them to address the problems, Sam has completely stopped responding to my calls and emails. The lack of communication and failure to honor their (paid out of pocket) commitment to fixing the poorly installed floor reflects poorly on their professionalism and customer service.

Not only was the initial installation subpar, but the complete disregard for customer concerns and refusal to rectify the situation has left us extremely frustrated and scrambling to find a professional flooring company to fix the issues. I would caution and be wary of their lack of accountability and follow-through.

reviews.text:
Sam was great to work with as we picked out and ordered the flooring and tile work for our new home five years ago.  The only negative thing about the experience was trying to deal with a flooring warranty issue that dragged on for a number of reasons but has finally been put to rest.
Though communication was difficult for a period of time, I thank Sam for his part in getting our flooring issue resolved.  We are very happy with the end result.  The installers did a great job and the floors look perfect.  They are nice and flat with no more ridges at the seems (which was the problem with the original product), and they match very well to the engineered floors upstairs.   It is unfortunate that Beaulieu floors did not recognize the issue as a problem when it clearly was not performing as it should have.  None-the-less,  the new floor looks great and we appreciate Sam bringing the new flooring in and giving us a break on the cost for the re and re.

reviews.author: Nicki Ellis
reviews.text: What a spectacular showroom!  So many options and it was great to be able to take samples home. Cassie gave us excellent service. She's very knowledgeable of the products and helpful with selection and finding what we were looking for.

I rarely write reviews, but I thought the Small's team deserved one.

reviews.text: We worked with Dylan from Strong Roots to replace or refinish all of the flooring in our house. The process was great— each part of the job lined up efficiently with the next and everyone was really skilled at what they did. We had tile installed in three rooms by Nolan (absolutely perfect lines, even in some tricky spots), new hardwood installed in half of the house to match the original living/dining room floor (can’t remember the name of the person who installed it, but he was top notch too and made sure all the transitions were smooth), and Blane refinished the original flooring and new boards together (beautifully smooth and you can’t tell where the 40 year old boards end and the new boards start). Very impressed by the professionalism and artistry of everyone involved.

reviews.author: lori gilbert
reviews.text: My Experience with Strongroots has been excellent.  We bought our house 2 years ago and started renovating this year. We pulled up tile and stone as well as a big corner bathtub in our master bedroom . I wanted to replace those areas with the same oak flooring that was everywhere else. So our floors looked seamless . They did a amazing job to make it all look like it was all done at the same time . We are looking forward to getting the second phase of the floors done in October. Many thanks to the staff and Dylan for making this a great experience.

reviews.author: Effie Simpson
reviews.text: Rick and Shannon run a wonderful small family business. They are friendly, efficient, and amazingly fair. My project required either a full sand of dark hickory, or a complete replacement of my hardwood throughout my house. They made sure to get what I wanted in the most cost efficient way possible. Their staff are professional and friendly, and hard workers who did the job right. Blane, who oversaw the project was so great to work with! This experience exceeded my expectations!! I would not hesitate to refer Strong Roots to anyone looking for flooring solutions!!

reviews.author: WE C
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I am absolutely thrilled to share my incredible experience with Strong Roots Hardwood Refinishing – a company that truly goes above and beyond to deliver exceptional results. From the moment I met Dylan during the estimate process to the final reveal of my beautifully transformed red oak floors, the journey has been outstanding in every way possible.

Scott, the expert who handled the sanding and buffing of my floors, deserves special recognition for his outstanding work. His skill and dedication were evident as he meticulously transformed my red oak floors, leaving them looking better than their original state. His recommendation of the popular Nordic finish was a stroke of genius – it lightened up the entire room and brought a modern, refreshing touch to the space.

In addition to the refinishing, the team also repaired a damaged area seamlessly – a testament to their attention to detail and commitment to perfection. The result is a floor that not only exudes a more contemporary charm but also stands stronger and sturdier than before.

One aspect that truly impressed me was the affordability of their services. The price they offered was not only competitive but even slightly better than other competitors in the market. This combination of quality and value is a rare find and speaks volumes about the integrity of the company.

To top it all off, I opted to have the team install flush mount vents as well, and the outcome was seamless and sophisticated. The attention to detail during this process further reinforced my confidence in choosing Strong Roots for the job.

In conclusion, I wholeheartedly and without hesitation recommend Strong Roots Hardwood Refinishing to anyone seeking outstanding craftsmanship, professionalism, and exceptional results. My floors are now a true testament to their expertise, and I couldn't be happier with how they've transformed my living space. Thank you, Strong Roots, for your dedication to excellence and for giving my home a new life.

Highly recommend Unlimited Garage!
These guys are absolute pros. They've been in the game for 19 years, and it really shows in the quality of their work. Whether it's concrete, wood, or just about any surface, their resinous coatings are top-notch—waterproof, flexible, and available in an endless variety of colours and designs. What really stood out to me was how trustworthy and dedicated they are. They go above and beyond to make sure everything is done right. You can tell they’ve built their reputation on word of mouth across the Okanagan, and now I see why. Great service, beautiful results, and a team that genuinely cares.

reviews.author: Terry Higginson
reviews.text: Having investigated the available products on the market to finish our garage floor we were very much impressed by the candid and honest presentation by Curt Dorin of Unlimited Garage. His educative articulation of the products he employs convinced us that this was the flooring product we wanted on our garage floor. No sales pitch here, just honesty and a complete understanding of his product’s ability sold us. He explained that in the RARE event the product did not attain a solid adhesion with the floor, it would likely be small in size. "Unfortunately, it came to this close call incident with your door/car to determine these deficiencies Fortunately no damage occurred.
We recommend annual servicing of the garage door or at least inspection which would catch these type issues before they become larger problems.

I had brought up the lack of safety bolt stoppers on the track and the negative pitch.  The install was completed by a third party contractor who no longer works for us, so I am not able to follow up for a coaching opportunity.

On a final note in regard to your invoice from Bob’s Doors, for after hours service.  After discussion with management, we will not cover costs incurred."
Choose a company that will stand behind their work.

reviews.author: Gerry Bowbell
reviews.text:
Buyer Beware! Although my experience with AARO Builders has been pretty good after 2 years of ownership there are still a couple of large items that David Young (Contractor) doesn't seem to want to deal with. Firstly, the downspout from my roof has been plugged from day 1, when there is snow melt from my roof there is run-off on my sidewalk that freezes and poses a huge safety hazard. There are no larger trees or anything else around a new development to plug it. David has said he'd look after it, so far, he has just ignored me. Secondly, the irrigation for the shrubs along my side of the driveway is tied into my neighbour's irrigation system. This is something I've had concerns about since the first winter, now I find out where the water is supplied from. Yes, it is a new build, and it has Pacific Home Warranty. This warranty company is great for sending out form letters to tell you that you are responsible for the problems that are built into your new home.
The purchase of a new home is supposed to be an exciting and positive experience in a person's life, not and aggravating one. The difference between this review and a 5 star review is to get these problems looked after and not ignoring a customer that put a lot of hard-earned money in AARO's pocket. Make sure that everything is documented, and it falls into timelines that the warranty company prescribes. Also don't take David's word that things will get done, because if it's a larger problem, it doesn't get done!
April 12, 2025
Since the first review was written Dave Young has tried to clear the downspout line a number of times. I've since sold the property and moved out of the province. As far as the irrigation system goes, I sent the irrigation company over to the neighbour's house to investigate what was wrong. Found out that the system was tinkered with and the valves needed adjustment, once that was done it worked properly. That was on my dime, not even a thank you from my neighbour! All in all it was a positive experience and I wouldn't hesitate to have Mr. Young build me another home.
Gerry Bowbell

reviews.author: Mitch Perlman
reviews.text:
To say that Denis is an incredibly talented designer would be an understatement.  Few home designers, in fact, are Gifted to that degree.  Perhaps that’s why one of our recent guests wrote in their review of Crescendo (our ski home), “I sent Crescendo’s architectural plans to St Peter, so when I get to heaven, he’ll already have a start on my dream chalet.”

Importantly, there is nothing cookie-cutter about a single home that Denis designs, which is obvious when merely perusing his portfolio.  Less obvious, though, is just how much thought Denis puts into sizing-up the home’s plot: its ultimate available footprint, its typography, its location, and the surrounding community.  With Crescendo, for example, Denis harmonized contemporary ingenuity/elegance with nature’s raw beauty.  The home’s structure was intentionally engineered to follow the mountain’s natural contour, with decks that step right out onto the slopes at their expected levels.  Also, while Denis may not be credited for creating the Monashee Mountains, in Crescendo, he certainly should be credited for capturing it.  A credit to Denis, then, is that Crescendo was awarded the Oscar by the World Ski Awards in Kitzbühel, Austria for Best Ski Chalet Canada, 2019.  Thanks Denis!  Mitch

reviews.author: Chelsey Gill
reviews.text:
Our journey with ARG began after one of the most terrifying events of our lives. Our family woke to discover our home was on fire, and while we were incredibly grateful to escape safely, we lost our home in an instant. What followed was an overwhelming and emotional process — from demolishing what remained of our house to navigating a complex and exhausting insurance rebuild.

From day one, Adam, Dan, and the entire ARG team showed up with compassion, professionalism, and unwavering support. They didn’t just build us a house — they helped rebuild our sense of security and hope. They went to bat for us with our insurance company, helped problem-solve every obstacle, and made us feel genuinely supported through every high and low.

ARG brings together an exceptional team — from draftspeople and designers to skilled trades — ensuring every detail is handled with care. Nothing is overlooked, and the result is a home that feels truly custom and perfectly suited to our family.

Throughout the entire process, ARG brought clarity, clear communication, and an incredible level of craftsmanship. Today, we are living in a home that is more beautiful than we ever imagined — so amazing it still doesn’t feel real that we get to call it our home.

We are beyond grateful to Adam, Dan, and the entire ARG team. If you’re looking for a construction team that truly shows up for their clients — especially during life’s hardest moments — we cannot recommend ARG highly enough.

reviews.author: Gail Jones
reviews.text:
After losing our lovely home in the McDougall Creek wildfire, we chose ARG to help us move on with our lives and rebuild our forever home. The outstanding construction team guided us through the project from beginning to end.  From Mandy helping us with details of our destroyed home for our insurance providers to Corinne guiding us through the plans for our new home, and Adam coming to bat for us with the insurance company, we felt supported by good people throughout the difficult and emotional process.
The staff and contractors on the job were all professional, courteous and available to chat and explain the processes they were attending to on the construction. We found the quality throughout to be exceptional. Dan was especially helpful as he oversaw our rebuild with attention to detail, positive interactions and timely responses to our questions and requests.
Adam, Dan and their team did a great job from beginning to the end of our rebuild.  We absolutely love our beautiful new home and are grateful to ARG for bringing our vision to life!!
We highly recommend ARG for any of your construction projects.
Don and Gail Jones

reviews.author: Jason M
reviews.text:
ARG Contracting recently completed a substantial renovation of our home that included a kitchen, 1 half bath, 2 full baths, a stairwell, and new flooring, doors, baseboard, paint, lighting, electrical, and millwork throughout the home.

The renovation commenced in April of 2024 and was substantially complete by mid-July, which is fairly remarkable considering we didn't even have finalized design drawings in hand until the second week of May.

During the renovation, we visited the home frequently to check on the work, we found the personnel working for ARG Contracting (and their subcontractors) to be very pleasant and professional, answering any questions we had, always maintaining a clean work site, and being respectful of our community and neighbours.

As the work was reaching substantial completion, ARG Contracting, especially Dan, exerted considerable effort in making sure everything was absolutely perfect.

From a cost perspective, we ended up exactly where we expected to be. We found ARG Contracting to be competitive in their pricing and communicative when it came to making any decisions that would have impacted cost or schedule.

We would encourage anyone considering renovations or a new home build to reach out to Adam, his passion for customer service during our introductory meeting is what ultimately convinced us to go with ARG Contracting, and this same passion remained present throughout construction.

Honorable mention for Dan who did an amazing job coordinating all the trades, holding them accountable, checking their work, and personally taking care of so many details to ensure that the work was completed to virtual perfection.

ARG Contracting will be back this fall to complete a master bath renovation project for us.

Thanks Adam and Dan!

We at Kekuli Bay look forward to more projects in the future. Thanks for the opportunity to be of assistance in building your clients dream homes.

reviews.author: Lisa Turchyn
reviews.text:
We selected Bercum Builders to build our custom home on the basis of their past work and reputation as one of the premier custom home builders in the Okanagan.

Darren and the team were involved in the project right from the beginning and worked closely with our architect. During this initial phase, Bercum provided key insights, options and recommendations, and presented us with rough costing throughout the design phase in order to keep us on budget.

Once construction began our site manager Bruce (from the Bercum team) was outstanding with communication and kept us updated with detailed weekly emails which included photos and specific progress updates.

Building a custom home is no easy task. Our project was further complicated by the fact that we were overseas for the entire design and build process, and we only visited once for lock-up. We placed our complete trust in the Bercum team's integrity and high standards. We were extremely satisfied as Bercum Builders not only met but exceeded our expectations with the outcome and we would certainly recommend Bercum for any new build or major renovation

reviews.author: Ed Sippel
reviews.text: In 2023 our house burned in the Mcdougall creek fire. Needing a place to live Derek and Sherry reached out to us that they had a guest house to rent. After renting and moving in to our beautiful little house we found out Derek was a builder and had built the guest house which was a beautiful build. After looking at another house Derek built we chose him as our builder. He was very professional to work with and provided us with the guidance we needed when dealing with a lot of government agencies. After we finally got our permits Derek built our dream home on time and on budget. If you are looking for a qualified builder Big Valley is the builder for you.

reviews.author: Glen Dufresne
reviews.text: Derek has been working with us for close to 20 years, after multiple renovations, 6 to be exact. Derek built our dream home in 2016. He was an exceptional leader on site with the other trades and was always quick to share his expertise on design elements that made sense. He was more than fair on pricing with an exceptional work ethic. We actively recommend him throughout our travels.

reviews.author: Jaime Montana
reviews.text:
Big Valley Homes did much more than the services listed, they built our new Carriage House. (they also remodelled the main house before that) The job was started sometime in September 2020, from Plans/Engineering, permits and construction it took approximately 8 months. Derek and his "top hand" Ken, worked in the cold, snow and rain, but the job was completed to our satisfaction. Derek has an excellent group of reliable and flexible sub-contractors to adjust to changes. It was amazing to see the teamwork under winter conditions to get the job done, kudos to all.
The cost did run above predicted to no fault of Big Valley but more because of all materials etc. rising in price. We are more than pleased with the finished job, we would not hesitate to recommend Derek and his group for any construction needs.
Without any doubt, we will call Big Valley for future new buildings or Renovations.

He is hard working, a creative thinker, coming up with ideas we had never considered, meticulous and honest.
He has a list of excellent and reliable subcontractors who also do great work.

reviews.text:
Black Briar Contracting KNOCKED IT OUT OF THE PARK!

My wife and I were more than a little nervous about what amounted to a pretty sizeable renovation: kitchen, living room, dining room, stairs, bathrooms, and laundry room. After all, this was our beloved HOUSE, so we couldn't trust it into the hands of just anyone. No, we wanted it to be absolutely perfect, so we took our time shopping around for the contractor we could trust to do the job right.

From the moment Simon took a look around our house, we both had a good feeling that he knew exactly what he was doing. Then we listened to his suggestions and advice on how to bring what we wanted to reality. One look at his estimate (easily 30% below others we received) and we knew it was a match made in renovation Heaven.

Come the big day, work begins, and we're off the races! The renovations seemed to fly by, and before we knew it, we had a glorious, brand new kitchen, a gorgeous living and dining room, a stunning mantlepiece and fireplace, and countless other details that have taken our house to the next level.

All throughout, it was a pleasure having Simon and co. in our home. Friendly as all heck, a hoot to chat with, and hard-working to make sure they met the proposed deadline (even when the reno threw some interesting curveballs at them).

Suffice it to say, we've already got them booked for our NEXT big renovation, and can't think of any other contractor we'd rather use.

Everything feels intentional — from proportions to materials to how the house sits and works as a whole.

Built Prefab truly delivers on their promise of well-designed, thoughtfully executed prefab homes. I would highly recommend them to anyone who values strong design, professionalism, and a smooth, well-managed building process.

I never had a single moment of doubt that I was in the right hands.

reviews.author: David S.
reviews.text:
October 2025 — This is the first installment of what will ultimately be a multi-part review.

We are working with Built Prefab to place a home on a piece of land that—due to setbacks, waterline restrictions, and other variables—is exceptionally challenging to build on. We’ve been engaged with Built for nearly a year (six months since signing the design contract) and are still in the permitting, variance, and shoreline exemption phase. Throughout this process, the Built team has been nothing short of stellar—we couldn’t be more impressed.

As naturally cautious clients, we approached this project with significant due diligence before signing any agreement. Co-founder Ian completely understood and even arranged for us to visit a home nearing completion in California, FaceTiming with us while we were there, which gave us the confidence to move forward.

We’re making steady progress with the county and remain cautiously optimistic about securing the necessary approvals and permits to proceed. This is due entirely to the dedication and tenacity of the Built team. As Ian himself put it, “this is the most complex permitting we’ve ever encountered.” Yet rather than being deterred, the team has leaned into the challenge—focused, determined, and committed to finding solutions at every turn. We could not be more grateful.

More to come as the journey continues…

reviews.author: Moe Matte
reviews.text:
Dear Ownership and Team at Carrington Kelowna;

RE:  Letter of Appreciation and Reference

It is with great pleasure that I write this letter to you.   I want to express our sincere gratitude for the incredible experience my family shared as two of our adult children became proud new home owners, each having purchased one of your impeccably built Carrington homes a few months ago.  I hope this review helps others make a decision to use your company.

It’s important to note that our family has a construction and development background and are familiar with many of the intricacies of building which are often overlooked.   When we toured Carrington’s new homes, we realized that the company clearly paid tremendous attention to detail with numerous amenities, features, and benefits not often considered by the majority of other builders.  Whether it be utilization of free spaces, thoughtful placement of electrical and service outlets, transom windows in closets, use of high-efficiency triple pane windows and solar-ready conduits, and the clear utilization of trades who care, Carrington went above and beyond our expectations for “spec” homes.

It's also important to note the exceptional HR talent at Carrington.    Chantelle was our direct point of contact for all aspects of our home buying experience.   Her knowledge of the product and experience with the overall process was akin to that of a business owner.   I can speak to this with certainty, as I operate a number of businesses and can spot an exceptional professional a mile away.  Chantelle’s thorough approach to the process and her impeccable sense of customer service made us feel well cared for, beyond that which one often finds in today’s world.    The champagne and thoughtful bath robes for each new homeowner was a lovely touch.  Again, this sort of service is something often lost today.

We ended up purchasing two homes instead of one from Carrington for all of the reasons listed in this letter, however, to make things even more special, Chantelle worked hard to help us prepare a wonderful “surprise” for our family.   She and her husband helped us to do a unique and amazing surprise for members of our family who were unaware of the second purchase.   It was such a spectacular event for everyone, and something we will fondly recount as the years roll ahead.    Chantelle made us feel like family, not merely customers.

Finally, I wanted to draw attention to the after-sales service that Chantelle and the team provided.   With new homes there are often a few items which need adjustment and final touches (landscaping etc).   The Carrington crew were ready to assist us immediately, caring for our needs as if we were fresh new sales opportunities.   Again, this is not common in today’s world.  Thank-you Chantelle and team!

In closing, it’s apparent to me that Carrington’s awards and accolades are well earned, recently being named the Builder of the Year for single family homes at the 2024 Okanagan Housing Awards of Excellence.   Congrats to Carrington, you deserve this incredible recognition!

Your friends,

Moe & family

reviews.author: Nolan Ryan
reviews.text:
My experience building our second home with Dilworth Homes was deeply disappointing. Unfortunately, we were obligated to use them because they owned the lot, and this home was of even lesser quality than our first.

The process was fraught with significant delays, beginning with drafting the plans. These delays led to an additional $10,000 lumber charge due to “rising prices,” but despite lumber prices dropping before construction began, Dilworth refused to adjust or reimburse the difference.

Customization options were upcharged significantly, and there was no room for negotiation. Any challenge to their decisions felt as though it was met with a refusal to cooperate or threats to abandon the contract.

The quality issues have been overwhelming. Despite requesting a tankless water heater, a traditional water tank was installed. Temperature regulation is inconsistent, and brand-new hardwood floors creak as if they’re decades old (NuFloors). Numerous structural deficiencies include a poorly sloped garage and driveway that pool water, cracked patio cement, exposed porch wood that we are concerned will eventually rot, separating flooring, misaligned walls and doorways, cabinets pulling away from the walls, and mold buildup behind bathroom caulking.

Delays in construction dragged on for months, and we are still working through unresolved deficiencies. Despite these issues being caused by the builder, the financial burden often felt as though it was placed on us or will never get fixed. For a home priced well over a million dollars, this level of quality and service is unacceptable.

It is our belief that Dilworth Homes prioritizes quantity over quality. In our opinion, they appear to lack qualified staff, have frequent turnover, cut corners, prioritize cost savings over quality work, and may hire based on availability rather than skill. If another builder had owned this lot, we would have gladly chosen them instead. For those considering Dilworth, we recommend looking elsewhere to avoid a similarly frustrating and costly experience.

So far out of the six tenants i have talked to here, five of them have had something happen to their property, i have yet to chat to all the building's tenants but so far it seems to be a common occurance(the one tenant that has not had property damaged or stolen has only recently moved in). reviews.author: Barbara Durno
reviews.text:
After evaluating several companies to work with to design and build our custom retirement home my wife and I selected Harmony Homes because of their scalable process that covers everything from design to completion, their excellent communication skills and their desire to make regular site visits to see firsthand how things are progressing.  In a nutshell, Harmony can oversee every task needed for a home building project. Your level of involvement is up to you.

After coming up with a concept design for our home, we worked with Harmony to modify the design as required to make the home perfect for us.  Once construction started, Harmony made it easy to tweak things as the build progressed to make the end result even better.  We were pleased that Harmony selects specific contractors and suppliers that they know will do an excellent job.  Follow on contractors often complimented the work of previous contractors.  This made a big difference in quality of the build.

Our build, similar to most, required dealing with the City for permits and inspections, a wide variety of Contractors, a Geo Survey Engineer but also with our Strata that has their own set of requirements.  Harmony Project Manager Gary Carpendale dealt professionally and in a timely manner with everyone involved across the build process and kept us updated, typically daily.

The end result is that my wife and I now have a home that not only checks all of the boxes, and much more, on our retirement home wish list but exceeds our expectations and is also appreciated by family and friends.  In a recent email from my wife to Gary, she summarized our feelings quite nicely - “Thank you again, for giving us such a lovely house.  We wake up everyday with tremendous gratitude.”

reviews.author: Maureen Palmer
reviews.text:
Working with and Harmony Homes and Gary Carpendale (Manager of Special Projects) was an extremely positive experience. We found the entire team to be very knowledgeable, professional and easy to work with.  Frankly, we loved working with Gary. He always went out of his way to provide information, solve a problem or just provide a constant flow of information. Interestingly, building a house is so much about communication. We always felt Gary and Harmony Homes were just a phone call or an email away. Always helpful, always knowledgeable and most importantly very willing to keep us involved and informed.  Building a home is a very large undertaking and we can not stress how important it is to work with a company that provides you with a specific contact to help wade through the process. Gary was always the "guy" who walked us through every step of the way with professionalism, and thoughtful interaction. Truly, he and his team gave us some excellent advice that made the end result even better. We love out house and often comment on what a beautiful home Harmony Homes built for us.  Everything is of such high quality and built to an excellent standard.

We would recommend Harmony Homes to anyone. It truly was a
very positive experience and we ended up with an excellent finished product. We love our home!

Maureen and Wayne.

reviews.author: Gerry Bakker
reviews.text:
Chris senior and Chris junior do great work.  In my home they refinished all the cabinets in our Kitchen, 3 bathrooms and 49 cabinet doors from old fashioned natural OAK to a modern Cool White colour.

Even at their high price it was still a lot better than replacing all of those cabinets and doors.  This kind of work takes a lot of hours in labour and a lot more coats of paint than they originally quoted.

Unfortunately, they misjudged how hard it is to cover the natural tannins in Oak which extended the quoted time to complete from a week to several weeks but it was worth the wait. Thankfully, they have a shop with a spray booth to paint all those cabinet doors correctly without impacting our ability to live in our home during the renovation.

I don't expect that they will underquote the amount of effort it takes to really cover Oak - next time someone asks. The net result was impressive even if it was frustrating to watch them struggle with the real challenges. We are very pleased with the results. I would recommend them to my friends.

Multiple coats of primer and white were applied to achieve a flawless spray finish. This was all done without a spray booth. reviews.author: Tim Loreman
reviews.text:
We had a block of land in the Okanagen that we wanted to build on, but had no idea where to start finding a builder. We turned to the internet and interviewed about 10 builders, as well as phoning many, many references. We chose Roland at Okanagen Builders (EXL) to build our home, and we feel so lucky and grateful that we did. The experience was actually enjoyable from beginning to end. Roland worked with us through every step of the process, offering us advice and helping us to stay within budget and to navigate the various decisions that needed to be made along the way. The end result is a beautiful home that we love, that we can afford, and an experience that was positive.

We were in Edmonton throughout the entire process, in the midst of the pandemic. This was not ideal from our point of view, but Roland worked extra hard to ensure that we were always updated on the progress of the design and build. He is a great communicator - always easy to get hold of. He is also very attentive to detail, which we appreciated.

Most important to us was honesty and integrity. Roland was always completely honest with us, and where savings were to be found he always made sure we were aware of them, and he passed them on to us.

We have had possession of the house for about 3 years now. Many builders hand over the keys and you never see them again. This has not been the case with Roland. The few deficiencies/warranty issues, which have been relatively minor, have been dealt with effectively. He is only ever a phone call or text away.

Roland not only built an amazing home for us, but he became our friend along the way. We recommend him highly.

reviews.author: andrew brownell
reviews.text: To say working with Roland and his team has been wonderful would be an understatement. We started by meeting with Roland and right from day one we had a good feeling. Every house build has hiccups, and whenever they happened, Roland and his team walked us through everything and has gone above and beyond for us. Our build site is not the easiest and has presented a ton of challenges that Roland has taken in stride. He is honest, upfront, doesn’t sugar coat things, and is an absolute joy to work with. As well as Kevin Kenney. Our on site project manager. I would not want anyone else building our house. Consistent pictures, updates, video walkthroughs. The attention to detail that Roland and Kevin have shown us is second to none. He has consistently proven to us that his knowledge, years of experience and general demeanour makes him the perfect person to build anyone’s dream home. Anyone reading this, Roland is your guy. No question.

reviews.author: Ruth Mills
reviews.text:
We used Roland to design a custom home for us and then to project manage the construction of the home. Roland's years of experience in home design were evident by the comments and suggestions that he made, as well as his ability to take our requirements and reflect them in the design. He provides respectful advice and will give you things to think about. Roland also has a large compliment of very experienced trades people and other consultants e.g. interior decorating that know their speciality and deliver quality work.
Roland is very capable of working with clients electronically, that is, the majority of our meetings and conversations with him were done via phone, email and conference call (and this was done before Covid restrictions). We did not live in the area at the time of construction and were periodically there. We set up a schedule for visits with Roland knowing that our presence would be critical at certain construction phases. When unexpected circumstances occurred, Roland would take photos from the job site or plans, etc. send them via email then schedule a conference call. This worked very well whether we would have been across the street or across the country.
House was completed on time.
We would use Roland again.

reviews.author: Amy Wiebe
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend RBT highly enough for anyone looking to undertake renovations. From the very first quote, they distinguished themselves with their logical approach, genuine care, and an impressive sense of practicality.

The entire team—electricians, project managers, drywallers, painters, plumbers, and cabinet specialists—was exceptional. They worked seamlessly together, ensuring that the project stayed on track while paying attention to every personal detail. Their commitment to quality was evident not only in the execution but also in the finishing and touch-up work, which were completed without any hassle.

After experiencing a complete flood in my home, the renovation process could have been a significant headache, but thanks to RBT, it was quite the opposite. They truly were a team in my corner. From coordinating with insurance adjusters to executing the trades with utmost professionalism, I felt reassured that they had my best interests at heart every step of the way.

What a pleasant experience it has been! If you're considering renovations, RBT is the best choice you can make.

Thank you, Amy

reviews.author: Benjamin
reviews.text:
Review for RBT / First Onsite Property Restoration

My condo was flooded over two years ago, and dealing with RBT / First Onsite Property Restoration has been an ongoing nightmare.

More than two years later, the restoration is still not complete. Completion dates were repeatedly pushed back with little accountability. During the process, the only furniture I had left was damaged while being moved to storage, several of my appliances were damaged, and the overall workmanship has been very poor.

To make matters worse, a few of my very expensive personal items went missing while the unit was under their control.

This experience has caused significant stress and hardship. I would strongly recommend extreme caution before hiring this company.

reviews.author: Tina Rasmussen
reviews.text: I highly recommend Rock Renovations to anyone seeking reliable, affordable and thoughtful renovation and design solutions in the Kelowna Area. As a newly disabled woman who lives alone, I needed a professional contractor to asses areas of my home that needed to be modified for easier and safer access. The designer made an initial visit to my home and conducted an audit. Tim very thoroughly considered all my needs in his designs including the heights and reinforcement (for added support) of banisters and railings, step tread and riser alterations and material, areas for non slip flooring to be installed, determined best clearances on landings and certain door jambs converted to zero step entries. After the completion of the job he also recommended better lighting options for improved visibility and suggested places where I could employ my smart home technology to make it easier for me to navigate my own home safely. From the initial consultation to the final installation, the Rock team displayed professionalism, expertise, and genuine care. They listened attentively to my needs and concerns, and provided insightful recommendations tailored to my specific requirements. The end result exceeded my expectations, making my home not only accessible but also aesthetically pleasing all within my modest budget.

reviews.author: Don Fletcher
reviews.text:
I live 600m from the Oyama pit where T& A does the blasting. For some geological reason, my house takes a major shock wave from at least half of their blasts. Last time it knocked pictures down, rattled dishes in the cupboards and made the living room floor visibly move a millimetre or two up and down a few times. So I contacted them and they said they would come around with a sensor next time. I found out today at quarter to five from my neighbor that they were blasting today at 5. So I called, and they sent a guy over with a sensor. (I guess they had forgotten) While he was setting it up they fired the blast - I heard it and my wife felt it, but it was a fairly small one this time. Then he got set up and went back to the pit to tell them he was ready. He came back about 15 min later to say they had just fired it. Of course we didn't hear or feel anything because it has already gone off earlier when we heard it. So he said the data was fine. When I tried to explain what sort of shocks we have been getting, but I was pretty much called a liar. I guess it was just a show to shut me up. So they will continue damaging my house and there doesn't seem to be anything they will do about it. I have a large picture window that has cracks right across it - I guess I will get it replaced and hope for the best.
BTW - I was demolition qualified in the military and also used to watch the blasts at Brenda Mine when  I was a kid, so I have been around blasting all my life - I know what shock waves feel like and it ticks me off to continously be called a liar when all I am doing is trying to protect my home and my family. I was really hoping we could work together and work something out, instead of making lawyers richer, but that's the way businesses like this operate.

This is a review that tells the story of how a business deals with a situation where everything doesn't go to plan.

We recently hired Onewash to come and do our windows, gutters, and an exterior softwash of our home.  The crew that showed up was newly hired and didn't do the greatest job.  When I got home from work I did notice a few spots that weren't the greatest but it was a Friday, long week and I thought I would check the rest tomorrow.

Later that evening I got a message from the owner Ben.  He asked me to check the work thoroughly because there had been some complaints about this particular crew not leaving jobs 100% complete to the Onewash standards.  Sure enough when I checked the next day I found several spots that weren't done correctly.

I sent the pictures to the owner Ben and he scheduled one of the their top senior employees to come and fix all the issues.  The gentlemen who came by yesterday was very friendly, very thorough, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was done properly.

This is how you judge a business.  Do they take care of situations when things don't go according to plan.  Onewash showed great integrity in this situation and I wouldn't hesitate to recommend them to others!

reviews.text:
UPDATE:
I want to amend my original review as the company reacted favourably to my original review by coming out, inspecting our concerns and then coming back to resolve the issues. Geer apologized for their errors and I'm sure he will be paying closer attention to his customer communications - he's a quick learner!We're now much happier with this company and their work and may hire them again next year to clean our windows and the underside of our aluminum deck cover.

I'll now recommend them to others.

***************

This company has great reviews but unfortunately, we can’t add to them. They postponed the original date and time for cleaning the house and interior windows (including the window tracks) twice. When they came, they did a great job on the interior windows but didn’t clean the side tracks of the vertically opening windows, so they still make noise when they move.

Outside, they rinsed the glass with a brush and water, but didn’t use any cleaner or a scrubber that would take the grime off.

They did a great job on the ceiling of the deck, and the siding, except for one section where they sprayed against the vinyl siding overlap, rather than with it, meaning the water went behind the vinyl. The dirty water leaked out overnight and caused ugly, muddy runoff down the siding, which our neighbours remarked on because it’s nearest the road. I messaged, sent the picture they asked for, and expected they’d send someone to clean it up right away.

Seven days later, I messaged again, saying I keep getting reminders to pay their invoice, and I would happily pay as soon as they cleaned the leakage.

They finally responded three days after that, saying “Sorry, we will be back out asap!”

They didn’t come out asap, but finally, 10 days later, asked if they could come out that day.  I agreed and said two windows needed attention, but we wouldn't be home.  We returned to find the most visible dirt was removed, but they had also sprayed it onto the recently cleaned window, so it was dirty again. Also, they didn’t clean the bottom of the wall.

Anticipating voicing our concerns would lead to another three weeks of delays and messages, we decided to pay the invoice and never contract them again.

To summarize, in our situation they had a hard time with customer service, changing appointments and then not following through. They needed to be prodded multiple times to get them to respond and ignored my request about the windows that needed attention.

As for their work, we have vertical windows that still squeal when opened, a messy lower wall in one place and all the exterior windows still have the grimy film they should have removed by using a cleaner and scrubbing rather than rinsing with a brush and water.

reviews.author: Amadeus Godek
reviews.text:
I don't write reviews often, but my recent experience with Air Tech was deserving of one. They went above and beyond to help us out during the busiest time of year, and we were beyond grateful for their help.

Our gas furnace had quit on us over this past weekend. We knew it was on its last legs, but had been hoping we could make it through to the spring and finally get it replaced. Unfortunately, life had different plans. Our furnace totally quit on us, and being our only heat source we needed it dealt with fast with the cold weather incoming.

We called Air Tech on saturday, and were met with kindness, politeness, and above all, CARE over the phone!! The lovely lady we spoke with reassured us that they would make time for us, despite the Christmas rush and it being a saturday. Within one hour, we had a technician show up to our door and diagnose the problem. He was prompt to assess the damage, punctual in his timeline, and once again, friendly and caring, which means a lot when you are in a very stressful situation. The technicians gave us clear communication throughout his diagnosis and took the time to explain what was wrong, which we really appreciated. He gave us an option for repair, but did mention the old age of the furnace as well as the inefficiency due to its age.

Based off of our lovely experience with Air Tech so far, we trusted them to provide us with a fair quote on a new furnace and AC unit. We had been quoted for replacement previously by another company, and Air Tech not only BEAT their price, but threw in a free one year service and filter replacement!!

The install team showed up the FOLLOWING WEEK. They were friendly and highly professional. You could tell they were skilled at what they do, and quite honestly, they made the whole job feel like a breeze. They took the time and care to leave their work areas cleaner than they had been before, they showed up every day ready to work and worked hard to get the job done. I really appreciate it guys. Our new furnace is quiet, efficient. We feel fully confident in our heating system going into the winter, and our cooling system for the got months to follow.

We are beyond grateful for the team at Air Tech for showing classy old fashioned customer service, fair pricing, and accommodating our needs during this stressful time. You can tell everyone that works there is well taken care of and enjoys what they do, and that makes all the difference. We cant thank you all enough! Will definately recommend to friends and family and use them again in the future.

reviews.author: Shannon Brown
reviews.text:
This company is completely inept.  COMPLETELY.  I’m taking the time to write out every mistake.  It’s going to be long, but hopefully this will save someone else from a nightmare.

Our furnace stopped working on a Sunday morning in January.  My husband sent AirTech an email describing that we had a geothermal system and asked if they could repair the furnace we have.  They said they could.  They sent a guy, David, the next day (Monday).  David said the bracket on the fan housing was loose, and we’d have to get a whole new housing.  (This is mistake number one.)  Okay, fine, how long will that take?  We’ll let you know, he said.  (Luckily, we have a wood stove in our basement meant to be used as an emergency backup, but we only had about 10 days worth of firewood.)

Five days later, we still hadn’t heard from anyone.  Hubby called and the girl who answered the phone said she had sent an email.  We didn’t get one.  He asked her what email address she had sent it to and she rattled off some address that wasn’t even close to ours.  (Mistake number two.) Bear in mind, we had emailed them, so all she had to do was reply to that email.  The incorrect email would have bounced back with a message that the email address was invalid, but they did nothing.  Didn’t check the address, didn’t call us, didn’t just reply to the email we had sent. (Mistake number three.)  To make matters worse, they were waiting for our reply to the incorrect email before ordering the part, so we’re now 5 days without a working furnace, and they haven’t even ordered the part!  We should have given up on them at this point, but we said to go ahead and order the part.

The next Thursday (it took six days to get the part from the Lower Mainland—a five hour drive away), David shows up to finally fix our furnace.  But wait…no, he can’t fix it because they ordered the wrong part.  (Mistake number four.)  He promises they’ll get the right part “quickly” and come back and fix it right away.
This is Day 10 without a furnace, and we had to go get more firewood…in January.  (At this point, we tracked down the guy who had originally installed our system (he’s moved to Surrey or we would have called him in the first place), and he tells us he could have fixed it in six minutes, but I digress.)

It took another full week (Day 17) for David to return with the “correct” part.  He shows up on the day we were leaving to go away for a few days.  It takes him three hours to install the part because “it doesn’t fit properly”.  Then he tells us that the motor doesn’t work.  We know and he knows that the motor was working when he first showed up.  (Mistake number five.) Now we need a new motor.  We got the part number from our guy, Barry (Geo-tech Geothermal, fabulous company—I highly recommend) because we don’t trust that AirTech won’t screw up again.

We go away for the weekend.  When we returned, we had a mechanic take a look.  He very quickly noticed that the wires to the motor aren’t hooked up properly, so of course the motor wouldn’t run.  (Mistake number six.)

So, after 21 days, I called to tell them that we’re done with them.  I explained all this to the woman who answered the phone.  She didn’t even have the decency to apologize.

reviews.author: Randal Froese
reviews.text:
We moved into our condo last summer so we wanted to have the fireplace checked to confirm it was operating normally and safely.

Our fireplace was done by two gentleman.   It appeared to be a lead and a trainee that came to do the service.  I asked them if there were bulbs in the fireplace?  They looked for them during the service and found them.  Because they found them and because all four needed replacing, I asked them to not put it back together so I could pickup bulbs and install them.

Then, I had to leave the condo momentarily, at which time guys left.  And they left the unit in a bit of a mess.  No courtesy to vacuum out the remaining glass media (even though they had a vacuum there).  No courtesy to offer re-assembly instruction tips (which I kinda needed).  No courtesy to ask my wife who was there, if there was anything else that we needed.  I was not impressed.

Judging by their body language, the lead gentleman appeared to be a "let's do as little as possible and get out of here" kind of guy.  The trainee was different.  He seemed really great but didn't have the initiative to speak up.  His communication was by eye contact and gestures.  But great to have there.

I received a report on the receipt but not very detailed.  I wanted to know exactly what was done and what was checked because I am not a fireplace expert.  Was it safe to operate, was my main question.  I was shocked when they left so soon.

I managed to replace the bulbs and re-assemble the unit.  It is running well now.  I was just not impressed with THE WAY the service was done and the poor report provided following.  To be excellent means to go the extra mile.  Which, in this case would have been to vacuum out the excess media and offer re-assembly instruction tips.  That would be an extra 5-10 minutes in this case.  Keep in mind that they did not have re-assemble the fireplace and replace the media, so they were saving time there.

This experience may not be a reflection on Comfort Tech as a company overall, however it reflected poorly for the lead technician that came to our condo on that day and was disappointing for me as a customer.

reviews.text:
My thoughts on the initial visit were below, but I’m having to update this:

Update:

My PTAC heating issue is still not fully resolved after three visits from Falcon. The same intermittent malfunction continues even after the unit was swapped out.

Visit summary:
•	Visit 1: Technician confirmed the original PTAC was toast and noted the thermostat might be failing, but no thermostat replacement was done because it was pending availability of a replacement PTAC.
•	Visit 2: The PTAC was replaced with an older spare from elsewhere in the building. Heat was improved — no full failure — but the intermittent malfunction still occurred on this replacement unit.
•	Visit 3: Technician arrived with parts, but none were suitable for this specific model. No thermostat replacement or internal repair was completed.

The issue across both units remains the same:
•	If the unit is shut off, it will never start heating again until the breaker is reset.
•	Sometimes it runs but only blows lukewarm air for long periods, even with correct settings.
•	The fan has continued running for hours while set to Auto or Off — which I was specifically instructed was the correct way to turn it off — and only stops after a breaker reset.

Although normal operation was explained again, parts of the visit were framed as user-operation error, which I take issue with. I explained the malfunction clearly and in detail three to six separate times, and the problem occurs across two different PTAC units and only resolves with a breaker reset — consistent with an internal thermostat or control fault, not incorrect operation.

After three visits, there have been zero thermostat repairs, and likely three billable callouts, with the underlying malfunction still unresolved. Given the thermostat’s age and the early indication that it may be failing, proactive replacement would be the responsible next step to prevent failure at an inconvenient time.

Original:
The technician who replaced my PTAC was friendly, skilled, and did a solid job — no issues with the repair itself. But I was disappointed with the lack of care for my space. He set tools and the PTAC access panel directly on my brand-new bed (less than 48 hours old) and left wire scraps on the floor and in the hallway. Maybe they fell during the install, but it still showed a lack of attention to detail. Good tech — just needs to be much more respectful of customers’ property and cleanup.

We have been clients of Okanagan Heating for close to 30 years for maintenance and repair calls. Recently, we hired them to install a dual fuel system (furnace and heat pump), a new hot water tank, and replace all the poly-b plumbing in our home with PEX.

We met with Nick, the owner, in August. Nick explained the time and cost savings with having the new installations and poly-b removal done at the same time. The quote that he provided us seemed very reasonable. Nick said the job would take five days; we scheduled it for the beginning of October.

Prior to the job starting, we also had some communication with the office staff. Both Fawn and Wendi were very helpful and friendly when answering our questions. After the job was completed, they helped us by scheduling the City inspector; providing us with the necessary paperwork to apply for the FortisBC rebate program; and booking the air duct and vent cleaning.

As the start date of the project got closer, we were feeling a bit of stress worrying about what condition the walls and ceilings would be in after the plumbing was replaced. However, when we met Cam and Bryant the first day of the job it was clear that they had done this many times before and were very knowledgeable.
They were both very friendly and good at explaining what was happening as the days went along. Also, they managed to avoid cutting any unnecessary holes in the drywall which kept the mess to a minimum. The job was finished on time and for the amount initially quoted.

This large project gave us a special appreciation for the company and everyone that works there. They made it so easy for us.
It is clear that Nick has compiled a team of hard working, knowledgeable and friendly staff. We would definitely recommend Okanagan Heating Air Conditioning and Plumbing and we look forward to many more years of working with them.

reviews.author: Luke
reviews.text: Highly recommended for spray foam! Steve came to site to measure and ensure an accurate quote (unlike the others) and plan out the job (especially good as my building is situated on a steep and tricky, long hill). The team who did the spray foaming adequately covered the floors and valuables with plastic to prevent any overspray and they worked an extra long day to make sure they got the job done in one visit. While I provided scaffolding, the guys had no problem taking it down and putting it up again where they needed it, with no complaints. For R28, they promised 4.7" of spray foam. When we punched holes in the roof for venting and the chimney, I could see these guys did not short sell me at all, in many places even a bit more than 4.7" of foam - they delivered exactly what they promised, professionally. Their pricing was also the best of 3 quotes. For spray foam in Vernon, Kelowna and surrounds, I would honestly suggest you don't bother shopping around, just call BC Spray Foam & Insulation.
