Well I’m glad I decided to save the money and go with BC Spray because from start to finish they came in and showed exemplary professionalism from day 1. They worked with me and my needs for the project, budget and even had some professional advice regarding other trades going on at my house. I can say with full confidence you’ll be happy with what you get. From the workers in the house to the company owner, it felt like a classic family owned local business while delivering a 5-star product and incredible customer service as we worked through several issues during construction. I have recommended BC Spray to numerous family and friends and will definitely be calling back for any further work in other properties.

reviews.author: devan wiancko
reviews.text: They do an amazing job for those who don't know Sewage treatment is the process of removing contaminants from municipal wastewater, containing mainly household sewage plus some industrial wastewater. Physical, chemical, and biological processes are used to remove contaminants and produce treated wastewater (or treated effluent) that is safe enough for release into the environment. A by-product of sewage treatment is a semi-solid waste or slurry, called sewage sludge. The sludge has to undergo further treatment before being suitable for disposal or application to land.Sewage treatment may also be referred to as wastewater treatment. However, the latter is a broader term that can also refer to industrial wastewater. For most cities, the sewer system will also carry a proportion of industrial effluent to the sewage treatment plant that has usually received pre-treatment at the factories to reduce the pollutant load. If the sewer system is a combined sewer, then it will also carry urban runoff (stormwater) to the sewage treatment plant. Sewage water can travel towards treatment plants via piping and in a flow aided by gravity and pumps. The first part of the filtration of sewage typically includes a bar screen to filter solids and large objects that are then collected in dumpsters and disposed of in landfills. Fat and grease are also removed before the primary treatment of sewage.

They use an AI system that takes a photo of your bin, so if one bag is over the rim you get charged $95. They charge for air as our bins are never overweight, just extra air in our garbage bags that sometimes makes it so they look like they overfill the bin.

Calm, focused, and respectful of the space, he handled that wasp situation like it was just another day at the office—no fuss, no drama, just smooth, skilled execution. reviews.text: The store itself looks good but the staff need better customer service training especially for returns. We did not have a receipt so were informed that we would receive a credit.  We were fine with that.  However, before she would issue the gift card, she was insistent on finding our purchase via our rewards account or credit card which she could not do.  Suddenly this seemed to be our fault!  Kept asking us for more methods of payment and then asked over and over if this was where we bought the lights and was it really only a couple weeks ago!!  The third degree for $10 worth of light bulbs!!!  In the end, a manager was called to deal with us and we received a credit minus a 20% restocking fee.  I work in retail and I understand the need for loss prevention due to fraudulent returns but maybe give your employees some training on diffusing a situation instead of escalating and making a mountain out of a mole hill.  Do they not have authority to action a $10 return??  This experience has left me wondering about my loyalty to Canadian Tire. reviews.author: Matt Dodds
reviews.text:
Poor Value for Exceptional Price

The finished project looks good, but its exceptional price is not matched by exceptional quality. In fact, much of the detail and finishing work is average at best.

The final cost came in at 200% higher than the agreed upon quote, tripling the price of the job. While some surprises are expected, and there was an addition to the project, the final bill was unjustified by the actual work.

I was upsold on a larger irrigation control unit as I needed 18-19 zones, up from the existing 12.  This was not needed in the end, as the final system only required 13 zones but they still installed and charged me for the larger capacity unit. The crew damaged existing fencing panels they removed for access and replaced them with non-outdoor rated wood, and then charged me for the replacement, and I have to seal the wood now. They lost the wiring for an existing irrigation zone that didn't require work and was not part of the project. They billed me to re-trench and connect the existing irrigation line to fix their error.

For the price paid, the attention to detail was sorely lacking, and they damaged multiple existing and new trees. The crew damaged over half of the new trees during planting, ripping the trunks. I was told all the dead in them was shock, but most have not come back fully. We will see in the spring the true damage they did. They repeatedly struck existing and new trees with the Bobcat, ripping off multiple branches.The mulch rings around trees were not centered, and they were overfilled with dirt mixed with mulch, which is now promoting weed growth. I have had to dig out and replace all of it. Same for the river rock edging. Numerous details like a drip line being run outside the tree edging, so you couldn't string trim around it, show a lack of care in the finishing work. The amount of broken valves, connectors, pieces of rebar I have picked up strewn around the edging has totaled 17 pieces.

The irrigation has been a significant headache. I have had to call the company back nine times for chronic issues, including leaks, non-functioning zones, missing irrigation and control timer problems. I have now given up and am hiring a separate irrigation company to fix their work and have redone some of it myself.

Because of their inadequate irrigation work, we have lost half of our garden and one new tree. Another new tree was never hooked up to irrigation, they just simply didn't run a line to it, and when they corrected it after we saw it was dry and dying, the line still didn't work and I had to take it apart and blow the dirt out that had plugged the line. Most sprinkler heads are a tripping hazard. While they returned twice to lower some heads, most still need to be adjusted to a proper depth for mowing. There were two sections of exposed pipe which on a complaint they lowered but I have no faith I can aerate my lawn in those areas.

The fencing was also a challenge for them with gaps as the posts were placed wider than the panels, broken panels left as finished. I could go on on all areas of the job, bottom line the quality was not worth the final cost or even half of it.

The owner is responsive to complaints, which is good customer service, but it is deeply frustrating to require them to return almost a dozen times. The rock wall they installed looks nice, and the sod took well.

I recommend this company only for large items like rock walls. I advise against hiring them for irrigation, fencing, or any finishing/detailed work. Keep an eye on your bill.

All Pictures are their finished work, it was left in this state.

In gratitude for your business and the time you took to write your review we offer you a $20 gift card to Starbucks (or a $20 discount on your next service - where available).

All you have to do to collect your reward is to simply reply to this email with a screenshot of your review and the address we should mail your gift card to."

I don't use Jim's Mowing or BC Mowing and More, but a couple years back I did ask for an estimate that came back quite high. reviews.author: Tina Rasmussen
reviews.text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Hampton Pools & Landscape for a large backyard pool scape installation, and I am incredibly proud of the results.

It certainly was a process and one that took an education in things I knew nothing about like geotechnical and structural engineering, electrical routing, cantilevering and so much more but I felt incredibly supported by Denise Van Beveren and Tim Valerioti though every step of a very intense and sprawling project.

Before we started, I had a virtually useless backyard on the side of a mountain and from initial consultation through to completion, Tim (the designer and chief of Hampton)and his team literally transformed it into a stunning oasis reminiscent of 1960’s Palm Springs. I didn’t want the usual kind of backyard and approached the project with a finite budget and Tim and Hampton took that challenge on with aplomb.

As everything was completely custom, I know I couldn’t have gotten the kind of results from just any pool company. I am so happy that I selected Hampton because they understand that "custom" refers to designs, materials, or features that are specifically tailored to meet the unique needs, preferences, and specifications of their client,  including architectural designs, layouts, finishes, and fixtures. This was very important for me because it allowed me to have a space that reflects my individual taste and lifestyle. Hampton ensured that every detail aligned with my vision. That kind of value is Incomparable.

Their custom design absolutely enhanced the functionality of my space and in fact, added a tremendous amount of usable square footage and significantly increased the value of my property. I know that my new backyard sanctuary will add significant value, making it more attractive to future buyers, especially those who appreciate unique and high quality elements.

I felt like working with Hampton was a true collaboration. There was a lot of flexibility and we made changes during the design and construction process, allowing for adjustments based on  new ideas and solutions to problems that arose.

Custom construction encourages creativity and innovation, leading to unique solutions which is why i am compelled to highlight Tim Valerioti, the designer and powerhouse behind this incredible transformation. Tim is not just a designer; he is a true artist with a remarkable ability to blend creativity with functionality. His keen eye for detail and innovative solutions made the entire process very enjoyable. Tim approached every challenge with a problem-solving mindset, ensuring that each component of my backyard was not only beautiful but custom tailored to my dreams.

What truly sets Tim apart is his reluctant big heart. He genuinely cares about his clients and their visions, making the collaboration feel personal and tailored.

His design was based on a fractal and from the initial 3D design presentation I was hooked. The design features a gorgeous pool with a Baja ledge and custom liner. The custom fire pit is a fantastic gathering spot for evenings, and the outdoor solar shower and counter space add incredible functionality. The cantilevered hot tub looks like a nest suspended out on a ledge.

A couple of the standout features are the complete restoration and modification of my 1958 Shasta Airflyte trailer that is now my writing studio, pool house and bar.

I also love the utterly unique art pedestals they incorporated, which showcase my quirky, artistic sensibility and create a sense of whimsy that everyone comments on when they come to enjoy the pool.

The addition of outdoor swings,  and a neon sign brings a fun, whimsical vibe that my family and friends adore.

Overall, Hampton Pools & Landscape exceeded my expectations. Their commitment to me as their client, through every aspect of the project (and it wasn’t all easy or smooth), was honestly without equal.  I highly recommend them to anyone looking to create a custom outdoor space, because they believe in, and make magic.

reviews.author: Ryan Bruce
reviews.text:
I cannot express my immense disappointment with Hampton Pools & Landscape, whom I hired for my pool & landscape project. Their glaring lack of communication, planning, and overall management led to a project that dragged on for a staggering 22 months, despite their own projected timeline of just 3 months. It is with great frustration, and ongoing issues, that I write this negative review to warn others about their incompetence and lack of professionalism.

From the very beginning, the company failed to maintain consistent and effective communication. I constantly had to chase them for even the most basic information, which is highly unprofessional and unacceptable.

It quickly became evident that they were ill-prepared and unable to handle the scope of my project. Delays, excuses, and constant changes to the timeline became the norm, leaving me utterly frustrated.

Their own project schedule, which estimated a completion time of 3 months, was nothing more than a pipe dream. I watched in disbelief as week after week went by with minimal progress, and the company seemed disorganized and incapable of keeping to their own commitments. It is clear that they had no control over the project's workflow, resulting in a prolonged and unnecessarily drawn-out ordeal.

This level of incompetence is simply unacceptable. The company showed a complete lack of respect for my time and investment, leaving me a project that has major flaws (including, most recently, a failing retaining wall).  The lack of professionalism and failure to manage their resources effectively are red flags that should make any potential customer reconsider working with this company.

I strongly advise anyone considering hiring Hampton Pools and Landscape to look elsewhere for their needs. The lack of quality, communication, planning, and accountability they exhibited throughout my project should serve as a warning sign to others. Save yourself the stress, disappointment, and wasted time by finding a company that values its customers and can deliver on its promises.  Should you still require more information relating to this, I encourage you to look into civil law suits against this company, this review is well documented there!

reviews.author: Viviane Mehr
reviews.text: Hampton did a full re-landscaping of my lakefront property including a new pool and hot tub. That was back in 2012. They have stood by their work and done anything they can to help me keep it all as beautiful and functional as ever. I love what they did with the property as much today as I did eleven years ago!

reviews.text:
We moved to Kelowna and built a house with a pool 2 years ago. We were unfamiliar with any contractors or businesses but Hampton Pools and Landscaping was highly recommended. We were not disappointed. Tim did a great job helping us choose our pool tile and design to get the look we wanted and in recommending different features for the pool. Tim and Dean together with their crew, suggested and created a unique landscape design and fence. Any issues that arose were dealt with quickly and professionally. Everyone we dealt with at Hampton was pleasant and professional and I would not hesitate to recommend their team.

Madeleine

reviews.author: Louella Klassen
reviews.text:
After believing that we had done our homework on pool companies, we hired Hampton Pools in Sept 2019 to create a pool oasis in our yard. Tim’s design was good, but we should have recognized the red flags. There was never a set of blueprints created, nor elevations shot to measure from (a definite necessity as it turned out). The “drawings” were not to scale nor did they reflect actual location of buildings on our lot.
Communication between management, supervisors, crews, sub trades and the homeowners (us), was minimal at best. Poor organization of workspace, crews, and daily tasks meant the job took much longer than expected. We were advised that it would take 2-3 months to complete (starting the last week of Sept). At the beginning of December, we shut down the crew. It was far too cold to continue and although we were told they could continue working through the winter, we were not prepared to pay to cover and heat the entire area. There was still so much work to do!
We (homeowners) completed ALL of the landscaping, gardens, and finished (restructured) the tiled decks, to make elevation grades work, in the spring of 2020.
I could go on and on with specific issues, and there were MANY, but I will confirm that the liner was installed at the end of May, and the auto cover finally this summer, and we were finally able to swim.
Since then, we have spoken to a few sub trades, and suppliers, and they have literally apologized when they hear that Hampton was our pool installer.
What should have been an exciting time and project for us, was not...

What really surprised me was how much of a difference it made. The whole backyard looks fresher and way more polished. Huge curb appeal boost.

I’ve always done this kind of work myself, rented the tools, spent the weekend hacking away, but after seeing the results (and how efficient they were), this is something I’ll happily leave to the pros going forward. Initial communication was timely, quote was fast to receive, and price was on point. They showed up on time, worked hard, and were respectful of our yard, furniture, space, and our pets.

Honestly, my only regret is not calling them sooner. I’ll definitely be bringing them back for annual maintenance from here on out.

reviews.text:
Last summer, we hired Synergy to build a large extension to our existing patio and construct a fence and path, and we couldn't be happier with the experience and the results.

From the very beginning, the entire team was a pleasure to work with. Everyone we interacted with, from the on-site work crew to the office staff, was friendly, professional, and clearly dedicated to providing excellent service. We really enjoyed Shannon's vision for the project, and her collaborative style in the design process. We felt that everyone took true pride in their work, and the construction crew were always excited for us to see what new additions they had completed each day. We witnessed them working tirelessly and they responded positively to feedback, to ensure we were happy with the final product every step of the way.

Despite unexpected delays on our side, the company was very accommodating. They went above and beyond to rearrange their schedule multiple times to fit our timeline, which we greatly appreciated. The final result was exactly what we had envisaged, or better. The new patio looks great and we can't wait to use it this year.

reviews.author: Sheila Goldsmith
reviews.text:
We feel very fortunate to have chosen Synergy for our extensive landscaping project in our 20 home strata community.
Their task was to completely remove all plantings, irrigation and a leaning retaining wall plus totally redo another garden surrounding the strata water fountains. The plantings, irrigation and retaining wall were over 30 years old and in desperate need of updating.
This was by no means an easy task. To add to the list they had to remove a massive tree stump that had caused the retaining wall to lean. They replaced it with a beautiful stone wall and added lights that look beautiful in the evening.
They had the right equipment to complete the task of removing the massive stump and work began. To begin the project Max presented a detailed plan for all the work required. He met with me and went over the plans many times to make sure we were aware of how the project was going to proceed and how long he felt it would take.
Max was hands on throughout the whole landscaping project and met with me many times in the early morning going over what was going to happen next. He was always available either by phone or visiting me personally if I had any questions or concerns.
I cannot say a bad word about Max and his excellent crew that worked diligently throughout the whole process. Their choices of shrubs, plants and trees were perfect.
The crew arrived early and worked hard all day. They always made sure before they were leaving that the roadway was swept and clear of any machinery.
They transformed our community to a place we are all very proud of.
I would highly recommend Max and his crew for any project you might have.
Thank you Synergy!
Sheila Goldsmith

reviews.author: Paul Philps
reviews.text:
It was an interesting experience with K2 stone and one that I am hearing is happening more and more!  We dealt with them for our front stone and it looks great!

We did not think twice when we ordered our stone for the interior which was a finished stone.  We ended up dealing with Dallas and found the experience unpleasant to say the least.

They tried to force us into product that was substandard.... We ended up with chipped and damaged product which they came and viewed twice.

They knew we were under a time crunch and we had hired our own installer to put it in.  We called Dallas in after a couple rows because the pieces width were suppose to be 6 and 9 inches wide are all different sizes.  The corner pieces (that we paid extra for) do not match the sizes of the middle stone and don't sit flush.

The majority of our product has rough cuts / chips or their are spaces between the rows......

My favorite was after it was put up and I sent another email to Dallas he said "Oh, I wish you would have told us and we could have replaced...." I showed him the text messages and emails where I did and..... Let's say he went silent.  I told them to drop off replacement stone and we have it installed.... Funny the offer just went away.

We have a hearth that we paid a ton for that their machines marked up and they did a deal with our installer to have the marks polished out.... They actually started to threaten to not pay him...

Anyways, Timberstone I believe has started to offer the same stone and I would definitely look at them.  It's a shame as my builder friends will not deal directly with K2 and I would suggest you don't either.

reviews.author: Carley
reviews.text:
Absolutely Outstanding Experience – A Truly Exceptional Painting Company

Renovations are stressful, to say the least. Having a steady stream of tradespeople in and out of your home can feel overwhelming and invasive. But throughout our full renovation, Kyle and his team were an absolute breath of fresh air. From the moment they arrived, they brought a level of professionalism, warmth, and integrity that completely changed the tone of our experience.

Honestly, they felt like family. It’s rare to find a team that is not only incredibly skilled but also genuinely kind, respectful, and thoughtful. Kyle went above and beyond—time and time again—to ensure we were completely happy with every detail. His communication was impeccable, his attention to detail unmatched, and his follow-through flawless. Not a single stone was left unturned.

A special thank you to Royce, who was the project manager for our home—he could truly never do enough to help. His dedication, responsiveness, and calm presence made a world of difference. We felt completely taken care of every step of the way. Priscilla was such a sweetheart—warm, thoughtful, and incredibly hardworking. She brought such a positive energy into our home. And Nicole and Conor were equally fantastic, each bringing professionalism and care that was deeply appreciated. Sterling also played a key role behind the scenes, helping ensure everything ran smoothly on the administrative end.

You really do get what you pay for. This team takes immense pride in their work, and it shows in every brushstroke. They made what could have been a stressful process feel seamless and even enjoyable.

I had no prior experience with this company—I was just lucky enough to find them. And now, I would never recommend anyone else. If you’re facing a major renovation and want people in your home who are not only top-tier professionals but also just truly good humans, this is the team you want. An absolute dream to work with from start to finish.

reviews.author: Gord Walsh
reviews.text:
I called The Spray Booth in Kelowna on a Monday, asking if they could spray our interior doors. I dropped them off the next day at 2:00 PM and picked them up at the same time 24 hours later! Brian brought in a special shift that night and sprayed 10 interior doors and 11 bi-fold doors -they finished at 2:30 AM. He said he understood what it was like to have to go without doors in your home.

I also asked him if they would be interested in painting our massive 3-sided brick fireplace and feature wall that ran all the way down our hallway. It was ugly 1908's style rough brick, which is impossible to decorate around. I asked if it were possible to do some sort of effect on them, such as a 2-tone effect. He said they had done jobs where the first coat was sprayed on as the grout color, then the final coat was carefully rolled on as a top-coat in a lighter color.

Long story short, they sprayed the grout coat a charcoal color on Wednesday of the same week, then applied the top coat on the Thursday. We're so pleased with their speed and quality that they'll be here next week doing all our trim upstairs and downstairs in the new door color.

Great job Brian -and paint crew Joe and Tom!

reviews.text: Darcy was great, arrived on time and worked together with my dad to get the grab bar installed for my Oma. My only disappointment is that when making the reservation, I specifically asked if they had a stud finder that worked through tile ( apparently you need a special kind) and they assured me they could do the install so I took that to mean that they had one. If it was just figuring out how to put it up through trial and error, honestly my dad could have done it alone. They ended up putting extra holes in the tile because they didn't have the specific tool I asked about, which is too bad. They managed to cover it with the ring around the grab bar, but I wish I would have double checked and confirmed about the higher grade stud finder when i made the appointment so the install would have gone smoother. reviews.author: Paul Liversidge
reviews.text:
Disappointing, unprofessional, over-priced.

I needed a 50A hot tub connection. I was initially advised that only labour would be provided and that I'd need to provide the materials, so I ordered the 50A spa pack and 50A breaker for my main panel. Handyman came and provided a quote for $1,680 for labour and estimated materials to be $300-500. I then gave him the 50A spa pack which had arrived and he said that will work and save me some money. He then offered to collect the materials and finish the job same day. I agree, thinking I'm all-in for ~$2K — the labour quote plus $300-500 of materials and a discount for the $250 spa pack I've provided. He returns and as he's finishing the final hook-up, he says the material costs are going to be closer to $700. All-in-all, I ended up paying $2,356.84 to Handyman Connection and $250 to Amazon for the spa pack.

I'd already been quoted $2,200 for the job by another electrician, and I had an indicative quote of $2,000 from another (they wanted $150 to visit and firm up the quote) — both of which were given photos and the distance of the cable route.

At no point was I told what the final price was until it was too late. I now need to install a protector plate and patch up the two holes in the drywall. Kicking myself that I didn't do the job myself.

reviews.author: MapleGoodness
reviews.text:
We had a sudden need for a plumber to deal with a complete blockage of our kitchen and laundry drains.

The person who answered the phone was pleasant, was up front in her estimate of when I might expect service, and was up front about the premium for same-day service, which all was appreciated.

The call-back was very close to the estimated time, and the plumber was punctual in arriving.

Corey was professional, took time to make sure he understood what he was dealing with, and then got right to work clearing the drain.  He gave some advice on ways to help prevent a recurrence, got the job done quickly, cleaned up after himself, and has a professional, pleasant demeanor.

The only thing that could have been better was that other than  the same-day "get us to the door" premium that was verbally explained on my initial phone call, I was given no info from the plumber about the costs of the actual work that was being done, and only made aware of the cost once the invoice was sent several days later.

To be fair, I didn't ask the plumber,  as realistically we needed the work done regardless, he was already there, and I expect the cost would have been similar no matter who we had hired, but regardless I would have appreciated some mention of what we could expect for costs for the work that he was doing.

I also expected the bill to have some sort of itemization (eg. call out charge, hourly rate, cost for auger, that sort of thing) rather than just the total. I would just appreciate that extra level of transparency.

Otherwise, as far as the attentiveness, professionalism, and the work that was done, we were very satisfied.  The end cost, I believe, is probably on par with any other reputable company we could have hired.

Despite my quibbles with the details around the billing, I would not hesitate to call Plumbinators again in the future for other plumbing needs.

Thanks for the help.

reviews.author: Benita Saxen
reviews.text:
Exceptional Service – Above and Beyond

Discovery Community College recently needed to install a sink in our Vernon site classroom to meet healthcare compliance requirements. What we initially thought would be a straightforward project quickly became far more complex.

With the ongoing building boom in the Okanagan, we were unable to secure a framer until Spring 2026 — and even that was uncertain. I reached out to Trufinity Plumbing, and they connected us with Cole. We are incredibly grateful they did.

Without Cole, we quite literally would not have a sink installed today.

Not only did Cole go above and beyond in his work, he actively reached out through his industry contacts to help coordinate trades and move the project forward. When he encountered the same difficulty securing a framer for what was considered a “small job,” he stepped up and built the wall himself so he had a proper structure to run the plumbing to the ceiling.

He then connected us with Franky from NorthStar Drywall, who did an excellent job, allowing ProWorks Painting to seamlessly match the existing paint. Cole returned afterward to complete and connect the sink unit.

Throughout the entire process, Cole was professional, solution-focused, determined, and exceptionally skilled. He was wonderful to work with, and we felt fully supported and in capable hands from start to finish. Chilina in the office always notified us of when Cole would be onsite and timelines of the project. The texts with the plumber’s photo is a nice touch so the site knew who would arrive. Chilina stayed in contact while the other trades were active. Cole and Chilina helped to drive the project forward to completion.

We highly recommend Trufinity Plumbing. Thank you, Cole — and Chilina, - it has been an honour working with you.

reviews.author: RVs Corner
reviews.text:
Last time I had Wiener’s Plumbing and Drain Cleaning do work in our home was in April 2024.
They did excellent work at that time and we were very pleased with the quality of work and the professionalism of the crew.
Well, it was time to have the company back to do more work. This time the job required pulling a new water supply line into our home from the street. Because the supply line was still the old “Poly-B” (Grey water line), and these lines have been failing and springing leaks in our neighbourhood, we decided to schedule this repair/replacement of the old “Poly-B” to the New 1” PEX line instead of waiting for it to fail. It would have cost us more to get the repair done with an emergency call. This time, we had the new Supply Service line pulled into our house, as well as replacing the Hot Water Tank with a tank-less Hot Water System. We also had them replace the three remaining “Poly-B” lines that ran into the laundry-room and the outside tap, with PEX water lines. This was the last of the “Poly-B” (Grey) water lines. We also had them replace the outside water water tap at the front of the house with a new one.
The sub-contractor for the cement work also repaired the two areas in the house that had to be dug up to get the new 1” PEX water supply line pulled into the house. Under the garage sink and in the mechanical room. There was a lot of work that needed to be done here and the crew was excellent and knew what they
were doing. Everyone was very helpful and easy to talk to about any concerns we had. Any problems that they ran into, they were able to solve.
Wiener’s Plumbing is definitely a top-notch company that can be trusted to get the job done.

Last fall when we closed the pool my wife and I had the same dread, after winter we get to start the "whole process" over again. reviews.text:
I don't really write a lot of reviews but hope this will be helpful to anyone considering an investment in a hot tub.

I did A LOT of research before buying a new hot tub and ended up choosing the Summit model from Arctic Spas Kelowna. I’m really glad I did.

What stood out right away was the build quality and smart design. The outside walls are fully enclosed, which is a huge upgrade from my last Beachcomber tub where the pumps were under the stairs and mice could get into the wiring. On this tub, all the pumps and components are enclosed in the walls, so that’s no longer a worry.

Another big factor for me was how they handle insulation. Unlike most top brands that fill the entire interior cavity with spray foam, Arctic insulates the walls instead. That might sound like a small detail, but it’s huge when something goes wrong: you can actually access and repair everything without ripping apart foam.

And that paid off quickly—there were a few issues with the tub when it was first installed. The difference was how easily and efficiently the Arctic Spas Kelowna team was able to fix them. That experience really drove home what I now think is the most important part of buying a hot tub: not assuming it will last forever without issues, but choosing a company and dealer who will stand behind your purchase. On that front, Arctic Spas Kelowna has been outstanding.

On top of everything else, their service team can now monitor my water quality remotely, which is a fantastic feature and gives me real peace of mind. Their service manager, Morgan, is really great to deal with and makes otherwise complicated issues easy to understand and goes above and beyond to ensure every fix is done right and has a great team of long-time service techs to get things done right.

I highly recommend Arctic Spas Kelowna—both for the quality of the tub and the level of service after the sale.

reviews.author: Tara Adamyk
reviews.text:
It’s pretty nice for a community pool but stars are knocked off because the change rooms are absolutely DISGUSTING. We were in and out of them over a course of a few hours and never saw anyone cleaning them. They honestly look like no one has cleaned them in a week. I’ve never seen so much hair on a floor in my life. Long black strands plugging all the drains. And gobs of spit!!! My kids, who normally don’t care about getting dirty, were totally grossed out. Also we went through a dollar in change before we found a locker that worked. Last complaint is the front admissions, which I saw other remarks about too: sooo sloooow. Not sure why it took 15 minutes for a few people to pay for a drop-in.

Otherwise, the Flowrider is a unique thing my kids liked. Three slides (one was closed). Disappointed that you have to be 13 to jump off the higher diving board. Water was cold. I guess I wasn’t done complaining. I personally wouldn’t come back but my little kids probably would. Not my teen though. He was bored pretty fast.

reviews.author: Angel Dutchak
reviews.text:
Held an active membership here for YEARS. Always paid, didn’t always use the membership to its full advantage but really loved it here.

Last year, I emailed to cancel my membership, the person who I emailed suggested I just put it on hold, so whatever I did. Life goes on, and it slipped my mind TO the tune of actually paying out of pocket for visits and swimming lessons completely forgotten that I had only held it. A few months later the membership comes off hold, and for what I can only imagine is to do this exact thing, they don’t alert you to it. So they charge me 184 dollars a month for 4 months, until I notice one day. I called THINKING this would be cut and dry, a mistake I didn’t use it no harm no fowl, an honest mistake. INSTEAD Megan Alcock told me I’m an adult and it’s my responsibility to be aware, and I guess not make mistakes and told me too bad so sad. After much push back she agreed in “Good faith” to return only 2 months While acknowledging I paid out-of-pocket to use the facilities, and that she would refund those but not my other unused months. Which I haven’t received because I need to go get it or whatever.

I sent an email to Allyson Graf about the issue who had no interest in responding just kicking it back to Megan saying-

“ Our CEO, Allyson Graf, has received your correspondence. At this time, the refunds outlined above represent the full extent of what we will offer”

Absolutely mystified by this situation. I would love to return because my kids love it there But I just can’t. And I will make sure that I share this story to anyone who will listen.

reviews.author: Kole Blooded
reviews.text:
Lifeguards take their job seriously and make sure top safety. Staff are always cleaning. Great place for the kiddos. It does get very busy, but even myself as an adult had fun and went down the slides.
Wholesome family time, 10/10

reviews.author: M1inne
reviews.text:
Pool is nice.
the change room was clean.
The lockers were a bit frustrating  to figure out
a little girl went missing and everyone had to get out of the pool.

staff was nice,

reviews.author: Matt
reviews.text: Not typically a leaver of bad reviews but this place sucks. Arrived with wife and son, was told my wife needed ID even though we all had an account and had been there without ID hundreds of times. She didn’t have her wallet but after some searching we found it in her phone. Then it’s $33 for the three of us just to use the pool. Ok. Greasy but it’s 2025 I’ll accept that. We get inside. Family change rooms closed. Ok. We split up. I go inside the change room is brimming with folks. can barely move let alone find a spot to change my son.  Anyways get the kid sorted and get my trunks on then the locker eats my quarters. Back out to reception to get more in my trunks carrying my son. Ok we get locked up and get inside. Oh, there are 5 groups of lessons scattered throughout the wave pool, so you have zero space and the hot tub has a lineup a mile long. Pretty cool. Absolutely terrible experience. Figure it out. Community centers should not be for-profit enterprises.

reviews.author: Kalib Dressel
reviews.text: As a builder, I rely heavily on dependable and professional sub-trades—Howie and his team absolutely delivered. He fit me into his busy schedule, showed up when he said he would, and stuck to the budget. The entire process was seamless from start to finish, and most importantly, the end result is some very happy clients. Couldn’t ask for more. Highly recommend Howie’s Hot Tub!

reviews.author: Craig Hostland
reviews.text: Top quality service and follow up. Howie really cares and his pricing is very competitive. I've already recommended him to neighbours and friends. Keep up the good work Howie!

reviews.author: Scott Renou
reviews.text:
Howie installed a pool for me. He undersized the piping for the amount of water movement needed to adequately control my features and now it is under concrete and not able to be corrected. He installed a main brain unit that did not have enough outputs to operate the amount of features that are installed. He installed a used cover system that was never registered to me with the manufacturer(that I paid 15K for assuming it was new). The cover has been a non-stop issue since day one. The pool has been unavailable for use a large number of times in its short three year life and the rope to open it has had to be replaced 5 times in 3 years. Howie installed pentair bubbler lights which both died the first year and I had to buy them again because he would not warranty them the following season. He installed two different manufacturers of lighting equipment(Pentair/Hayward and then when I asked why the lights don't work properly together he told me I'm the first client that expected his lights to match up and function in the same color patterns. Now the pool cover motor has died and he has told me that the supplier of it will not even look at it because I hired a pool cover service company to change a broken rope when I couldn't reach Howie. After some investigation the cover system that he installed wasn't even a product Howies supplier even supplied anymore, so Howie just bought some discount unit that someone else had had and passed it off as my new system by adding a new physical cover material.

If you plan on enjoying a pool go to another installer because you will be very disappointed in the product you get at the end.

reviews.text: This guy is losing it!!! Can’t even return a call when he opened and closed our pool every year… you have to hunt him down and he’s not worth it.  He’s very rude and disrespectful. Complete waste of time and money and would not recommend.

reviews.author: Not Yet Perfect
reviews.text: We got a hottub from here 3 years ago brand new. The first day they set it up, we saw one of the hottub clips had broken during their installation process. I emailed them about it. No reply to our email, they said in person that it should be fine with the other three and did not offer to resolve the broken clip. 3 years later, all clips have broken, very poor quality. With that being said our hottub lid will fly open and debris, leaves, etc completely fill the hottub. This requires us to dump, drain, and reset the hottub almost every 2 weeks because of the lid flying open from small amounts of wind. I reached out to them multiple time's 3 months ago, they said they ordered us clips, and they were under warranty honouring three years. Someone called me 2 weeks later arguing about warranty and stated it’s not valid after 1 year. Regardless, I asked for that clip to be replaced the first day, now it’s 2 months later and I’ve called multiple times and been in store and been lied to about these clips being ordered and reserved for me. Now my hottub does not even work. It says flow error change filter, after we have changed filters the hottub doesn’t heat past 65 degrees now. I ordered clips of Amazon and replaced them yesterday. This company is a joke and now my hottub is literally broken. Stuck at 65 degrees on cold mode because the pump is clearly broken from all the debris that the wind threw into our hottub. Flow error change filter cold mode, all because they didn’t replace my clips 3 months ago, lied about warranty, and said they were ordered. A new guy from the store said they easily can be ordered and it’s in the Vernon store so why did I wait 3 months to be lied to about them never being ordered.

reviews.text: Sean was quick to come and fixed all the hot tub issues as well as an issue with my koi pond heater. reviews.author: Mstephen
reviews.text:
Our realtor hired Sean to do a pool inspection for a home that we had made an offer on. The pool inspection was done in late July 2020 and we took possession of the home on September 1, 2020. The summary of his inspection was "Overall, the pool, equipment and surrounding area are in very good to excellent condition with the only areas of concern being:
● skimmer and side drain ball valves Should be replaced.
● Care should be taken when walking around the waterfall upper area where the exposed plumbing is.
● Missing weir(flapping door that goes in the skimmer). Non essential but replacement should be considered.
● The minor pitting in one pool tile.
● An unverified functional pool light. "
After we took possession, we noticed some fairly large cracks in the coping.  There was no mention of this in the inspection report. We contacted Sean and his response was that the cracks must have occurred subsequent to his inspection. We contacted the previous owner who confirmed that the cracks had been there for sometime. It was late in the season and Sean and I agreed that he would do the repairs in the Spring 2021.

I contacted him at the beginning of April 2021 and he wanted to see a picture of the crack  again. This time I a made a video of the whole crack and sent it to him on April 7, 2021. He replied "That's very different from the picture that was sent to me last year. I'm not sure how I will respond to this. I'll speak to a concrete professional and get a recommendation." The picture I had sent previously did not cover the whole crack thus the reason I sent the video.  I did not hear from Sean, so on April 21 I sent him an email asking him when he would be fixing the crack. I again emailed him on May 3, May 11 and May 19. He did not respond to any of those emails. I sent Sean a text and left a voice mail and he did not respond to either. I sent him a lengthy email on May 25th expressing my frustration and have not heard anything from Sean.

On his website he states "My mission is to offer you a “human” connection for those times when things are going wrong. I get it. The pool and the spa are important parts of the family and of the home and when things break or the water doesn’t look right, it’s frustrating.
I offer a 100% personalized service for your pool or spa. You’ve got my number. Those aren’t just words. Families that play together stay together."

Obviously there is a disconnect between what the website states and how I was treated.

We have a tiled pool and we noticed that there was  a bulge in the glass tiles mid point on the waterfall wall about six to eight inches above the waterline. The bulge peaks at about the waterline and affects a number of tiles below the waterline as well. It's very noticeable when looking along the length of the wall. In addition, grout had disappeared from tiles on the stair walls which again was very noticeable.  Sean's comment in the inspection report was "Pool tiling is in very good condition with no missing tiles and no signs of degraded or damaged grout work. One exception to that is a large panel(the panel with the pool light) that has some moderate “pitting” in it that is smooth and in its current state does not pose a cutting/slicing hazard. This should be monitored for further degradation and repaired if required." Obviously the pool tiling is not in very good condition and there is damaged grout.

We are  having the pool tiling repaired this year and although I don't know the cost as the tiler is not sure just how many need to fixed, it will be  significant.  This is a cost that the previous should have borne had the inspector caught the issue and covered it in his report.

Although the cost of the repairs bothers me, what really bothers me is the fact that I did not get a response from Sean. I understand people are busy and miss emails, texts and phone calls. However, not responding to five emails, at least one phone call and text is not acceptable.

Mark S. Bragagnolo

reviews.text: Don't ever give your credit card info to them, they will charge you highter than a lawer.  You think the labour rate is $40/hour? Open your eyes and look again please. It's $40 per 15 minutes. Make sure you watch that clock like a hawk and let them know it.

reviews.author: Michelle Colvey
reviews.text:
AVOID at all costs.
We had an issue with our pool.  Had to wait a week for them to come when they were already in our area. Fine - understandable.

Tech arrives, is at our house for 5 min, 7 tops.  Tells us the salt cell needs to be replaced and leaves.  Company sent us an invoice for over $300.  We asked them to explain.

They billed us $119 for the call out, despite being in our area.  Ok, but, then they also added a fuel surcharge. It was a real pleasure working with Jeremy and his team. From the moment we met Jeremy and Jan, we knew we were in good hands. We had a few different contractors come in, some higher, some lower but chose to use Ultimate Pool Builders for a few different reasons.  We had to do a lot of earthworks in the form of extending and building up our yard due to the slope of our property. Knowing that Jeremy, Owner of "Okanagan Yard Works", brought experience and knowledge for this portion of the build, made it an easy decision to use the same contractor for the yard prep and the pool build. Jeremy took the time to sit down with us, listen to what we wanted, look at our plans and then fine tune it and design it. We gave Jeremy and his guys a tight timeline, and no doubt I was not easy on him. We made some changes throughout the process and Jeremy stayed very professional and accommodating.
In a project this size, there are always a few roadblocks and delays.  Jeremy stayed true, very transparent and honest while explaining these, collaborating with us to come up with solutions to stay on track.
His guys, Hunter and Grant were incredible. These guys went full speed all day, worked long hours and even the weekends to ensure the job was done on time. Daily, Hunter would give us an update on the progress, what to expect the following days. Hunter is definitely beyond his years and full of knowledge, experience in building pools.
Would most definitely suggest Ultimate Pool and Spa and Okanagan Yard Works for your next project.

reviews.text: Working with Ultimate Pool and Spa has been an excellent choice.  They are flexible, competent, and quality oriented.  We’ve built family memories that are priceless in our new back yard and pool.  Thank you!

reviews.text:
Earlier this year, we contacted Jeremy at Ultimate Pools among four others for quotations on pool installation. After a couple of preliminary meetings he was one of three quotes to come in and was not the lowest bid (close), but it was the most thorough and detailed. I noticed the language with some others was vague. We decided our best interest to go with Ultimate Pools even though they had not been around as long as others and had a tad pretentious name lol.
Starting the dig and prep, Jeremy's crew is fantastic. We had Hunter show up and take charge immediately like a seasoned pro. Wise beyond his years, he anticipates and asks questions if he doesn't already know as well as explains what happened that day and what to expect.
When installing a pool, one thing to know is that dates are planned, but dependent on weather, trades etc so this in mind, I was impressed with the level of accuracy of the timeline in spite of these conditions and if something was delayed, the level of communication to give not-so-good news.
We ended up adding the auto cover (Highly recommended) and some additional concrete work for a large patio and it looks beautiful! Total timeline was two months which included re-sod of our lawn and other fixes. Glad to know these are the same guys who run Okanagan Yard Works which of course we recommend as well.
In summary, it is a bit scary of a project and filled with emotional highs and lows but now, at the end of our first pool-owned summer, we have an incredible back yard oasis and many warm memories because of it. Thanks Jeremy and crew!

On the first leak, management's attitude was 'prove to me that it's leaking by removing a panel (NOT trivial) and finding the leak yourself', ostensibly to save us being charged for a service call.  My word that the water level is declining 6 cm a week was not sufficient.   They eventually did send a tech and the leak was found and fixed.

Our pool was re-opened in May and we were advised to add 5-8 bags of salt.   We added 5 to be safe.... but the salt reading was then off the charts (high).   That necessitated draining and additional trips for testing.   The manager looked for reasons why this was our fault.  Zero customer focus and no apology, let alone compensation.

I would not recommend this firm.

reviews.author: Jodie
reviews.text:
Sales Only - No Service!!

We were in the market for a swim spa with zero experience in what we were looking for. On our search we decided to check out World of Spas. Initial experience was good. They were helpful, friendly and knowledgeable. They were happy to help us make a purchase. Once the purchase was made, this is where things changed.

We put down our deposit and our swim spa was allegedly ordered and communication stopped. We had to follow up after 2 months to find out it was still a month away. We were promised spa school prior to its arrival and that did not happen. Ryan and Terri Ann were great at making promises yet failed to communicate at all.

Upon arrival of our swim spa, we were told the delivery people would fully educate us on chemicals and hook up our electrical which just had to be connected. None of that happened. We were given general ideas of chemicals but failed to tell us how to properly setup our swimspa, which we have now found out is critical. After having provided them with over $20k of deposits, the delivery guy “jokingly” said he wouldn’t even talk to us until we paid our final amount, which World of Spas was well aware we had waiting for them.

After struggling with cloudy water and unbalanced chemicals, we called World of Spas and talked to Terri Ann who didn’t provide any insight. We asked to talk to Ryan and our call was never returned. We ended up going to a different dealership to get our water tested and educated on how to balance our water properly. It was at that time we found out we couldn’t buy filters anywhere for the 2025 model as they are proprietary and hard to come by. We were forced to call World of Spas more than once, spoke to both Terri Ann and Ryan, only to find out there is a shortage of filters, they had none in stock and they suggested we go elsewhere.

We couldn’t find them elsewhere, so called World of Spas again and they were finally in stock (they could have called to tell us, but again failed to provide customer service). We went in and purchased $500 worth of filters since our original ones were ruined from not doing a proper startup. We then spoke to Terri Ann and gave her a list of a few things we were having issues with; one of the jets not working properly, a broken clip and the temperature going above 100 degrees. She wrote them down, said she would talk to someone, get some answers and call us back. Almost 2 months later, we have yet to hear back.

Our experience with World of Spas was brutal. We would not recommend them if you are looking to purchase a swimspa. We have received more information and support from the Master Spa Facebook group than the people we gave over $40,000 to! Crazy!!

We had a flood in our branch costing us $15,000. We were told we had to properly dry the wall and insulation quickly because if any mold formed we would have to remove the entire wall covering and insulation. 2' vent openings were performed on all walls to allow air to enter the walls and dry properly. Upon completion we had another company come in to perform the replacement of drywall and insulation. Upon completion they pointed out the wall right next to the flood source was untouched and mold was forming. I emailed Greg of the error and he said he would stop by Mon/Tues to look. On Monday a Okanagan Employee shows up and without any communication cut out the mold area and sprayed. We are now left with a 1' by 4' opening in the wall. Greg never followed up.
This entire experience was you have to do this or else. I had purchased my own wall moisture tester and found all the walls were within acceptable limits even though they were going to continue to run the fans through the weekend.

We relied on Okanagan Restoration to perform a service for us and in the end they missed the wall next to the flood source. I would expect they would have taken the time to repair the wall instead of just leaving the opening.

Very disappointing and will not use them in the future.

reviews.text:
Having my garage catch fire was one of the worst things that happened to me.

Until Okanagan Resoration showed up.

Sean Petit was impossible to work with.  He rarely, if ever returned my calls, despite emails, leaving voice mails and leaving messages with reception.  He accepted no responsibility for this, and even failed to act when insurance withheld funds from him.  He was full of promises and optimism and I too was optimistic.

I threatened to fire him and eventually my insurance company released him from the contract having waited almost 6, yes SIX months from the date, still waiting for him to send pictures of work completed.

They cleaned my ducts, then tore down all the drywall around the furnace room, contaminating the ducts they had just cleaned.  I had to call them back at 8 at night to close off the room with plastic.  Then the worker shows up without a flashlight to work in a garage in the dark at night, in the winter.

They left 7 blowers at my house for over 2 months, I contemplated selling them to get rid of them.  Their insulation guy showed up to insulate and was asking me questions about how to insulate.  They charged the insurance company for R24 insulation and used R20.

I had to pester them to get firm dates on when they would remove the roll on dumpsters from my driveway.

Cleaning staff was the sharp end of their crew, the remainder were unskilled lackeys who needed supervision in order to not cause further damage to my home.

Okanagan Restoration is not recommended.  You don't have to use whomever the fire department contacts.  Skip these clowns unless you're having a kids party.

Seriously, don't work with them.  Heartbreak will follow.  When Sean left my house for the last time I felt a huge sense of relief.

reviews.author: Debra M
reviews.text:
I hardly ever write negative Google reviews. I usually only focus on doing positive Google reviews, but I think it’s necessary in this case because Service Master caused us a lot of grief. I noticed there are not a lot of reviews on Service Master and the ones that are up there are all good reviews and perhaps they’re great with floods but after the fires and us being out of our house for over nine months with Service Master being the restoration company I need to share my story.

When we first met with Service Master, Robert told us we won’t be happy until you’re happy and I can certainly say that was not the case. I will say that Robert was always good at responding to text messages and questions but everything else was a complete failure.

My neighbours who went through the same fire and had smoke damage were back in their home after two months, but they had used Puroclean Restoration Services I’m not sure when the decision was made and why it was made but my insurance company did switch over to Puroclean this past month and I am going to be back in my house this weekend. The amount of work they did in this short time is amazing and I will review them next.

First, after the initial meeting with the adjuster who was from Saskatchewan and with Robert from Service Master, there was a distinct bad smell in the house so they cleaned our house and cleaned all the furniture but the smell persisted. However, Robert told the insurance company that he didn’t smell it, and since my adjuster had changed to somebody out of Vancouver, they could not come in and they took his word for it, and it was an uphill battle from there, and I had to fight tooth and nail to have more work Done. Robert later confessed that he didn’t have the greatest sense of smell, but I do believe that that was what precipitated the insurance company dragging their feet.

Because of all the delays in getting more work done and honestly Band-Aid solutions I am now in my sixth rental waiting to move back home. I get that the restoration companies also work for insurance but Service Master did nothing to help our case.

In the last month, now with Puroclean all of our furniture was removed and deemed to have smoked damage and was nonrestorable. Why our furniture wasn’t removed by Service Master and tested in the first place to determine if maybe that was part of the culprit of the smell I don’t understand. Also we heard from other people that you need to check your window seals for damage and that your home should’ve been power washed, which wasn’t so now that’s getting done through Puroclean. So why did Servicemaster not make that recommendation as according to everyone I talk to it’s standard.

Also with Service Master, all our clothing was removed to be cleaned and I was told to expect three weeks and it ended up being three months and I understand that I’m sure the laundry places were busy, but I should’ve been given an accurate estimate because we ended up going into the winter with no winter clothes.

These past nine months have been a nightmare and I do believe had we had Puroclean on the job instead of Service master much of this turmoil could be avoided.

reviews.text: On windy days, I could hear the wind blowing through my skylight so I called Archer Roofing to see if they could come and take a look at it.  Pawel came and was really nice to deal with.  He explained in terms I could understand as to what the problem might be.  He didn't try and upsell me on getting a new skylight, in fact he told me that I could probably get a few more years out of the one I had.  He said that he'd probably only have to replace some flashing and a gasket to seal it better, but he would know better once he got the skylight off.  I asked him to give me a quote on replacing the skylight as well as repairing the one I have.  When I received both quotes I decided to go with a new skylight.  When the job was completed, I noticed that all the cardboard and garbage from the job was gone.  He also checked out the rest of my roof and said that it looked good.  I found that dealing with Archer Roofing was a great experience.  Pawel is very pleasant, polite and very knowledgable at his job. I also liked that he takes the time to explain exactly what he is going to do.  I would highly recommend Pawel and Archer Roofing to anyone who is looking to repair their roof or skylights etc.

reviews.text: I needed a few things done on my roof.  Archer roofing was referred by someone in my community. reviews.text: We recently had the pleasure of working with Jaden and Nathan for our house lights. The entire process was incredibly seamless from start to finish, and the lights look amazing! We are very pleased with the final product, which only took about two days to install, as well as the fantastic customer service Nathan and his team provided. They had great attention to detail, which I appreciated. There are no random wires hanging about my house, and they also tucked the interior wires away nicely. I would highly recommend Nathan and his team to do your permanent lights!

reviews.author: Jeff Mills
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with OK Roof Revival. From start to finish, they were exceptionally professional, knowledgeable, and easy to deal with. There was absolutely no sales pressure just a clear, honest assessment and a very detailed, well-prepared quote.

What I really appreciated was the in-person experience. It was refreshing to deal with a real person who took the time to come to my home, walk through everything face to face, and answer questions without rushing or pushing a sale. It was simply straightforward, respectful communication.

I ultimately decided to postpone the work for a year or two, and they were completely understanding and professional about it. That level of candor and respect really stood out. I’ll absolutely be reaching out to OK Roof Revival when the timing is right and would confidently recommend them to anyone looking for honest, professional service.

reviews.author: Chanelle D
reviews.text: Hired OK Roof Revival to clean the moss off my roof. They were the most reasonably priced. They sent me a very extensive proposal with options to choose from. It looked very professional. They did a good job but the only two issues I had: 1) Communication leading up to the appointment. I didn't receive a confirmation so I really wasn't sure if they were coming. So, I reached out to confirm. 2) The gutter on one side of my house was not cleaned. How can I tell? There was a plant growing that was there before and after the gutter cleaning. However, I called them and they came to clean it then took pictures to show me the evidence of the cleaning. What I liked is 1) their presentation and 2) the photos they shared with me on the job after it was done. 3) They also did some asphalt repairs and 4) provided additional recommendation for extending the lifetime of the asphalt. Overall, very good and the most competitive per square inch price for roof cleaning.

reviews.author: Cayla Stiles-Clark
reviews.text:
Came across OK Roof Revival at a local home show in February after experiencing a roof leak (that got worse shortly after the initial interaction). They then came to my house a few weeks later and did a drone over with photos. They presented me with a detail account of my roof's condition and gave me affordable options.

It did then take several weeks for someone to come to the island to do the in person inspection, but that was very reasonable. They were able to schedule my home shortly afterwards for the repair and rejuvenation.

My only issues were with communications and issues with the financing after the repair. After the initial presentation, I kept having to follow up to get a set answer.

And then communications broke down when they had to reschedule the repair (was supposed to a Thursday and rescheduled to Sunday afternoon) I was ok with the reschedule after I rearranged my schedule for the Sunday. Then I received multiple appointment emails the day before (Saturday) kept changing the time on Sunday. While this was going on, a worker showed up on the Saturday to stage the day before the repair was scheduled and we were not home. We really didn't know what was going on. A call later, from Cameron, resolved the confusion.

The repair itself was well done as well as the rejuvenation. They did a beautiful job on my roof. It looks fantastic. They supplied before, during and after pictures.

It did take a few days to get the final invoice cleared up as the wrong financing was set up but it was fixed by their office within a week of the completion of the repair.

All in all, it was a good experience and I would still recommend them over any local roofing company. (and I did have 2 other roofers look at my roof who were useless).

Thank you OK Roof Revival for all that you have done.

reviews.author: Wes Winger
reviews.text: Had a great initial meeting/consultation with the owner. Contracted Ok Roof Revival to Revive and seal the roof.  Only completed the revival not the sealant portion (perhaps miscommunication).  Had all sorts of trouble getting the warranty document (more disclaimers than warrantable items).  Clean up was minimal but the biggest complaint was dealing with the Sales Manager Dan M.  Rude and pompous!!!   If you  contract with them, make sure you take your own before and after pictures!!!!  Cameron (the owner) smoothed things over.  I would deal with Cameron again!!

We quickly learned that he had a solid understanding of our needs and made some great suggestions for combining a modern metal look with cost effective shingles. We’re super happy with the final result! The Osland Team took on our challenging and very old cedar roof (which is a curved a-frame style, so a literal curve ball!) and exceeded our expectations. His crew were very friendly and professional, and were mindful to keep our yard, deck and landscaping neat and tidy after each work day. We have peace of mind knowing it will be leak free for many years to come, and can’t believe how big a difference our new roof makes to the overall appearance of our house! Thank you Osland Roofing!

reviews.text: Pinnacle Roofing recently replaced the asphalt shingles on my roof along with 2 skylights, gutters, downspouts and fascia. I couldn’t be happier with their service. He gave me a contact at their nearby shop and I then spoke with Howard, and indicated that my daughter's home was in urgent need of a new roof and winter was almost here.

He promptly provided a comprehensive quote, addressing our additional needs; exhaust vent, and carport re-roof as well.

I had spoke with a couple of other roofers prior, but their pricing and warranty didn't come close.

The contract was signed and his crew showed up within a couple of days as promised and had both roofs stripped, substrate repairs & ice damming protection done, and re-roof completed within a few days. All construction debris was cleaned up the following day.

All in all, great service at a great price.
Many Thanks to Howard and the Roof Doctor Team!!

reviews.author: Sarah C
reviews.text:
Unprofessional
TL;DR bought a tv 2 weeks ago, Andre’s called me to tell me I was undercharged and owe $1000 or need to bring it back.

Writing this 2 weeks after purchasing my TV. I never leave 1 star reviews but wow if I could leave a 0, I would. Purchased a TV at Andres and had wonderful help in-store. It was my first time getting a new TV of this price point so I had a lot of questions and was directed to a certain model within my budget. Unfortunately they were all sold out of the size that I wanted, and they had one left in the size above but it was the display model. It was a few hundred dollars over my budget, but for a bigger TV and for the high quality I thought why not treat myself. They said I could purchase it but it would take over a week for them to take it down box it up and have a technician bring it to my house in Penticton for install. It wasn’t a problem for me so I paid and waited for install. At the time of writing this the TV has been mounted for a week in my home, so it’s been 2 weeks since I’ve purchased this.

This is when everything goes wrong. I get repeated calls and messages left from a guy named Derek although he doesn’t say where he’s calling from or WHY and callers ID doesn’t say ‘Andres,’ so naturally I don’t answer or call back because I don’t know who this. Then he proceeds to leave me a voice message (finally states where he’s from and why) in a confrontational tone that they sold the TV to me way under value and that they “need the TV back in their inventory or paid for.” Derek said, in an almost threatening tone, Andre himself is willing to come to my house and “get it.” This is extremely unprofessional to threaten to go to a customers house taking back something that has already been paid for! I already gave them a lot of money.

My bf called them back and he is told the TV was undersold by $1000. How does that even happen??? How did no one catch this in the week before the TV was taken down from the store, before it was packed in a box, driven to Penticton, mounted and been in my living room for a week? No apologies from them for THEIR mistake, not even nice about it…they are rude as if it was our fault, and we are treated as if we stole the TV. We have done nothing wrong here. When my bf brought up how unprofessionally this situation has been handled, no accountability or apologies were made, all they care about is their money. We feel like we are being treated as criminals for their mistake. I have never in my life experienced something like this. We chose Andre’s because we like to support local businesses but never again will we step inside an Andre’s.

reviews.author: Greg Jones
reviews.text: Walked in to my local Best Buy, I needed an ink cartridge, USB drive, and a memory card. I also looked at a few stoves as I am in the market. I went to the ink cartridges first, looked everywhere but was not successfully. I walked to the end of the aisle and saw a sales associate, he was working on something so I patiently waited for him to finish, I stood at his 11 o'clock well within his eyeline, once he was done, he stood up and walked away without acknowledging my existence. I was stunned, gathered myself, walked across the store, found another associate who appeared to not be occupied. I asked for assistance finding the ink cartridge, she seemed put out by my request but started walking back to the ink department, she looked, pulled out her phone, looked it up online to tell me the same cartridge I had bought many times in this store was no longer kept in stock. Next, we walked over to the portable storage department, I needed an 8gb or maybe a 16gb USB drive to simply deliver a few hundred pages of documents, nope, had to buy a 64gb, the smallest they offered, fine. It was only $10. Next, I needed a micro class 10 memory card, I had been told I could install a 512gb card in my device although the manufacturer says I can only install a 256gb, I asked the associate for their opinion or advice,  she looked it up online and essentially told me I had to order online, no advice, the shortest way to not continue to assist, I looked in the display, saw a few options for 256gb and 512gb cards, im stunned at this point, sorry i put you out by asking for you to do your job. I quickly took some pictures of the stoves i liked, paid for the USB drive and left. I came home, ordered my $55 ink cartridge from Amazon, ordered my $150 SD card from the manufacturer and will now look up the model number of the stoves i liked and find a retailer locally who may appreciate my $2200+. At what point do these people realize they have jobs because customers purchase items that pay the bills and their pay cheques. Im not a demanding or unreasonable person but im about done with most aspects of brick and mortar businesses. I wasted my time and gas money to try and support my community. I can't wait until Amazon has 30 minute drone delivery.

reviews.author: Jennifer O'Callaghan
reviews.text: NEVER buy appliances from Best Buy. I bought an expensive fridge (approx $9000) and I have NEVER had so many problems with delivery, set up and they even sent me two different handles on each side of fridge!!! Apart from that, I was upsold a Kit to regulate the two different sides and my plumber that I ended up hiring on my own (because the one Best Buy coordinated, never contacted me) and my plumber said I didn’t need that kit. With one last thread of hope I went to my local Best Buy in Kelowna and they wouldn’t return the kit because it was passed 30 days - I didn’t get the fridge delivered even within that time frame but even so, I was hoping they would offer me some grace with how much I spent on the fridge. Anyways I left the product at the store - and left with nothing. I will not buy from Best Buy ever again. And please don’t respond with an auto apology asking me to contact you, I have been on hold once too many times. We are  “Best to Buy” from somewhere else!

reviews.author: Brendan Siemers
reviews.text: Terrible experience ordering a TV from Best Buy online, when buying directly from Best Buy there was no option for in store pick up so I was forced to choose delivery. Then I thought oh no problem they say they'll call me the day before to confirm a time window for delivery. Today is the day before and instead I got an automated message telling me the time. The text also had a link to the delivery services info page that says they will not reschedule. So my options are cancel delivery or reschedule (because apparently you can) and wait for possibly another week so I can actually warn my work I need some time. Best Buy customer service was awesome other than the fact they have no control over any of this except helping me reschedule the day. I understand time windows and could have prepared for this had I known there would be no actual confirmation. The email I was sent said Best Buy would call to narrow the time window, and in the how to prepare section mentions nothing about how I should actually prepare for this. This has been incredibly misleading and makes me want to never buy from Best Buy again.

reviews.author: Antonio Leme
reviews.text:
5 years ago, there was a windstorm in my area, one of many but this time, after hearing a loud bang, I found on the ground one entire piece of trim and the higher siding right below the overhang was lose, and if there was even a breeze, it would bang on the wall which is my bedroom’s wall.  Of course, it was very difficult to sleep with that noise so I called ON SIDE Restorations, the one that subcontracted Conroy Exteriors, to repair the lose siding.
A person from ON SIDE Restorations came to assess the damage and took pictures.  I was later contacted by ON SIDE Restorations to inform that Conroy Exteriors was informed of the occurred damage and asked to do the repair.
I kept waiting and called ON SIDE Restorations several times, each time I was informed that Conroy Exteriors would come to make the repair.
Eventually, I decided to contact Conroy Exteriors.  The person that answered the phone told me that the warranty was expired (5 years, but one year for soffit, which was not what detached from the wall) and I had to pay for them to repair.  I argued that no houses on my neighborhood had any damage and most of them are more than 30 years old.  That’s when the gentleman got angry and started to shout.  So, I told him that in this case I would write a negative review about the job done by Conroy Exteriors.  He got even angrier and I hanged up the phone.
In spite the fact that I’m 70 years old, I decided to repair the damage myself, rented 4 levels of scaffolding, (only 3 levels were required) put everything together with the help of one of my neighbors and repaired the damage properly.
That’s when I found out that the sidings were installed with staples instead of nails, on most of the staples the sidings were broken, sidings were not capable of moving due to expansion, trim on top was glued with a little bit of silicone (that’s why it came out) and there were parts that no sheathing paper was installed underneath the sidings.
I took pictures of the very unprofessional work done.
I do not recommend Conroy Exteriors.

reviews.text:
I do not typically leave negative reviews, but I feel it is important to share my experience so others can make an informed decision. The only reason this is not a 1-star review is because the work was ultimately completed.

Unfortunately, the overall experience was extremely disappointing. Communication throughout the project was disorganized, inconsistent, and at times unclear. Costs and quotes were poorly communicated, which led to unexpected budget increases. Scheduling was similarly chaotic and difficult to follow, creating unnecessary stress and confusion.

We raised our concerns multiple times during the process, but there was little noticeable effort to address or improve the situation. While the final result was delivered, the journey to get there was far more frustrating than it should have been.

Based on our experience, I would advise others to proceed with caution and ensure expectations, timelines, and costs are clearly defined in writing from the outset.
