reviews.author: tarun bhatia
reviews.text:
Worst customer service. They are only there for your money, not for their customers. I had a horrible experience with them.

I needed to place a large order of sheets, which was a special order coming from another city. The quote mentioned a 3–5 day lead time, but I did not receive my order for over two weeks. During this entire time, I had to call them myself—they never once contacted me. When I did call after 3–4 days, they didn’t sound happy about me following up.

When my order finally arrived, I realized I had ordered the wrong type of sheets. I accept that this was my fault, as I did not carefully review the fine print in the quote. Not to mention my sheets were not cut properly either. I contacted them to ask what my options were. The employee (Keith) told me to call back later, but he never returned my call.

I then went to the store to express my concerns and explain that I did not understand the difference between sheet grades, and no one had explained it to me either—again, I acknowledge this was my responsibility. To my complete surprise, the employee ( Keith) told me to “get the hell out of the store.” When I said, “I’m sorry is this how you talk to your customers?,” he replied, “Yeah, get out. This is Canada, and I don’t want to deal with  customers like you.”

Also he did call me back apologizing about how he behaved but it’s still not cool.

Never ever going there again. Always had a very good experience with metal supermarket even with very small orders.

Randy was our first contact and made everything easy to understand right from the start. Garry provided a clear, fair, and detailed quote with zero pressure — exactly what you want.

The installation by Jarrett, and his crew, was exceptional. His workmanship, attention to detail, and respect for the home stood out immediately. My dad was extremely impressed with the quality of his work.

Scott handled the billing side and kept everything simple, organized, and transparent.

From start to finish, Adera Windows & Doors delivered professional, friendly, and top-quality service. The referral we received was 100% right — and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Adera to anyone needing new windows or doors.

Highly recommended.

The entire team was outstanding. Scott, Colin, Ethan, Jarrett H, and Jarret V were professional, hardworking, respectful of our home, and clearly took pride in their work. Communication was great throughout, and the quality of the install exceeded our expectations.

We wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for window replacement - reliable, efficient, and truly exceptional service.

reviews.author: Sylvia Thompson
reviews.text: I live in a new build where Starline installed all the windows and sliding glass doors. I have had nothing but problems when we get a cold snap. The windows and doors freeze up and then thaw and ruin the baseboard and window ledges. Unsatisfactory installation and workmanship from the get go. Fortunately the strata has stepped up and had to hire an independent contractor to fix it before the home owner warranty expires but this experience has left me questioning whether i would ever use them again. I'm sure other owners feel the same. Not to mention all the sliding doors in the complex are installed upside down or backwards whichever way you want to look at it.

reviews.author: Charrie fichter
reviews.text: In 2022 we started our process of getting starline windows installed in our house. Last April we ordered our last 4 windows in the back and had starline install them so they are not even a year old yet. The other day my husband went to open our bedroom window and there was a crack from under the frame accross our window. Immediately I called starline windows and said our window is not even a year old that you installed and it looks like a manufacturing issue. We were told we have 10 year warrenty on windows when we purchased them. I sent them the pictures I have shown in this review and I get an email back saying broken glass is not covered, your house settling could have broke it? I’m like our bedroom is upstairs , house 1985 I’m sure it’s done settling and it’s on the window slider glass, Who knows what caused this but it was not us! I said this window is not even a year old ,they said too bad glass breaks and sent me an estimate of over 300 to fix. I phoned head office and they sent me to a gentleman who was supposed to be a manager of Kelowna branch who was not kind and did not care wondered what I wanted him to do about it?  you can send me the pictures don’t get your hopes up , then no response lol. They didn’t even send anyone out to look or nothing! Horrible customer service from everyone I dealt with at starline. I ended up getting a local glass company to order the glass and they will be installing it within the week . There was no way I was giving starline anymore more of our money.The glass company was surprised that the crack they saw in a window that was not even a year old would not be covered by the company and said they will not recommend starline to any of their customers. Now I’m stuck with my whole house done in these Windows , there warrenty pages are misleading and they just don’t give a crap obviously about there consumers that spend a lot of money on their windows. I do not recommend starline windows to anyone. Read your warrenty very closely and whatever is confusing ask about it and get it in writing. They said whatever we wanted to hear to sell us their windows .

reviews.author: Jenna Roze
reviews.text: Our contractor ordered us a couple of these windows for our addition a couple of years ago. Called to ask about warranty as we found a small crack in one of our windows. No apology or anything just told us that they don’t warranty their glass apparently. Go with Milguard who offers a lifetime warranty on their glass and seals.

What truly set the experience apart was the installation team. They were prompt, courteous, and clearly experienced. They worked efficiently while ensuring everything was perfectly aligned and sealed. The clean-up afterward was spotless, and they took the time to explain care and maintenance clearly.

We have used Starline in the past,  and will continue to do so for every door and window job. Highly recommend both the product and the team behind it!

Rutland Glass has been doing their repairs because they refuse to repair their own work but there are over 400 folks waiting (many of whom are owners of star line windows). I did find a few miniscule bubbles that set off my OCD but he remedied it immediately.

This happens when pressing out wet tint.

You need to give the tint time to cure and if you notice any bubbles that formed around the edges simply press them out with a solid non sharp object like a credit card.

I had realistic expectations and they were exceeded.

Thanks Darcy.

As a great example, we had one piece of glass on a very expensive window order that came damaged on the inside pane (3 pane windows). TJ was all over this, and did what he had to do in order to get us a third piece of glass. Update- that being said, after being in the house for 2 years, we still have scratches on multiple windows that have not been addressed so would be hesitant to use them again. We were told the scratches were between the two panels of glass so nothing could be done about it. Adhesive was also left on most of the interior window frames/sliding doors that we have tried to clean/remove using multiple products and will still not come off. The sliding doors are also very drafty- so not efficient in either summer nor winter. We’ve seen many other products and installs since then that are much better.

From my initial call to the final handshake, my experience with Lakeland Electric was nothing short of phenomenal. In the world of electrical services, it's a breath of fresh air to find a company that genuinely stands out for its excellence, and Lakeland does precisely that.

**Customer Service:** The Lakeland team exemplifies professionalism and courtesy. Scheduling an appointment was a breeze, thanks to their accommodating and flexible approach.

**Punctuality:** The technicians from Lakeland respect the value of time — both theirs and ours. They arrived right on schedule, fully prepared for the task at hand. It's clear that they prioritize efficiency and punctuality, which greatly minimized any disruption to my daily routine.

**Expertise:** What impressed me the most was the level of expertise displayed by the Lakeland technicians. They carried out a thorough inspection, explained the issues in understandable terms, and offered practical solutions. Their knowledge and proficiency not only solved my immediate electrical problems but also instilled confidence in their workmanship.

**Quality of Work:** The quality of work delivered by Lakeland is exceptional. They addressed all electrical issues with utmost precision and attention to detail, ensuring everything was up to code. The team used high-quality materials and the latest techniques, leaving me with lasting solutions rather than temporary fixes.

The first time we hired Lakeland was for a small job, yet they made us feel like it was a priority. Jeff also made us all laugh when he had to run to get a part and said “I’ll be back in a Jeffy.”

reviews.author: Lake Life
reviews.text: As a consumer you have choice - beware of this business.  We've worked with a large number of contractors and Lakeland Electric has to be the worst.  Our experience...  Lakeland Electric rewired our <1000 ft 1-bedroom basement suite including a new electrical panel (cost was over $10k).  The initial estimate provided was extremely vague so if you decide to go this route be sure to have every little detail of work to be completed written down (or you'll regret it later).  Be prepared to chase these guys to try and get the job finished and to deal with Bruce who as an added bonus is generally rude and unpleasant to deal with.   At one point we asked for the music to be turned down as I was working upstairs trying to participate on Zoom calls; we subsequently received an email from Bruce indicating 'construction is noisy' - the next week we listened to loud rap music (f-bombs and all) compliments of the electricians working downstairs (music was so loud and wonderful that our neighbors called to ask us to turn down our music). Yup construction is noisy.  The final straw was the install of a couple of under cabinet lights - the wiring was already completed by Lakeland Electric as part of the rewiring for the basement suite,  we were  told install of these lights are not included in the quote (yet the wiring for the under cabinet lights was completed...) and that we need to supply the under cabinet lights; we purchase under cabinet lights, then told they are the wrong ones.  I think we must have lost our minds at this point, as we then asked Lakeland Electric to supply and install the correct type of under cabinet lights (2 small pot lights) - Charged $355.10.

I want to say that overall Okanagan South Campground is nice but please read the description of each site. We arrived to find that site S-74 was not "camping" per se; more like camping on the edge of a parking lot. The images on the BC Parks website are somewhat misleading as the don't portray the fact that some of the sites are only separated by concrete parking barriers so privacy is minimal at best (though described as average on the website).  We walked through the rest of the camp ground and were amazed by most of the sites (just not the row we were in).

We graciously requested a refund because if we had seen pictures that were more representative, we would not have booked this site; however, BC Parks informed us we would have to talk to the private contractor, Kaloya Contracting.

We understood that cancelling a site because we did not like it was not an acceptable reason; HOWEVER, Kayola graciously REFUNDED us 50% of our booking!  We are so grateful and amazed by this generosity and customer service (which is rare these days).

I do recommend this campground as it is very well maintained, very clean, great amenities and on Okanagan Lake. And I highly recommend the services of Kaloya and their team.

Hired this company in April 2022. Was told 10-12 weeks to have kitchen installed. Constant excuses, delays, cancellations. They will come in for a few hours, do a bit of work and then leave saying they will finish or address concerns “next time”. We never knew when next time would be. Unless we called or emailed to follow up they would never reach out to us. After 9 months we still did have a completed kitchen.
Workmanship is poor to say the least. Cabinets and shelves are bowing, pullouts don’t work, panels aren’t secure, trim is crooked, pieces are missing, hinges are twisted, these are just some of the issues we are left with.
I would rate zero if that was an option.

reviews.text:

Things need to be put right but we keep getting told that they are busy and a reply never comes. I ended up having to do the warranty work myself. Definitely do not recommend.
In response to the delinquent account, we held back money from final payment because your fitter bodged the trim work and couldn't be bothered to mitre the joints. One fitter did turn up one day but didn't know what he was here to fix and didn't bring anything to fix it with. Total shambles.

reviews.author: Philippe Lesage
reviews.text: In September 2025, we decided to renovate our house in Penticton. On October 4th, we went to the home show at the Penticton convention center, where we met Neil from the Wood Labs. A few days later, he came home to discuss our kitchen renovations. In the same week, he send us a draft of our project with different options, advices and cost estimates. After we settle on the project, Connor and him came back home for us to validate the color and material to be used, before starting the production. On November 25th, Neil and Connor did the install. We saw them working, they arrived at 8 and worked steadily and methodically all day to get the kitchen perfectly installed. Seing them worked, we know that for them it is not just a job, they are knowledgeable and passionate which bring them to deliver the best cabinets possible. We are very happy to have met them and we are sure we could not have get a better kitchen that the one they build for us. On the price side, for sure it is more expensive that an IKEA Kitchen, but not that much. Each component is custom fit to maximize the use of your space, and you do not have to install it yourself and everything is adjusted perfectly. Thank you Neil and Connor, and we will recommend others to do business with you anytime

reviews.author: Indra McMorran
reviews.text:
We were stopped by first thing in the morning looking for local fresh early-season strawberries. We were greeted by a friendly younger man and his mother, who offered to go pick our strawberries fresh from their fields if we could wait a few minutes. While waiting, we strolled through their plant nursery, and I was pleasantly surprised at what a nice selection of healthy perennials they had at reasonable prices. They also had some huge stunning hanging flower baskets. We ended up leaving with a few plants in addition to the strawberries we came for.

Once they picked us a flat of strawberries, the mother rinsed us a smaller container to eat fresh on our drive. The whole experience of stopping by was above and beyond what we expected. The family was so friendly and welcoming; their products were high quality and had competitive prices.

We also got strawberries from two other fruit stands down the road, but the ones from this stand were hands down the most flavourful and sweet.

We will be back!

reviews.text: Great location and proximity to wine tours etc. Men's showers were gross. Women's were okay. Common area nice but pool would have been better, given it's the OK and too hot to just sit in the sun. Dont put ANYTHING on the grass (including tents, tarps, camping carpets) or you will get yelled at. Otherwise, not bad. For us it was all about location...if you're reading between the lines, it means we spent a lot of time OFF site. Wifi can be spotty. Also way too many people with random wandering dogs off leash.

reviews.text: Great staff! Very helpful and accommodating through booking process. Quiet spaces there and well maintained sites with privacy! And they love dogs!

reviews.author: Graeme Lister
reviews.text: We checked in for a 6 night stay recently. At check in no one mentioned the town water supply was on boil alert. We pull a 38’ fifth wheel and the corner to get to the rv sites was so tight we were a few inches from rubbing the wall, others obviously had. Our site was also very tight to get into and certainly not as picturesque as the online photos suggest. PS there is no pool. The bathrooms were so so as far as clean, and the men’s room smelled musty. The laundry machines were dirty so we put iff doing laundry until the next stop. We left a day early for a nicer rv park.

reviews.author: Charlie Shearer
reviews.text: Our overall motel stay was pleasant. The room had been recently renovated and the bed was comfy. Towels and linens were clean and soft. The bathroom was small, but it had everything you needed. Self check-in was smooth, but I wonder how frequently door codes are changed. Cleanliness is the reason for 3 stars. Although the place appeared clean on first inspection, a number of issues began to pop up throughout our stay. The floors had been swept, but not mopped; our feet turned black within a few steps of walking on the floor barefoot. The tea kettle was filled with limescale and the coffee machine contained residual coffee from a previous occupant. We did end up utilizing the newly renovated outside seating area, but many of the seats were covered In dust and debris.

reviews.text: I will say that the work that was done was of quality. The reason that I will steer clear if at all possible was the conversations with my insurance underwriters and the non transparency with all of it causing them to dismiss 2/3 of my claim. Sunrise convinced me to go ahead with the first portion telling me all the rest would get taken care of. Needless to say this did not happen. My daughters bedroom was a total disaster no floor, no doors and holes in the wall for over 6 months. The leaking shower valve had caused grout to crack in the shower. Now I’m stuck with a useless shower that needs to be replaced. Both the insurance company and sunrise realize there is no recourse for a homeowner in these situations.I felt completely unsupported by sunrise and would highly recommend using someone else. The only benefit is they are local.

A big shout-out to Mel, Chris, Ethel, Brett and Rob. Thank you all for your exceptional service.

reviews.author: D. Kim Smith
reviews.text: Polo and his team built us a custom tiled walk-in shower, replaced our aging carpet, installed new vinyl flooring and baseboards, and updated our fireplace tiling.  After an enthusiastic recommendation from friends who had contracted with Underfoot Flooring, we began the process at their showroom in Oliver and received excellent service to select the flooring.  We were picky and they worked with us until we finalized what we wanted, never pressuring us and always giving us the information that we needed to make informed selections.  We worked out an on-site assessment of the project.  They then provided us with a detailed cost estimate and were patient with us when we wanted to make some changes during the installation.  Polo's teams were excellent.  These installers (flooring and tiling) minimized the disruptions, adapted to "discoveries" under the existing flooring, kept the rest of the house clean as they worked, and were professional and friendly.  Polo kept us informed throughout the project.  The results were even better than we could have expected.  Polo conducted an inspection of the completed work before the bill was presented and it reflected the original estimate and any changes we had requested during the project.  Our experience with Underfoot Flooring was excellent and we would recommend Polo and his teams unreservedly.  It was nice to have a business from Oliver provide us great and seamless service in Midway.

reviews.author: Damaris Kazor
reviews.text:
Pristinley manicured campground 10min outside the town of Oliver with an upper and lower section. The lower section is on a little lake and often busier. All are wonderfully shaded by pine trees and there is a lovely little pub across the street as well 😁 (The Flealess Hound).
Not your cheapest camping but you get what you pay for, and customer service is outstanding! Also worth mentioning: free showers, gas tank exchange program on site, very level and accessible, many with power/sewer, some only power, also offers cabins, just off the highway (so a bit noisy), WiFi can get poor when everyone is on devices, only minutes to District Village (must visit) and as many wineries as you can handle! Book a chauffeur or go with a wine bus, so much to taste

reviews.author: Liubov Kokonina
reviews.text: We stayed at Gallagher Lake | A Parkbridge Camping & RV Resort and really enjoyed it! Everything was peaceful and quiet, with a beautiful lake nearby. The roads inside the campground are paved, and the sites are nice and convenient, although a bit close to each other. The washrooms and showers were clean, and there’s also a laundry. Lots of activities are available, including a playground for kids. The only downside was that overnight some sap dripped from the pine trees onto our car and tent. Other than that, it’s a great place to stay!

reviews.author: Edie Hogarth
reviews.text:
Hebig Bros came highly recommended by Osoyoos Aggregates, to do my intricate custom residential job to address mobility and health issues in 2019. After nineteen (19) emails and an estimate written up by Daryl Hebig in June 2021, several promises were made to come out to site, but no one showed up. Excuses and a couple of apologies were made. I'm a patient and understanding person, but what has transpired is unprofessional and can't be ignored.

Phone calls could not go through as mailbox was always full.

In mid October 2022, I finally reached Daryl by phone, stating that I had simplified my project, and he told me to call him back in a couple of hours as he had to review my estimate. I called back, as requested, only to be greeted with a full mailbox, again. I re-sent my 'revisions' via email, but never heard from Daryl.

A courtesy call to say Hebig Bros was no longer interested in my job would have been the 'right' thing to do - back in 2021. I even asked if I should look for another concrete finisher, to which I received no response. I believed Hebig Bros was still going to go forward with my job, right up to October 13, 2022. Ghosting 'potential' clients and leading them on is not an acceptable business practice, especially for health-related projects - whatever their size/complexity.

For large commercial jobs, this company seems to jump at those; forget the smaller residential ones. Hebig Bros. claim that 'no job is too small!' and I beg to differ.

Don't waste your time trying to communicate with this 'silent,' busy company. Budgeting and/or moving your savings around while truly believing your job is next in line during these economic times is a serious mistake - you'll only end up disappointed and without a concrete finisher.

reviews.author: Marc van der Veen
reviews.text:
Over the Fence Winery: A Warm Welcome and Instant Enjoyment!
We recently had the pleasure of visiting the young Over the Fence Winery in the Okanagan Valley, and we are absolutely thrilled! What a fantastic winery.
We received an incredibly warm welcome. It immediately felt friendly and relaxed, which is exactly what you want from a young, ambitious winery. The atmosphere is perfect for enjoying their creations in peace.
Excellent, Ready-to-Drink Wines
Not only was the welcome outstanding, but the wines themselves are also of very high quality and a true delight. What struck us most is that the wines are delicious and ready to drink immediately—perfect for anyone who doesn't want to wait for cellar aging!
The Gewürztraminer was truly excellent; a beautifully aromatic and refined wine. I really take my hat off to the winemaker!
Furthermore, the red wine, the Hey Neighbour 2021, was perfectly ready to drink. We’ve already set one aside and are very much looking forward to savoring it this evening in combination with a delicious pasta. A superb choice for a cozy night!
We wish this young winery great success with their venture and will definitely be back to taste what the next harvest brings. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Donald Mundrick
reviews.text: We were looking for a reliable local company to replace our flooring.  We got a quote from a company in Penticton, but all we got was "we don't do this, we don't do that".  And they acted like they were doing us a favor.  So we put it on hold.  Was going to call the guy in Oliver who advertises on the radio all the time.  However, I was talking to another person in our building who said that they got their floors done by Rudy's in Osoyoos.  Their floors looked fantastic, so we called Larry (the original Rudy's son).  He came down, took the measurements, confirmed our choices for luxury vinyl plank and upgraded Berber carpet.  He gave us a quote in a couple of days, which was very reasonable.  Much more reasonable than Penticton.  Less than a week later, he called and asked if he could start.  We were overjoyed.  The vinyl plank was a bit tricky as it had to be installed over existing ceramic tile.  The installer was very knowledgeable and friendly.  The install went Super Smooth, and the plank looks awesome!  Next came the carpet.  Tricky because we have some heavy bedroom furniture.  They helped us move the furniture and went to work.  Again, the workmanship is fantastic!  All this, and he was significantly less expensive than our Penticton quote.  About 30% less.  We can't recommend Larry and his crew highly enough.  Very professional, very friendly and easy to work with!

reviews.author: markie vanderlinden

At that time the owner of the business told me it would most likely be done in " a week or 2".I waited and waited and waited with no follow up whatsoever. Any time there was any communication between us it was at my behest. This went on for 7 weeks. His lack of professionalism and honesty was unbelievable. I was told the reason for the delay was due to his employees vehicle etc. In the end, the product I wanted was not even ordered...after waiting for 7 weeks. My only regret is not pulling the plug on him sooner than I did. Do yourself a big favour and give Rudy's Flooring a miss. I went with a reputable company in Penticton and haven't looked back.

I called Dave at Anarchist Mountain Air Conditioning and Refrigeration, when it was 34 degrees...going into a long weekend and my A/C stopped blowing cold! Everyone’s nightmare!

Dave picked up the phone at 6pm at night (personally) and was at my place by 7pm to assess and determine a plan. Followed up with a detailed email and photos of what the problem was and suggested parts that would be required to repair.

Said he would order for 8am the following day. He did so and followed up with some bad news, that fan motor was 3-4 weeks out given a US supply. What would next steps be?
He was able to find an alternative solution to modify another fan motor to get us back up and running as soon as possible.

With my approval, he ordered those parts, which arrived by 1pm the following day from Kelowna.

He then called me at 12:30 once parts arrived and was back at my place to install and repair by 1:00pm. All was repaired and we were back up and running by 5pm.
He also was considerate enough to take down the portable A/C units I had put up in short term and stored them exactly where we wanted them.

Dave was a pleasure to deal with all the way through this process. He is a very good communicator, with descriptors and details that we all would understand.

We all want Service Technicians (in any industry) who will take our calls when we are “in need”, respond in a timely fashion, communicate with/to us and with a sense of urgency and some level of attention to detail.
Finally, provide a solution.

Dave was all of this and more!

I would highly recommend him for all your A/C needs. In fact, I already have to friends and family!

He will be the first person I call for A/C repair and maintenance going forward.

Chad McGregor

reviews.author: Carmen Weld
reviews.text:
My recent visit to the Osoyoos Desert Centre was a truly profound and enriching experience, standing out not only for its natural beauty but for its deep commitment to sharing the history and cultural knowledge of the land.

While the unique ecology of Canada’s desert is stunning, the true power of the Centre lies in its interpretive focus on the Syilx Okanagan Nation and the Osoyoos Indian Band. The exhibits and the guided tour seamlessly integrate the history of the land's original stewards, providing a powerful perspective on traditional practices, resource management, and conservation philosophy.

Our guide Jenna was phenomenal—not only an expert on the flora and fauna, but a wonderful storyteller who brought the centuries-old history of the Okanagan  territory to life. The tour was much more than a biological walk; it was a lesson in Indigenous land connection, resilience, and stewardship, beautifully narrated through the context of the desert ecosystem.

The kilometer-long elevated boardwalk is a thoughtfully designed pathway that allows visitors to traverse this fragile environment respectfully. Every step and every interpretive moment reinforces the fact that this land is not just a biological curiosity, but a crucial historical and cultural site.

If you want an experience that goes far beyond typical nature education, one that is respectful, and deeply moving in its historical and Indigenous context, this is absolutely an essential stop.

reviews.text: We used West Side Curb Appeal for a number of renovations in our home. They did an excellent job enlarging our deck. It entailed plumbing, tiling, electrical, woodworking, etc. The work was extremely professionally done and in a timely fashion.  They enhanced our front hallway and down the stairs to give it a show home like appearance.  They installed an acoustic wall in our media room enhancing the sound quality dramatically. West Side Curb Appeal were very professional and thorough throughout all of this work. We highly recommend them for any and all of your needs. Give Chris or Denise a call, you won’t be disappointed.

We fully recommend Westside Curb Appeal. It has been a very satisfactory experience having them improve our home.

reviews.author: Victorio Mangalindan
reviews.text: Chris and his team did an excellent job in our recent home renovation. They addressed our concerns professionally.  They finished way ahead of the committed time schedule. I will definitely recommend Westside Curb Appeal Inc to my friends.

reviews.author: Tiffany Sundstrom
reviews.text:
We first met Chris & Denise almost 20 years ago and watched them grow their incredible local business!
2 years ago we had them build a brand new deck for us and we were so happy to finally enjoy that space. (It was 20 years old and very tired)
We talked about a house reno at that time but we weren’t quite ready. We engaged them again this past summer and I can’t believe all that has transpired. They took our ideas and within one month we had a big beautiful shed built that completed our yard and is so functional for firewood, storage, gardening tools etc.
We were so impressed and overwhelmingly happy, We decided to jump in with both feet and start our house reno so September of 2024 we began…
We weren’t clear on what we wanted exactly but after one meeting with Denise, she took our ideas and came up with the most incredible timeless designs for us and we fell in love.
They replaced all flooring, lighting, kitchen cabinets, hardware, railings, paint, toilets and doors, added a new kitchen,  fireplace and feature wall etc. we even had them knock out a huge wall which opened up our kitchen to the dining room. Denise was so organized, always knew what needed to be done and when! She checked in weekly always making sure we were all on the same page and answered any questions.
I can honestly say, not once did we ever feel stressed through this process. We trusted them with every step and I’m so thankful we did. Our home was completed the exact week they said it would be (I hear that’s rare)
They followed our budget (we added a ton throughout the process as things were going so well we couldn’t resist) and we always felt there was open and clear communication. Chris is an extremely detail oriented and Conscientious business owner, we had no doubts everything would be perfect for us! Less than 10 weeks later we moved back into our dream home!
Thank you thank you Westside Curb Appeal
(Chris & Denise) and team!
They went above and beyond to transform our home and make it our sanctuary!
I highly recommend them to complete any  vision/project you may have! We’ve since had them back for smaller projects and they get it perfect every time…
Best team ever!!!

reviews.author: Robert Law
reviews.text: We just finished purchasing a Electric Stair Chair and having installed by Kirkwood Elevator. The whole process was made so easy by dealing with their pleasent and polite staff. Thumbs up for Kirkland Elevator and their staff.

reviews.author: Chris Davis
reviews.text:
Kirkwood Elevators is simply an amazing company.

My project was to install a wheelchair lift (elevator) on my house.  Their staff is extremely helpful and knowledgeable and very pleasant to deal with.  The owners of the business themselves even answer the phone and willingly spend time discussing your needs, answering questions, and being very helpful in offering useful advice.  The conversations were never hurried and never felt rushed.

They were extremely patient in our dealings as I faced significant delays in this project that were not their fault.  They never once pressured me to ‘get on with it’.

They matched or even more than matched the prices of dealers in my local area, including the installation, and I am definitely not local to them.  Even early on I got the best impression from them which is why I chose them over local companies.

Now for the negatives.
There are none.  I’m trying, but I can’t think of a single time where I experienced any situation where I got a bad feeling dealing with them over the last two years.

I strongly recommend giving this company a call, even if you are not local to their area.  They were willing to travel hundreds of kilometres each way to install the lift on my house.

Thanks Kirkwood Elevators you guys are awesome.

reviews.author: Lee Harrell
reviews.text:
Sept 2024 - My wife and I decided we wanted a feature wall in our home. We roughly narrowed down the kind of look we wanted to achieve. I was hoping to keep things local (I live in Peachland) and stumbled across his company (using google reviews). Marius was so responsive from the get go. We had an initial conversation on the phone and he stopped by shortly after with samples in hand. He explained in detail all the steps and exactly how this project would come together. I love this because I’m a details man. We looked for assurances along the way (are you sure we’ve picked the right tile? etc) and he held our hands throughout. Our wall and fireplace was a relatively small job but I still assumed it would take several days. He arrived on Friday morning at 7:30am and did not leave until 7:30pm! I’m sorry folks but in this day and age and especially in this area, I think this is a rarity! My wife and I were so impressed. They came back early Saturday morning and completed the job (when I say “they”, big shout out to Robert, Marius’ team mate). We absolutely love it! It looks amazing and has completely transformed the look and feeling in the room. We think it makes the room feel bigger and several people have made the same comment. Thank you so much Marius and Robert, outstanding!!

Oct 2025 - my wife and I decided to remove some carpet on our stairs and master bedroom floor, so i once again engaged my main man Marius! It's hard for me to fully express my gratitude and really don't have the words to sum up how good this Company is! Meticulous planning, a detailed quote, summarized EXACTLY how i asked for it to be laid out. Very fair pricing. Someone that truly takes pride in his craftmanship and absolute care in everything he does! 12 out of 10! Thank you!!

reviews.author: Z Baja

reviews.author: Alia Nicholson
reviews.text: Really really sad and disappointed in my experience with this company. We had an employee come out and provide us a quote, we explained we are selling our house and there are some spots in the floor that need to be replaced. We were quoted $500 for about a day of work (they wouldn’t quote by the hour) which we thought was a bit pricey for what we needed. We got a second quote by another business who quoted the same (who clearly confirmed our expectations) so we figured we would go with these guys as we reached out to them first and they had availability to do it right away, which was great (assuming there understanding was the same as the other business' quote was the same and our expectations seemed obvious). There were two employees at the house for all of 2 hours (which totals $125 per hour) we provided lots of extra flooring to have the problem areas fixed. They did not do a walk through after they were done and literally left 90% of the affected flooring still there. They’re saying this was our communication error. When explaining to someone you need to get the flooring done as you’re selling the home you would expect them to AT LEAST communicate with you in regards to your expectation (which I assumed was very clear considering we’re selling, there’s ample flooring and the $500 cost to do it). When we reached out to try and solve the problem they said they couldn’t justify coming back when it was our fault and that we would have to pay more, we ultimately declined because they already gauged us once. Poor communication, quality, customer care and relationships. I feel if I was a man this never would have happened, it's really sad to be treated so poorly and to get ripped off...avoid feeling this way and just go somewhere else.

reviews.author: Sara Nicholson
reviews.text:
Dylan and Noah quoted us $500 for a full day of work to repair three problem spots in our flooring. After only two hours, they said the job was complete — which immediately raised concerns, since they had originally told us it would take all day, and every other company we received quotes from said the same.
While they did replace the three damaged boards, nothing in between was addressed, and the floors were left looking unfinished and poorly blended. The final result did not reflect what was promised or what we reasonably expected based on their quote.
They also never did a proper walk-through with us once the job was supposedly finished. When we raised concerns and asked them to correct the issues, they argued with us, ignored our messages, and eventually tried to charge us additional money to come back and fix their own work.
At that point, we decided not to continue working with them and had to hire another company to properly complete and fix the job, which cost us additional time and money.
Overall, the workmanship, professionalism, and communication were extremely disappointing. I would not recommend them.

reviews.text: This company is amazing! I had called 3 AC companies they were the only one that called me back and promptly after leaving a message. He knew how everything worked and explained how to maintain everything. We also have climate control in different rooms, he explained it all. He checked out our utility room, and gave us advise and recommendations for other good service companies to use for our in floor heating system and water on demand. Also something worth noting is my 82 year old mother also lives at this property and was talking a mile a minute asking him so many questions, he was so patient with her and definitely has respect for technically challenged  seniors.  Would definitely use him again. Not to mention it was 38C out and he was working in the sun on our AC unit. Just the greatest service! Highly recommend this company. Conner your the best! reviews.author: Hilary Mercier
reviews.text: Absolutely breathtaking property and so immaculately maintained! I wished we had booked a longer stay. The pool, hot tub and landscaping were unreal, not to mention the 180 degree view of the lake! The room was very clean and spacious with many amenities provided. We will be back for sure! Thanks Chris and Sheila for your hospitality!

reviews.author: Adrian
reviews.text: Amazing accommodation with an incredible view. Okanagan Oasis offers three rooms with all the amenities to stay comfortably. A common lounge with fridge, freezer, toaster and necessities as well as a BBQ available for each room. There is a well maintained pool and hot tub along with ample seating on the patio deck. Chris and Sheila are amazing hosts and recommended a number of local attractions. I would highly recommend staying at Okanagan Oasis.

reviews.author: Karman Tittemore
reviews.text:
We have been coming here for 3 years in a row. My husband surprised me with a 3-night stay here the first year for a special birthday, and we’ve been coming here every year since, with each stay being longer and longer. I think next year we will try to stay one week.

Chris and Sheila are excellent hosts and staying here is like staying with friends! The property is stunning and super well kept. Stunning landscaping, with plenty of chairs around the property to read a book, relax, or enjoy the view. There are so many amenities - each of the 3 guest rooms has their own outdoor grill, own mini fridge, drinking glasses, cutlery and plates (normally in the guest kitchenette but stores separately for each room due to COVID). There’s a large fridge, Keurig coffee machine, knife block in the common kitchenette. In a normal year there’s also a guest lounge with DVDs and games plus laundry available but these were temporarily closed down for COVID. There is a large pool and hot tub. The breakfasts are to die for (Chris is an excellent chef) but there are some changes coming soon next year to how breakfasts are done so we are eagerly awaiting the updates for our stay next year!

We have stayed in the Oasis room twice and Twig room once. The Oasis room has been recently remodeled and very modern. The Twig room has a super large bathroom with plenty of shelf and counter space. I like both for different reasons but there’s definitely not a bad choice between the 3 available rooms.

The house is on a quiet road, we never hear any traffic and is only a few minutes drive to the main town. Great base for many activities: visiting wineries, there are a few hiking trails nearby, Zipzone is a few minutes away, easy drive to Penticton and Kelowna while being a bit further away from the crowds.

We absolutely love it here and seldom return to the same places when traveling - this has been our only exception to date! Thank you Chris and Sheila for always looking after us!

reviews.text: Love, love, love the Poolside Retreat.  We have stayed every summer for the better part of the last decade with our kids and couldn't ask for anything better in the area.  The carriage house accommodation is fantastic for a family - two bedrooms, full sized kitchen & eating area, two sitting areas, bathroom with full sized washer and dryer and covered outside eating area with BBQ.  All of that is yours exclusively plus there's a pool to share with other guests and green space / games area for badminton!  Ray are amazing hosts - always available while giving you your privacy.  Incredible overall experience.  Highly recommend as long as you don't book the weeks we like to stay :)

reviews.author: J Gase
reviews.text:
We have been booking the Poolside Cottage every spring for some years now. Its central location in the Okanagan Valley makes it a perfect home base for our hiking pursuits.
The amenities inside the cottage ensure a comfortable stay-at-home experience when taking a day off from activities, or riding out a bit of weather.
The neighborhood is quiet, and taking a walk through the residential/pastoral streets in the mornings or evenings is a pure joy.
The owners are accessible for help whenever needed, while communication with them is prompt and professional. Full privacy is given otherwise.
The property has a large games/play area for kids, and the cottage has books, games and puzzles as well. A collection of maps, local visitor guide maps and brochures will offer activity ideas when running out of things to do.
As for vineyards, Peachland has only Hainle at this time, but Lake Country, Okanagan Falls and Naramata (and everything in between) can be reached in less than an hour.

reviews.text: Simply the best! Jennifer is knowledgeable, caring, intuitive and gifted. My wife and I have experienced extremely positive outcomes. Jen is the expert in lymphatic drainage. reviews.author: Keely Portsmouth
reviews.text:
Ninety minutes of slow, healing bliss. The space is beautiful, tucked right here in Peachland, so it’s incredibly convenient with no commute at all. Jennifer is extremely knowledgeable and brings a depth of experience that shows in every session. She assesses you each appointment, explains what she’s doing and why, and gives simple at-home exercises to keep the progress going.

I sit at a desk all day and deal with a tight neck and back, and her MLD work has been exactly what I needed—MLD focuses on the fascia and lymph system with gentle, rhythmic techniques that reduce swelling and encourage proper flow, which often creates longer-lasting relief than pushing directly into muscle like a deep tissue massage. It’s calming, de-puffing, and restorative rather than intense, and for me it’s very effective. I even did a session before flying overseas—my jet lag was noticeably easier, and somehow everyone else caught a virus except me.

Highly recommend Jennifer if you’re looking for thoughtful, effective care.

reviews.author: Britney Stewart
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Jen highly enough! Her expertise in Manual Lymphatic Drainage (MLD), combined with visceral work and Pilates, has truly transformed my body and overall well-being.

When I first came to her, I was struggling with poor posture, chronic tension, inflammation and gut issues. Through her thoughtful and personalized approach, she helped me understand the root causes and supported me every step of the way. The MLD sessions are incredibly gentle yet powerful, and I always leave feeling lighter and more aligned. The visceral work has also been a game-changer—something I didn’t even know I needed until I experienced the benefits firsthand.

What sets her apart is not just her technical skill, but her holistic approach and genuine care. The integration of Pilates has helped me build strength and awareness, reinforcing the bodywork in a sustainable way. I’ve seen lasting improvements in my posture, inflammation, energy levels, and even digestion.

If you're looking for someone who goes beyond surface-level fixes and is truly invested in your long-term health, Jen is the one. She’s a rare find!

reviews.author: Justine Billon
reviews.text: I am extremely grateful to Jen. She has helped me with ailments I had for many years and given me a renewal in my life. reviews.author: Noreen
reviews.text: This RV park is an absolute gem in the Okanagan! We stayed 7 months as we just did not want to leave. The lots are huge and many are private, hookups modern and flawless, and yes—fibre internet if you stay long term! The owners are incredibly kind, welcoming, and active in the community. Potlucks, parades, and peaceful mountain views make every day special. You can be social or enjoy total serenity—it’s your choice. Clean laundry, showers, and fun spaces for kids too. Every upgrade this year was amazing. We’ll return again and again—our hearts are still there!  I really cannot say enough about the entire experience was amazing.  Loved the spooky Halloween decorations.  So grateful to the couple that run this place.....Thank you! (we were first timers in an RV so we needed a fair amount of advice; everyone was so friendly) Highly recommend this place..oh and safe, lots of cameras, just watch out for the occasional bear...loved her too.  ❤️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

reviews.author: Skye G
reviews.text:
We absolutely loved our stay here! The sites are large, level, and have full hookups — which made setting up super easy. Everything is very clean and well kept, and the whole park has such a peaceful, aesthetic feel surrounded by trees. It’s tucked up the mountain just enough to feel like you’re in the forest, but still only a few minutes from town and all the essentials.

The neighbors were friendly, and the atmosphere was really welcoming and relaxed — perfect for families and kids to enjoy some space and quiet time outdoors. The pricing is also very reasonable for what you get.

We went right before Halloween and the amount of effort that went into decorating the place was incredible.

Highly recommend Peachland RV Park if you’re looking for a quiet, beautiful, and family-friendly place to unwind. We’ll definitely be back! 🌲🚐

reviews.author: L Morgan
reviews.text:
This campground is a place we keep coming back to.  From when it was just being redone by the new owners a few years back, I had been waiting to come, and now it is the only place we will stay at when coming out to Kelowna!  Spacious sites, which is privacy, not having see my neighbor's window, very flat sites, no need to level, full hook ups and set in Nature's best.

The owners are very friendly and care about your stay.  Sure there are some rules but hey, it keeps everyone safe, like our grandkids when they come see us while staying there.

The grounds are kept tidy and it is paved roads, so no dust storms when any rig goes by.  Just all the little things that make the stay even better.

Every site we have had is always a great spot.

This campground shows that the owners care about your stay and take such great pride in their campground.

Coming from the West you do have to drive a couple of minutes further up the highway to turn around on the overpass to come back to enter the park but seriously it is a couple of minutes, not a deal breaker to stay at such a great place and yes when going back home to the west, same thing over the overpass.  But once parked it is easy access back to Kelowna or Peachland.  I am sure if they could, they would change the exit situation, but that is in the hands of higher level government to do that.  But again not a deal breaker to stay at such a lovely park.

I wish the wifi was a bit better, but I am not leaving less stars because of it, as the owners are always working on the park to make it even better every time you come.

Our home away from home......

Thank you again for such a great stay!

reviews.author: Geordie Loverin
reviews.text:
Had Stephen come install a sump pump in my basement after having water intrusion issues. Have had multiple contractors come give me quotes on repairing the drywall/framing after the pump install/waterproofing repairs. All of them had lots to say about the poor quality repairs that were performed....
Some of the issues noticed:
- Very uneven concrete work, not level at all with the rest of the floor. I understand its hard to get it perfect but this was very excessive and required hours of grinding down areas to make the floor/framing level.
- Damaged/chipped concrete on the exterior of the house when they drilled a hole for the discharge pipe. (I feel this should have been a way cleaner cut with a proper tooling)
- Leaking glue joints from the discharge pipe that sprayed water inside the house after a heavy rainfall (ideally this should have been caught by testing the system after install?)

Although Stephen's communication was good, and stuck to the quote. I felt the job was very rushed and lacked attention to detail. Especially for the very hefty price tag of the repairs...

Make sure you do your own contract because he keeps anything more and more items.

Please avoid this company or have a lawyer draw up your contract with it. The one worker he has is great at his workmanship.

Penticton Cabinets installed my kitchen and the whole experience was amazing. They’re busy and it’s because they are experts. They listen, offer helpful advice, and always follow up. With only measurements she was able to reimagine a space to  increase storage cabinet space, dining space and adding room for a desk and a dog bed. 🤩

Martin was great onsite and adapts on the fly, whether it’s a delivery issue or problem-solving in a tight kitchen space. The installer was prepared, on time and professional. I was on a time crunch, and the team made suggestions to help keep the project on schedule and keep my stress at a minimal level.

The finished product exceeded my quality expectations, especially on a tight budget. After dealing with another kitchen installer in town who didn’t listen, care, or have any vision, I was very grateful to have Tanya and the team deliver a far superior experience.

reviews.author: Connie Liclic
reviews.text:
DON’T ever I repeat ever use The Boreal Woodshop to custom manufacture kitchen cabinetry. Had the misfortune of contracting The Boreal Woodshop (ROB the owner) In February 23/2025 and gave him 60% deposit to start the project with 30% due prior to delivery and remaining 10% due on substantial completion. ROB started the project and delivered 4 new cabinets March 10/2025. (Satisfactory delivery at that stage) BUT upon delivery and installation is when the nightmare started. All cabinet boxes were 1/2” too tall and would not fit the bases under our granite countertops, cutting and shimming were the only alternative . ROB gave up and modified the boxes by installing 4 plastic adjustable legs on each box. After 2 days of partial installation, the boxes were in place and the matching cabinet fronts were ordered from a custom door manufacturer by ROB. From this point on for the next 3 1/2 months we waited. It was then we were completely GHOSTED after trying to contact him by phone over 20 times . No communication whatsoever. We then decided to visit him at his shop to find out what was happening with our cabinetry install. He then told us he did not have time to finish the job and couldn’t tell us when would he be able to complete. Now 16 weeks (4 months) since the project started we were without installed doors and finished work.
I would not recommend anyone to ever do business with ROB and THE BOREAL WOODSHOP. They have definite problems with communication, workmanship and not delivering on time or with a promised product. TOTAL ABANDONMENT and INCOMPLETION is what we finally received from ROB and THE BOREAL WOODSHOP.  Save yourself the stress and headache and don’t use such a unprofessional and unreliable contractor.

Jeerlee is truly exceptional at her craft. As a customer, you walk into her shop with something deeply meaningful—something you want protected and preserved for years to come—and she gets it.

Her quiet confidence and expert guidance transform your ideas into a finished piece that’s nothing short of perfection. That’s no easy feat when emotions are high and expectations are personal—but Jeerlee has a laser-sharp eye for detail and an artist’s intuition for presentation.

She gently offers suggestions that you may never have thought of, helping shape a vision that elevates your artwork in ways you didn’t imagine possible. Her goal is always to educate and ensure the best outcome for you—not just a beautiful frame, but a meaningful experience.

If you’re looking to frame something special, this is the place. Jeerlee will treat your artwork with the respect, care, and expertise it deserves.

Alan and his apprentice, Ian, really earned their wages today!

I hired Bett's to run a new dedicated 220amp circuit from my electrical panel to my kitchen for a new induction range. Alan and Ian arrived on time, as scheduled.

Some contractors might have jumped into the job without much thought. I was impressed that Alan and Ian took their time considering all the options. Not just what would be easiest for them, but also, what would provide the best job for my situation.

Moreover, they took the time to discuss the options with me so that I understood exactly what to expect.

reviews.author: Gary B
reviews.text:
Can't say I'd recommend this location for its service.

I've given Gescan Penticton three opportunities to win over my business over the last year and unfortunately they failed to impress at every occasion.

Firstly when you walk in the door nobody acknowledges you exist which doesn't seem like much but when you're the only customer in the store you think they would at least treat you like a human being and say hi.

Once you get over that you like okay sure they're busy whatever you gather your stuff you put it on the till there's no one at the computer till but there's two staff members different computers again don't acknowledge you exist don't give you any kind of timeline of when you can expect to be help so you stand there and wait, and wait, and wait some more. Then after 5 minutes you say forget it you put the stuff back and you leave and nobody even tries to you know correct it as you walk out the door they literally they just don't care.

If that happened once then fine you know maybe it's a bad day or maybe it was me and was mad about something else but when it happens on three separate occasions with different staff members it's clear that it's a team issue and they aren't interested in new business. They clearly have their base of contractors that they support that keeps them in business and if they don't recognize you I guess the assumption is that they don't need your business.

Now compare that to the staff at Gescan Surrey or Langley and you're immediately greeted when you come through the door and asked if they can help and clearly care to help get you on your way and out the door. Or even a local example of Penticton Andrew Sheret.

Can't say I didn't give Gescan Penticton another chance and I won't make that mistake again. I'll just order online from or go somewhere else. Best of luck!

reviews.author: Real Unimportant
reviews.text: Everyone at Rona Penticton was so friendly and helpful, EXCEPT CODY AT THE CUSTOMER SERVICE DESK. Twice over the course of 3 days we went in and both times Cody was overly rude and dismissive of us. The first time we stopped at the customer services desk to return an item and Cody was there on his computer completely ignoring us for a few minutes. Even though we were standing right in front of his field of view. After a minute I asked “am I in the right place?” He said “for what” (with a snarky rude tone). I said “for customer service”. He said “what do you want” (again with a rude tone). We asked if we could return a shower head and he said those are not returnable. We told him that Les and Don told us they were returnable even if they were used but he said “no they wouldn’t have said that”. So we went to the desk at the back and were served by a very nice lady and returned the shower head no problem. She was confused about what Cody said, and his behaviour. The second time was a day or two later, and we again approached Cody at the customer service desk about questions we had on an item, and again he was very rude and dismissive saying “I don’t know” and then walking away from us. We are very polite people and were shocked at his level of non-customer service skills. Everyone else at Rona was very helpful and friendly, but Cody ruined the experience. We just bought our first house and wanted Rona to be our store for repairs, etc. but we will not be dealing with Cody anymore. He should not be in a customer service position.

reviews.author: Ashley Syer
reviews.text:
Things did not start off well, with the person who was supposed to come to do some work at my place calling in sick 15 minutes before I was expecting him. Mike was incredibly apologetic and responsive, and arranged for someone to come the next day. He was a pleasure to deal with through all the booking issues. Clark was great and very friendly, and seemed to do a very good job with the things we needed help with. I was really happy.
The real problems I have are with the back end of dealing with Skaha Electric. I asked for the bill twice before it came, and then it just had one large line item for all the materials. I sent four emails over the course of a month, trying to get the information. It took me over a month to get a breakdown of the materials used, and when I finally got it, it had no pricing. They have refused to tell me what they charged me for any of the materials at all. I emailed and called again, to no avail. I got a snippy text about how I hadn't paid my bill (because I was still trying to get information about the charges), and finally got a call back. The person I spoke with was rude, argumentative, and talked over me. I said I had felt my requests for information were being ignored, and she confirmed that it was because they were ignoring me. When I told her my accountant needed the breakdown of materials, as we are anticipating an audit, she told me that my accountant requiring the breakdown was "moot" because I wasn't being audited yet.
What started off as a clear 5 star rating has left me feeling disappointed and demeaned as a customer. Clark was pleasant and did a good job. Mike was very nice to deal with. If you expect transparent pricing or someone to treat you with respect when you call about a bill, you might look elsewhere.

He put in composite decking, which is expensive, and John did a poor job installing it with uneven and rough end cuts using a skill saw rather than mitre or table saw and even installed one piece upside down. There are uneven ends everywhere and random screws where it seems like he forgot something. In the end, I am not certain he knew what he was doing with this product, but not taking the time to use the proper saw or measure and cut boards to the same length when dealing with expensive materials is just poor workmanship. I would not recommend him as he is expensive, and the quality of the work in no way matches the price he charged.

In response to John's reply to my post. Here are the photos I took of the work. The photos I sent John stating my displeasure with his work before I posted my review. He was notified of my concerns ( in writing with these photos), which I still have, and he chose not to respond.

Just when I thought I was done when the winds kicked up the other day, my gate started to come off and when I investigated it only had 1 of 3 screws in each of the two hinges. I then opened the gate and realized it wad installed backwards and that he had crushed my downspout to install it. I would warn anyone even thinking of hiring FenceDeckYard or John not to. reviews.text: I find this team very unprofessional, unorganized and poor at communication. They were recommended to me by my restoration company, as I am dealing with a flood claim through insurance. The manager Josh was my main contact and he often "forgot" to get back to me. He verbally quoted me $1500 for a niche and $350 for a shelf including install for the shower, which a highly rated local competitor quoted me $400 for the niche and $150 for the shelf including install. He also built a quote for over 1000 square feet of materials for a 850 square foot surface. There are duplicate underlays and other materials that I'm not sure what they are. I know you need extra material for mistakes, but that seems like a big excess. The quote has quantities and prices that just do not make any sense, so I went in to discuss it and get clarity. Josh was not in for 5 more days, and the (3rd) worker refused to go over the quantities and prices with me because the quote was in the restoration companies name. Even though I had a printout with those details on it which I left at home, on purpose in case it was wrong or old. The issue of details was not about being priced for the restoration company, it was to clarify the products and quantities were correct, in turn making my personal additional upgrade prices appropriately reflected. But he refused to discuss it with me. I think this team price gauges and I do not like the way the operate. I will not be using them, and can not confidentiality recommend them.

reviews.author: Danny H
reviews.text:
Hired NuFloors to do the 3000+ sq ft of flooring, and the tile in our entire home, including custom walk in shower.

The initial work started Ok, but there were problems that crept up and dealing with them to rectify was like pulling teeth, and there was never any resolution.

Custom formed stair nosings cracked a month after moving in. I asked for a resolution multiple times. I was given excuses of being too busy to come look, but they promised to. Never got fixed.

Showers and bath tub didn't get siliconed. Asked multiple times. Just finger pointing at different trades as to who should have done it. Backsplash joint to counter has grout jammed in with no caulk. The tiler should do this, period.

Then the black grout in our ensuite. The tiler used way too much water to wash it and bleached the color right out. They also tiled the walls first, which used white grout, and the dust from this settled and mixed into the black grout on the floor due to poor cleanup and planning. It made the black grout look washed out in uneven patches. I had two second opinions and both gave the same diagnosis. My general contractor even saw them use so much water on the floor it distorted the door frame moulding at the bottom. He pleaded my case, and they still did nothing.

Upon using the shower, the grout in the floor was leaching out white stuff for months see the picture. It was horrible. I have no idea what would cause such a mess.

Brad, Kevin and Don eventually came to our house once (after months), and they denied the deficiencies to my face. Told me it was the lighting that made the grout look different colors in different spots. The definition of gaslighting. I proved it to them with showing them the proper color of the grout by looking inside a vent hole where some grout had gotten and was the true color as it hadn't been washed, despite it being clearly obvious as shown in photos. They admitted it then, but did nothing to rectify. All they did was send another installer to kind-of fix a horrendous backsplash corner. Picture attached is what it looks like AFTER the fix. Nothing else was resolved.

The installers didn't caulk where the shower bench meets the tile. Over time this has resulted in water getting behind the bench, running down, and coming back out at the grout joint at the bottom. This has weakened the grout and caused efflorescence, as water slowly seeps out over days after having a shower. It looks like garbage and has since a few months in.

The installers were a father/son team. The work the son did was perfect. The father's work had deficiencies, and he had a poor attitude and was rude during construction. Acted like he didn't want to be at our house.

Then during construction I asked for a black schluter drain. Before the tile was set I saw the wrong drain installed. I contacted NuFloors and they told me no worries they'd just change the cover to black later.

Turns out the black drain I paid for is a different size and not compatible with the basic silver drain they installed.

So to fix it, they had to come cut out a section of tile above the kerdi membrane. You should never disturb the membrane and who knows what will happen down the road. All because they didn't quality control the work and didn't know the drains weren't compatible with one another.

This isn't even all of the issues. There are holes in the grout of second bathroom. Misaligned tiles on backsplash and splotchy marks in grout. Carpet peeling off bottom of stairs.

Nothing was rectified. After months of attempts and patience I just gave up.

Now every time I enter the shower I am angry to look at it. And now I have to pay people to complete and fix things, and still it will never be right.

This has been my experience with NuFloors.

Unfortunately, I do not have anything good to say about this builder. He is definitely not the man I thought he was and I truly thought I could trust him. I was so wrong.
We were 150,000 over budget and I was left with a half finished house. He jerked me around for 2 years promising to make it right and then ghosted me.
We did a cost plus contract which was a very bad way to go. Be very careful is all I can say. He claims to be transparent but he is not. His trades are gauging so make sure you get other quotes. Keep track of trade hours and verify that he is not charging you double for labour. What he actually pays his trades is less than what he is charging you. Understand your cost plus contract and keep track of everything.
Hope that helps.

reviews.author: Adam James
reviews.text:
I'd echo other reviews for buyers to do their own due diligence.

The homes in this development are very nice looking, and there are great views to be had. In all likelihood the homes will keep and increase in value at pace or more likely greater pace than the Canadian standard rate. Notably, the Okanagan home value increase year over year is typically much higher than the Canadian average. These are standard Canadian modern homes though; a lot of flashy finish that isn't meant to last >10 years.

This development was developed in a bit of a vacuum. It is a large subdivision that was installed without surrounding infrastructure to support the subdivision, notably transportation, sewer and storm water. It has taken nearly 10 years for construction on the adjacent infrastructure to begin after homes were being sold in the development. During that time, at least one traffic fatality and numerous accidents have taken place at the intersection of sandhills and the highway. Storm drainage and runoff into the surrounding natural environment (including Skaha Lake) has been exacerbated by the paved and other hard surfaces in the development which channel polluted water into the surroundings and at higher flow rates than would naturally occur.

Portions of the development are constructed on glacial lakebed silt, which can be subject to desiccation cracks and sinkholes. A careful review of adjacent municipality and regional district zoning and building guidance will show that these areas are not recommended or zoned for residential development due to these issues.

These homes are emblematic of the modern western world. They look good, they represent a lot of money, but the substance just isn't there. But, people love it, and they'll keep voraciously buying into it.

reviews.author: Garry Saik
reviews.text:
To anyone doing due diligence on this development, take everything you're told with a giant grain of salt and keep another bag or two handy, you'll need it. This is the most "forked tongued" developer I've ever had the misfortune of being involved with, and I've worked with many in the lower mainland for years. They are the masters of excuses and month after month after month, that's what you'll get. Looks like we drew the short straw with these wanna be house  builders, our mea culpa big time.
How about a 4 + months update. Are we moved in, No, do we have a move in date, No, has the interior been completed, No, has the exterior been completed, No, has the plumbing/electrical been completed, No, has the ground work been done, No. As for the bag of salt I mentioned in my earlier review, change it to a shovel, and keep handy several of  the bags you find in the airplane seat in front of you, because the bs just gets deeper and some of the platitudes will require the bag.

reviews.author: Scott Hutchinson
reviews.text:
While researching local contractors, we came across Square Foot Construction and their experience building carriage houses. After meeting with owner Bryce Goligher to discuss building a carriage house on our acreage for our parents, it was clear from his professionalism, temperament, and depth of industry experience that when the time was right, he would be our builder.

Bryce introduced us to a house designer who took our ideas and transformed them into an excellent plan, and he also encouraged us to engage an interior designer—a decision that proved invaluable. The scope ultimately expanded to include a garage suite, renovations to our main residence, and a refresh of the entire exterior envelope.

Demolition began in the spring of 2025, and the team Bryce assembled was nothing short of superb. The trades and vendors were highly skilled, respectful of our property, and courteous throughout the build. Both site superintendents were excellent problem solvers, and it was a pleasure to watch their “pro tips” and practical experience in action. Any challenges that arose were addressed promptly, and scope changes were managed with care and professionalism. The carriage house was completed at the end of October, with the remainder of the project substantially completed by year’s end.

As someone with over 30 years in the construction industry, I appreciated the opportunity to contribute where appropriate (leaving my "signature" on some of the heavy timber and glulam beams/columns) and found the overall execution and craftsmanship to be of a very high standard.

Bryce and the entire Square Foot Construction team have our full endorsement.

P.S. Square Foot Construction partnered with Akribis, a highly experienced local residential framing company. Luke and his team took the project from foundation to lock-up and documented the process in a 10-part video series featuring impressive drone footage and excellent heavy timber and glulam craftsmanship. The series can be viewed on the blog link for BuildIT Systems (10 Part Contractor Pro Series), or through Akribis YouTube channel.

reviews.author: Rich Koh
reviews.text:
Our real estate agent referred us to Bryce while we were in the process of selling our townhome and while my wife and I knew we needed a larger space for our growing family, we really didn’t have a solid plan of what our next home would look like.  We decided to contact Bryce anyway to get the ball rolling.

From that very first phone call, Bryce exhibited an exceptional level of professionalism that truly set him apart. He patiently walked us through the entire process, taking the time to explain potential costs, what could and couldn’t be done, and addressing any concerns we had. Again, at this point of time, we didn’t know the size of renovation we would be needing, we were also considering to build new.  We had so many questions. We were such newbies!  Despite all of our changing plans and uncertainties, Bryce’s calm demeanor and unwavering patience provided us with immense comfort, ultimately solidifying our decision to choose him as our general contractor.

We were fortunate enough to purchase a 3000 sq ft home in great condition, albeit needing some updates. We opted for a fairly extensive renovation, which encompassed the main level kitchen, dining area, living room, family room, half bath, and office. Additionally, we repainted the entire interior and installed new flooring on both the first and second floors, including a new staircase and railing. Lastly, we incorporated a kitchen in the basement to transform it into an in-law suite.

From start to finish, throughout the entire project, Bryce maintained excellent communication, ensuring that we were kept in the loop and that our needs were met. His even keel and practical approach were invaluable, making the entire process smooth and stress-free. He was testing out a new project management and accounting software with our project and we thought it worked well and was also helpful.  He consistently demonstrated his expertise by walking us through each step, offering practical advice, and always being available to address any questions or concerns.

What also sets Bryce apart is his extensive network of industry professionals who are not only highly skilled but also genuinely good people. This network allowed us to benefit from top-notch services and workmanship, further enhancing our overall experience.

Above all, Bryce is more than just a contractor – he is genuinely a really good dude. His integrity, trustworthiness, and dedication to ensuring customer satisfaction are truly commendable. We couldn’t have asked for a better partner for our project, and we wholeheartedly recommend Bryce to anyone in need of a reliable and trustworthy general contractor.

reviews.author: Barbara McIntyre
reviews.text: I hired Paneless window cleaning on the suggestion of my realtor in preparation to list the house for sale. Two men came out to do the work and I understood they were subcontracted by Paneless Window Cleaning. I was given a bid and it was higher than what I've paid in the past but I assumed they would do a meticulous job since it was a referral from my realtor. I told one of the men, we'll call him Josh, that I wanted the window sills wiped after the windows were washed. I have had window washers leave the dirty water on the window sills in the past. At his request, we even went in and looked at my windowsills so that he could see that they were clean to start with. They finished the job and this same subcontractor tried to get out of putting the screens back up, I told him that was part of the bid and he needed to do it. After they left I noticed there were spots on some of the windows and some of the corners of the windows that Josh had done were still unclean. I went and looked at the window sills and in fact the ones cleaned by the other subcontractor, we'll call him John, were wiped clean. When I called the company and told them they wanted to send the same team out. I told them I did not want Josh back out and that John had done a great job. I was fine with him coming back to fix what hadn't been done properly. John called me to set up a time to come back out and I asked him if he was getting paid to come back and make the job right? He told me he was not. What kind of business takes a good subcontractor and expects them to go back and clean up the mess of a poor subcontractor without paying them? I'm sorry but that should be the cost of doing business. You should not continue to work with the subcontractor that did a bad job but you should certainly pay the other subcontractors to fix what was done improperly. I will never use them, I will never refer to them and I can't even believe that they have five star reviews. I hope they have fired the sloppy and lazy sub.
