reviews.author: Jason Schmidt
reviews.text:
1-Star Review: Stay Far Away – Dishonest and Unprofessional
I regret every second I gave this company my business. From start to finish, it was a nightmare.
They demanded a large deposit supposedly for materials—way more than was actually spent on materials for my job. When I asked where the bulk of the equipment was, they said it was on order and would arrive in a few days, but they needed to keep it at their shop. Then, when it was actually needed two months later, I had to wait again because they had never ordered it.
The owner became pushy about getting the remaining balance paid before the work was even finished, but after payment they completely ghosted me. I could not get a response—no returned calls, no replies to texts, no answers to emails—nothing. This was especially frustrating because their original quote clearly stated they would handle rebate applications and warranty registration on my behalf. Those promises vanished the moment the final payment cleared. They took my money and immediately treated me like I no longer existed.
The workmanship itself was mediocre at best—nothing terrible, but definitely not worth what they charged. Sloppy details, corners cut where it showed, and no pride in the finished product.
Bottom line: Poor and dishonest communication, questionable financial practices, abandonment after getting paid, and subpar work. I would not recommend these guys to anyone. Save yourself the headache and stress—go with literally anyone else.

*Definitly not a performance shop of anykind*

*Very Dismissive*

I Took my 1972 K10 project to Britney and her then Husband Cal.  Britney and Cal came recomended to me.

I was told by Britney to have the truck there for the 4th of january 23. It was not brought in untill over a month later Febuary 6th 2023. Then when it was needed in the shop she charge me an aditional $150 to have a tow truck move it inside from their parking lot.  This was after i payed to have it towed there in the first place. The project was in to have a bunch of electrical and basic break, suspention and steering repairs and upgrages including instaling and wireing a brand new painless wireing harness aswell as install and wire a vintage air ac system which was bolt in except for the lines which they were un  able to sove and i myself figured out and had made at the autodoctor in kelowna. The truck was a "Project" I was initial quoted 35 hours to wire in a full set of gauges, turn signals, and an ac system, all parts I provided. In the end the wiring bill came in it was $19887.81. That was just to have the above electrical done.

The mechanical side of things came out to $13k while the majority of parts being supplyed by me and bolt on.
They supplied starter ac compressor front and rear brakes and ujoints throught ect.

I would describe the technicians there at the time my truck was being worked on by them as disgruntled and generaly lacked the motivation to work productively. The tech seemed more interested in his toolbox then my truck. I know there was a bunch of infighting between Cal and Britney and most definitly spilled on over onto the tech that was working on my truck. Aswell as me.

I tryed many times to rectify the situation at the time which enevitabley led me to yanking the truck out of the shop before it was completed due to Penticton diesel dragging it out for months. After their work should have been complted. She will say it was cause they were waiting on parts. Only thing they waited on was the AC lines as that was a dificulty i had to overcome.

They got their money and I got a basket case. Hinde sight is 20 20 and i knew when she took that month to get it in I should have found another shop.

Fast forward to febuary 2025 and i had it back in for a long standing issue of going through starters, payed another $650 to have them ad a start cuircuit relay insted of fixing the wiring I payed them to install in the first place.

My issue is they could not produce what she told  me she could do. Embaresed i let Britney take me on that ride but lesson learned Hardway.
I was also never fond of how she talked or delt with me. Was also kinda conspicuous that they got two brand new 2 post lifts while my truck was drug in and out of the shop over the next 6 months.

All in all I could not recomend this shop to anyone with clean conscience.

reviews.author: Peter Bolhuis
reviews.text:
I truly can't believe that this company is still in business.
Putting the extraordinarily higher prices aside, these guys are crap!
First off, they showed up without the needed materials. They actually forgot to bring a piece of plywood needed to mount a propane manifold to an interior wall, so instead of driving to the nearby Home Hardware, they simply scrounged around my basement and stole a sheet of material that I had set aside for a bag-toss game, then cut it in half without even asking me.
They pulled insulation out in order to make runs for propane lines, but rather than simply replace the insulation they instead merely left it laying on the ground in about a half dozen places.
The crew appear incompetent and mounted spigot covers in locations where they couldn't properly open, rather than simply using their brains and locating them ever so slightly up or down. They literally left ALL their trash right where they dropped it. My basement and surrounding yard were littered with little plastic bags and copper tubing cuttings.
And speaking of dropping, one or more of these clowns used our washroom, where they somehow managed to leave a bit of their own droppings (if you know what I mean) atop the toilet seat, and also managed to smear some on a hand towel, which they then just tossed into the bathtub. Disgusting!
During a lunch break, I spotted a few of them scoping out one of my shipping containers which I had converted into a workshop. They had absolutely no business being in there, other than to to covet my equipment. I don't trust that they didn't help themselves to an expensive item or two.
A valve and burner for our outdoor fireplace had been promised and included in the quote. The burner was finally delivered a few months late, and left for ME to install. The valve however, never ever arrived.
A few months after their installation, I caught Alex on my surveillance cameras. He was sneaking around the house and in my carport without notifying me. He returned a few weeks later when I was home, and asked if I'd found a small braising kit with a gas tank, torch and tools. I shook my head and chuckled in disbelief at how stupid and disorganized this bozo truly is.
Of course I'd found his tank.....and I gave it away, to an actual gas fitter.
But if all that wasn't bad enough......(and this is the IMPORTANT part of my review).... Alex charged me $400 to pull the permit for this work. A permit which is required by law and is absolutely necessary for insurance purposes. I requested my copy of the permit repeatedly for months following the installation of the new hot-water-on-demand and propane system, only to learn that he lied and had never actually applied for the needed permit. An inspector came to my house and pointed out several serious deficiencies with the work and suggested that I get them to return to correct the issues. I stated that I didn't want those fools back on my property and instead chose to correct the issues myself. The proper documentation was provided by the oversight inspector and other than this review, I have forever washed my hands of Response Heating and Air Conditioning.
I strongly suggest that this company is avoided. They are much more expensive than their competitors, they promise much more than they actually provide and they do crap work.

I called, left messages, spoke with workers with promises of getting call backs, I received no communication at all.
I then started receiving past due date bill for the initial checkup that totalled $189.
I protested via emails that my issue is unresolved and on going, that they haven't bothered to help fix my situation, that I've been ignored.

I get another 2nd past due date bill and once again I reply that my issue has been ignored by the company.
I have just received an email saying that
"Anthony,
The LG equipment in unit 92 was installed in 2020.
Some of the parts may still be under warranty but labour isn’t covered.
We are too busy and don’t have the manpower to take care of it. You will have to call someone else.
Regards,
Aaron Kelliher
Service Manager"

This company obviously has zero integrity and interest in actually helping their customers.

Extremely unprofessional.
Do better.

reviews.author: Michelle Davies
reviews.text:
I strongly believe the Canadian Tire Auto Department is dishonest and routinely overcharges customers while hiding behind a “family-friendly” brand image. In my experience and the experience of multiple people I know, this reputation does not match reality.
My elderly mother-in-law was repeatedly charged $2,000 or more per visit for routine maintenance — tire rotations, balancing, oil changes — with “new problems” suddenly appearing every time she brought her vehicle in. She trusted them completely, and I truly believe that trust was exploited.
We also brought a nearly new Dodge truck in for inspection while it was still under warranty. They claimed multiple issues that simply did not exist. Another vehicle was charged over $1,400, and within weeks it broke down again with the same problems supposedly fixed.
This is not a one-off experience. Nearly every person I know who has used this location has walked away feeling ripped off or misled.
A company that markets itself as affordable and family-oriented should not be repeatedly draining customers with questionable repairs and inflated charges. I would strongly caution anyone to go almost anywhere,seek a second opinion before  trust them with your car or your wallet.
Bro Ken 'N' Down, another unsatisfied customer.

reviews.author: Starlight Gazer 2020
reviews.text:
I’ve been going to Canadian Tire automotive for years, and usually they’re the only place I take my car outside of the Kelowna location. But this last experience was honestly terrible. I brought my car in because it was making a horrible glug-glug sound and vibrating, and after a whole side panel on the driver’s side was taken off and the entire muffler replaced, the noise was STILL there.

I had to come back multiple times for the same issue. On the fourth visit, after sitting in the waiting room for two hours, the shop manager came out and basically told me he had no idea what was wrong. He said the engine would show 8 cylinders then drop to 6, and told me to go to the Lincoln dealership. This was after I had already spent around $4000 and trusted them to diagnose it from the beginning.

What bothered me most was his attitude — abrupt, rude, and acting like I was a problem when I just wanted the issue fixed. If the car needed to be plugged in for diagnostics, why wasn’t that done the FIRST time I came in? Instead I was left with the same noise, same vibration, and a huge bill.

Really disappointed and won’t be going back after this.

UPDATE:
I've been meaning to update this for a while. So the head office of Canadian Tire did contact me and took down my side of story and contacted Penticton store but I never heard anything back from them wanting to resolve the issue. Never the less I did take my car into Carmi Motors as suggested by many friends and they were able to diagnose the problem and fix it easily with spark plugs. Moral of the story is if you keep having to repair things that are not broken and the problem continues to be there just go somewhere else. Lesson learnt! Never again!

reviews.author: Katrice Sutherland
reviews.text:
Nole, Cassie and Cortney did a fantastic job from start to finish and were incredibly friendly the entire way through.

Nole was very responsive, even in off-hours, and thorough in putting together a fair quote. We tasked them with a major spring clean-up surrounding the on-site residence and future public guest space at Foxtrot Vineyards, tidying up after our wind-thrashed willow tree, raking leaves, pruning overgrown rose bushes, trimming unsightly hedges, revitalizing garden beds, removing lifeless raspberry bushes and giving our lawns their first nurturing mow of the season.

They brought all of their own equipment, complied with COVID public health measures, and made sure to keep us informed of their progress throughout the process. We appreciate that it was the same workers who returned over the 4 days. We have a lot of moving pieces on site, so it helped to have consistent friendly faces we were familiar with, and gave us a chance to follow up without gaps in our conversations.

They went the extra mile to adjust their team's schedule around the needs of our business, and even worked an additional day without going over budget to ensure the property looked pristine. Nole even took extra time during his walk-around with us to suggest appropriate low-maintenance plantings for our future garden beds so we can focus our energy on the vineyard during growing seasons.

We truly appreciate all the hard work, thoughtfulness, and care that was put into this project. Our property looks great and we can't wait to host guests to show it off. We would definitely work with OK Valley Landscaping & Maintenance again and highly recommend them to anyone looking for a swift, affordable, well-executed job done right the first time.

On behalf of the team at Foxtrot Vineyards, thank you!

I settled on 1/2" clear dark stone, but honestly I thought the name was a bit optimistic when I bought them. They were mid brown, but still a good product. Turns out when you wash them like they tell you to, they completely transform! I bought dust stone 😉

In one of the photos you can see the difference between just wet and wet washed with a garden hose. I'm really happy with how everything turned out, and the dark stone looks really lovely once you get all the transport dust off of them! So make sure you do as they say and wash your rocks.

reviews.text:
I deeply regret hiring Sierra Flooring for a very large renovation we did in 2020. When the shower pan they installed started having issues, I reached out to them last March. I provided photos and asked them for help.The response was We will get back to you. Then nothing. I followed up in June. Nothing.
Then in July after a personal tragedy and tired of chasing after a company that clearly didn’t care about customer service.I just wanted the issue fixed before it became a bigger issue. I paid out of pocket to have another company come in and replace the shower floor.
After the floor was replaced I contacted Sierra again to show them the extent of the damage and what it cost me to have it repaired and replaced. I was again told, by the owner this time, that they would get back to me….I’m still waiting 3 months later.
It is beyond frustrating that a company has no problem taking your money but totally ignores you when there is a problem with there workmanship. The lack of accountability and professionalism is appalling!
If you are considering using Sierra just remember if something goes wrong they may not stand behind there workmanship!

reviews.author: Heather Primrose
reviews.text:

Initially we were sent an installer that did not prep the concrete floor at all.  After a few disgruntle complaints about how many dips our vinyl plank flooring had upon finishing, it took one complaint left with a neighbour, who then shared with their Sierra flooring installer, who then came to inspect our floor and commented how it was unacceptable. Patrick, Elizabeth and crew were at our place within two days ripping out the floors and properly prepping and reinstalling the floors back in.  Wow, what a team they have.  Always kept us informed of their time frames.  Any time I would walk in to check the progress, they all stopped what they were doing and gave us 100% of their attention.  They were quick and paid much attention to detail.  They taped off all my cabinets and wall pictures with plastic, and even washed floors and counters; took care of all the dust!  You could tell they aimed to please.  True, friendly professional and skilled at their craft.
We can't thank you enough for making this project a success.  We highly recommend Patrick and Elizabeth's team and the product sold at Sierra Flooring is of great quality.

reviews.text:
We had a clogged kitchen sink and called for help. Left a message and someone returned our call within 30min. Mat was able to come out the next morning and he cleaned out our drain promptly. He was very professional and friendly and I would certainly recommend Mavco based on this experience.

UPDATE: I was super disappointed to learn that after such a good in person experience, I was then charged for 1.25 hours, which was 45 min longer than the time he spent in the house. I was told that it included the time required to source parts from a supplier when all he did was go out to his van to get the item and install it. I did notice at the time that he did sit in his van for about 20min after he'd finished the job and said goodbye. I guess I paid for that time.

There was no reply to my concerned email about this over charge. After a good start, it turned out to be disappointing customer service and more than double the price it should have been.

I will not return to Mavco.

reviews.author: Bernhard Schneider
reviews.text: I had them scheduled as a backup for a main drain problem that the city was called to rectify.  City showed up first and fixed my blocked drain by flushing out their main drain line.  The Mavco guy showed up, very nice and professional but he had nothing to fix.  He checked my cleanout and said that everything was flowing and looked good.  He was present for 10 minutes and I received a bill for a full hour plus a $25.00 truck charge.  Total bill was just short of $140.00 for showing up.  Billing said that there is nothing that they are able and or willing to do to appease me.  Poor way to keep customers and service customers.  I will never call and use, nor recommend Mavco to any of my friends and aquaintances.  If anything I will make sure everyone will know of their greed and lack of customer care.  A terrible way to do business, I didn’t expect it to be free but a reasonable charge would have been appropriate and good business to insure future service calls.  Not ever again.

My wife and I were in the process of upgrading our fairly large kitchen countertops. We checked a number of local options but really weren’t satisfied with the lack of clarity of options from them. They tended to want to give us what we thought we wanted as opposed to what options would be best suited for our needs.
Then we meet with Steph and Doug from Madeira Stone. - great breath of fresh air. Not only did they offer a great history of quality work but they had the courage to make suggestions that were most appreciated at the end of the project. One example was backsplash. I wanted to keep the small tile backsplash that I installed (it was okay but, I’m not an installer). When I accepted the inevitable, I wanted to remove the tiles and save the drywall. Some appropriate and clear discussions with Steph and Doug brought me around and the old drywall and tile was cut out. Now it was all on Doug’s shoulders to template and install. Everything was seamless (pun intended 😊), complicated cuts and a good number of power outlets went together perfectly.
At the end of the project and now almost a year later we are still left with a feeling of total satisfaction. Our kitchen is upgraded, bright and way more modern.
In short, if you have the desire for quality work and honest and sincere support go to Madeira Stone. The appreciation of quality work lasts longer than the few extra dollars it might cost to get it.
Thanks Doug and Steph for looking after our needs. We are pleased to provide this ‘year after install’ review.
PS: I’m not a photographer so my apologies if the pics don’t do the work justice 😳

Great place to deal with! Super friendly, unlike the two other hot tub stores in town. Best prices with great quality product. Deliver was a breeze, super fast and without issue. They delivered the hot tub and accessories. Then they returned a few days later to install the lift and tub cover attachments after the electrician came and hooked up the hot tub. Also, unlike the other stores they didn’t tell me that WCB demanded that the hot tub be placed by a crane. The tub arrived on a tilt trailer onto a mover with 4 wheels, front and back. Easily moved across my lawn, leaving no marks or damage at all. Also saving me upto another estimated $2000 in crane costs.

I would highly recommend Okanagan Home Centre to anyone and everyone in the market for a hot tub, patio furniture, BBq’s etc.

reviews.text: Fantastic friendly service! They made shopping for a hot tub very easy!  Delivery was quick and efficient! Cody Came by the house to explain all the chemicals and functions of our new hot tub! I would highly recommend going with Okanagan Home Center for your spa/ Hot tub purchase!

reviews.author: Sheila Hawthorne
reviews.text:
Honestly I'm flabbergasted by the 2 negative reviews.  I doubt that these folks actually used Pleasure Pools!
Pleasure Pools has been our pool company for almost 20 years.  Originally Jared was our main contact and then his brother Raymond took over the business.  They have done our opening & closings every year, all repairs & maintenance and about 14 years ago Raymond did a complete overhaul of our pool - new Foxx pool, liner, added in stairs (we only had a ladder previously!), added a fantastic water feature with rocks and a "waterfall", stamped concrete pool apron, built a short allen block retaining wall to create a sitting area by the pool and finished it with paving stones.  Absolutely amazing work at a reasonable price.
We run a B&B so our pool is an extremely important part of our business.  Stuff happens (maintenance/repair things) and Raymond has ALWAYS responded right away.  He's even come out on holiday long weekends when it's been an emergency as he knows the pool is an important part of our B&B business  We've always received excellent service and I'd highly recommend Raymond and Pleasure Pools to anyone.  We just replaced our liner this year (2020) - a challenge during Covid! - and it was Raymond we hired to do that.  We're completely satisfied with the product and the service and if we ever "redo" our pool again will not hesitate to use Pleasure Pools!

reviews.author: Kelsey Harrington
reviews.text: Ray was absolutely wonderful through our process of building a pool! This was our first big project involving many other parties including the RDOS, the ministry of health, land surveyors, engineers....Ray was always supportive and helpful through every step! He worked with the delays we couldn’t overcome. His crew was incredibly quick on their parts of install and I must say, gentlemen! I would absolutely use and recommend Ray for any further pool endeavours. Reliable, experienced, and a down right good guy!

reviews.author: Jameson Harrington
reviews.text:
Ray was great to deal with we had a unique situation with out pool installation (permitting issues) which messed up our dates for starting  which obviously screws up there schedule. Over the phone or having him come
By the house. This is the second pool we have had done by pleasure pools and have had very little issues and the issues again were resolved. Thank you pleasure pools

reviews.text:

To the second reviewer..although it has been a family owned business since 1977, Raymond didn’t take over the company until 2006 and doesn’t even know who the reviewer is. She has never contacted Raymond.

reviews.text: As per Chris’s comment we were the new buyers of the house and in fact Pleasure Pool did instal the pool.  He was telling the truth as previous owner of home. The pool was broken and salt water generator had to be replaced. So not properly trained staff and owner is a liar and we got stuck with a huge bill when pool should have been operational as part of sales agreement. DO NOT use this company.

Staff were very friendly and helpful.

reviews.author: Michelle V
reviews.text: This facility exceeded my expectations by far! Having been a member at so many gyms over my life and visited many while on trips, I have pretty high standards for a gym. From the phone to call, to coming in and first impressions, the staff were so friendly and patient and answered all my questions and were eager to help! The don’t have contracts, which is so rare for gyms, and they have complimentary parking and are attached to the hotel’s pool and hot tub! The gym and change rooms were spotless and well maintained. There are so many machines and it’s well laid out. They have fresh mints for your enjoyment and sweat towels, so as you are working out next to people, you smell mint! Thank you for making my first day such a joy and I can’t wait to come back next time ☺️🙏🏻

reviews.text:
I don't use the gym itself (weights and machines) but the facilities and equipment are beautiful and it's spotlessly clean.   I do however utilize the studio and go to fitness classes almost daily and have done a wide variety of them (from Spin to Barre, Pilates and Yoga) with a wide variety of instructors and would recommend this facility and studio to anyone.

Each of the instructors brings something different to the table, inspiring, spiritual, funny and motivating.  I have never seen anyone singled  (in a class) out or made to feel out of place because they are learning or new.    All of the instructors rock and are genuinely interested in helping you bring out your best self.

The front desk staff and management are lovely and bend over backwards to help you.  I've never once gone in to anything but a genuine happy greeting.

Special shout out to the Active Recovery class, which teaches you a range of relaxation and stretching techniques that make you feel like you've been to a masseuse and therapist.

Love these folks.  100/10.  Would recommend to anyone looking for a facility where kindness and professionalism  is valued.

reviews.author: Barry Beckner
reviews.text:
Well I still choose to ride my ol’ custom Harley and decided to brave a road trip from Victoria BC to the Boogie Bash in Cache Creek this year.  What started out as a 79 flh ,… well not much of that left. With a stretched frame to fit an 89 stroker EVO, I installed PM brakes front and back.  My girl purred the whole trip, but on the #3 hwy Princeton hill sliding into Princeton, on the way there, a rear brake pad popped out on me.
So with only a front brake, I found the only shop in Western Canada who was able to help me in Penticton. I have not been able to find a drop in pad for my PM rear, period, for +25 years!  So what are the odds that KNS was able to come up with an odd brake pad AND was able to quickly modify it to get me back on the road.  It was a damn longshot, but that’s exactly what we did.
A little grinding, a little drilling, some graciously borrowed tools, and next thing I was doing was bleeding the life back into my brakes!
I can’t tell you how excited I was to be able to finish my ride on my scoot, and not in the fast truck but that’s not all!
Despite my efforts to pay for this service, I was denied!  I’ve had my days of helping a brother off the side of the road, but this was my ‘come-around time’ The dude would not take a dime and sent me off with the grace of the Penticton riding community.
My thanks ride on.  I’ll be stopping by this shop again for sure. I’ll have one more ‘ come-around time ‘ good will gesture to return! And that’s my word!

I ordered a door to replace an old wooden door on a 90 year old farmhouse - door size is custom and smaller than standard doors today - shorter and narrower.

ORDER vs custom CUT door - where the door is
Made to your dimension and then the holes are drilled to scale.

We had doors installed as well as a window. The doors turned out good. Some minor clean-up was needed. Unfortunately with the window they left quite a large scrape down my drywall. It's quite noticeable. There is also a large gap between the trim and the wall now. My wife and I were unhappy with how they decided to leave it so we contacted the owner. He had the supervisor who did the work contact us.
The reply was, "I believe you and Matt have sorted the issue out with the window and as for the scratch in the drywall I do apologize for that miss hap as these type of issues do happen when trying to remove the old trim and we try to do our best to leave the job in good order and little as posable touch ups for our customers in the end to touch up. I have had a meeting with my techs this morning regarding and to do our best when performing this type of task. I do apologize to you and your wife for this.

Thanks."
Nothing had been sorted out. I gave them an opportunity to fix the mistake. Past that, I'm not sure I would call it finished. A little putty can go a long way. Especially when paying 6000$ for something like this.

reviews.author: Lynn Walters
reviews.text:
We moved up here in June and did a large renovation on our home including replacing our old wooden patio doors. We ordered two new ones with the black frame on the outside. These doors cost over $9000.00.  The were installed in July and when I looked at them the outside black frame was all dented and scuffed. I mentioned this to the installer who took pictures and said it should of never left the shop or the manufacturing company.  August we had to call Salmon arm Window and doors over 9 times to follow up on the warranty. I was told the doors are great but their warranty service isn't. September more calls and I asked for a discount as this is a joke. The next day after my call someone from Plygem showed up to fix the doors, lol all the wrong parts in fact Salmon Arm window didn't order the right ones.  The repair guy from Ply Gems gave us Ply Gems numbers to deal with directly as it seems Salmon arm window loves to sell you items and not follow up or care it there is anything wrong with the items. As long as they made the sale.  To me they should be following up with us and the manufacturer not us. This is the worst customer service I have ever had. We have more windows to install but it sure as hell will not be from them. Take our money and run.  Called Ply Gem directly and they seem not too impressed that Salmon Arm Window and door passed the buck. Maybe by the end of the year our windows will be done correctly

Update still dealing with this mess. Plygem keeps ordering or not ordering the parts. It's the end of October and we still have damaged doors.

The house was constructed with SIP walls and retains it's coolness in the summer and warmth in the winter. We have spacious rooms and equally spacious halls and doorways. reviews.text: We have done a number of foundation subcontracts for Green Emerald Construction over the years and have always enjoyed the friendly, co-operative and safe work environment that Green Emerald's has provided. reviews.author: Stephanie Herlick
reviews.text:
Here is a review we have just received from some of our wonderful clients:

Building a custom home with Green Emerald was a first for us. We had never designed and built a custom home before and had never lived in the Shuswap region before. We placed our trust in Green Emerald Construction and 12 months later, we had a beautiful, quality built, forever home. Gary and Marilla were terrific to work with. Impressively, they answered their phones and shared their expertise with patience and friendliness. Their ideas and advice proved sound and have added to the enjoyment of our home.

We are particularly happy with the Structural Insulated Panels (SIP) that were used in the building of our home. We can feel the difference between our house and a frame constructed house. Our SIP built home feels more cozy and comfortable. Previously, we lived in a 1487 square foot rancher on a crawl space on the West Coast. Our current house built with SIP construction is 3482 square feet with a basement and many large windows. I compared the gas bills from each home over a period of 8 months. Six of the eight months we paid less for gas here in the Shuswap than we did for our smaller timber framed house on the coast. (The shoulder months were more expensive here in the Shuswap than on the coast as winter came sooner and lasted longer.)

I am thrilled that Green Emerald uses SIP and that it has made such a happy difference in our heating costs. I would recommend to everyone who is building a home in Canada to use SIP construction.

Gayle and Frank

reviews.author: Kyle Routledge
reviews.text:
We hired RedPoint in 2024 to help us undertake a pretty substantial home renovation. The job was complex, and the timing was not ideal–an overwinter job (our choosing) and while expecting our third child. For several months, Jacob and his crew were at our home, accommodating our needs, and working tirelessly to keep the disturbances minimal. Everyone on the crew has repeatedly impressed us, not only with the quality of work, but with how they have interacted with our entire family.
With RedPoint, you will get:
• Great communication – Jacob and Sheri are prompt in their responses and always have their crew show up on time and ready to go.
• Hard workers – every crew member that has helped our project take shape puts in a full days’ effort, rain or shine (even in temperatures in the negative teens!).
• Masters of their craft – the attention to detail and quality of work that we have seen at every turn has only reinforced how happy we are to have found this team.
• Fair rates – the rates charged by Jacob and each of his crew members are very fair and a full, transparent breakdown of hours worked and expenses incurred is provided on every invoice.
• Respect, kindness, and integrity – Jacob and Sheri (and their entire crew) have consistently treated my wife and myself, our three children, and our pup with some much kindness and respect, and always do what’s right by their customers.
Our project is not yet complete, but there is no other contractor we’d rather work with to finish the job. We love what has been done so far and look forward to seeing the final product come together.
Thanks Jacob and Sheri (and Matt, Jason, Wade, and Rick), keep up the great work!

reviews.author: Jessica Blundell
reviews.text:
Firstly, I would like to say, this entire experience was better than I could have imagined.
We recently hired Redpoint in 2025 for a major project on our home: replacing all the siding, windows and updating our deck. Additionally finishing and siding our shop, and we couldn't be happier with the results.

From the very beginning, communication was excellent. Jacob provided a detailed and transparent quote, and they were always quick to respond to our questions. There was never any waiting. We always felt like we were their priority even when we knew he was busy. They helped us choose the right materials, colours and design for the project, offering valuable insights. It was clear he understood what we wanted and how to achieve it for us. At times we were not sure exactly how we wanted certain elements to look, and we felt completely confident trusting his Jacob's judgment. Jacob and his team took our preferences and aesthetic and made smart design choices that turned out better than we could have imagined. We were so happy mid project we even decided to add additional things to the project. Jacob had no problem rolling with it and made it easy. Jacob and his guys were exceptionally easy and accommodating to work with.

The crew were top notch. Everyone was professional, skilled, and incredibly efficient. They showed up on time every day and worked hard to complete the job on schedule. The quality of their work is outstanding; the new siding, windows looks flawless and the deck is exactly what we envisioned. They paid close attention to detail, and the job site was kept clean and tidy throughout the entire process. They were very professional and treated our home with respect. It was very clear they take pride in their work.

We are so impressed with the transformation of our home. It looks amazing. Better than we could have ever imagined. We highly recommend Redpoint for any project. We have full intentions of having them return to complete our Kitchen reno next.  They are a reliable and trustworthy team that delivers exceptional results and I would highly recommend them.

Thank you Jacob and his amazing team of builders!

reviews.text: 1st time trying this shop, wont be back. I Booked in 2 weeks ahead for non working 4x4 issue and a front end check. My truck didn't go in until 1.30 only after I was asked if I was in a rush. When the truck was "done" I got handed a bill for $280, told my one hub was stuck in auto needed replacement and needed all new vacuum lines after the tech managed to get the vacuum working for now. I was told I would get a follow up quote for the repairs. Its been 2 weeks and no quote, no call nothing. I did some looking and the hub needed lubrication that is fixed and the vacuum line had been eaten by a rat, the new lines were $116 from Ford and took 5 mins to install, so I dont follow how they could have got them working for now. I dont usually write bad reviews but being charged that high of a diagnostic fee, not being followed up with (where I would have explained these frustrations to them) and also being misdiagnosed, and not sticking to an appointment got under my skin. I hope if you do go here you have a better experience than me. The front desk lady was pleasant to deal with.

reviews.text: They lived up to the name and took ACTION! We’re incredibly thankful for the good people at Action Safety! reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.text:
We had such a great experience!!! KIND AND HONEST PEOPLE!!

We are a group of 3 woman traveling from Calgary on our way to Tofino. We took a stop in Salmon Arm to get gas and accidentally put diesel into our gas tank. We ended up driving for a couple km until we heard a noise coming from our car. We stopped immediately and tried to start the car and the poor thing didn’t start.

We were terribly worried knowing the common occurrence around woman getting over charged by mechanics. Us not knowing anything, we went to the near by shop and asked for good reputable car servicing locations. Action Safety was listed but unfortunately they didn’t have availability until Wednesday. We called around and it seemed every mechanic was booked until the next day. Cutting our losses on making it to Vancouver that night, we decided it might be more worth it to rent a car and leave ours at a reputable mechanic over the week of our trip.

After towing our car to the shop, the owner was able to look at it right away and was confident he could even get us out by the end of the day. We were SO grateful for this quick service as it meant we could still make our 10:40pm ferry ride to Vancouver Island and also not need to rent a car🥹.

When asking for how much everything would cost, they were so very transparent and didn’t overcharge us on any thing. It’s so nice to know that there are places that are like this! We were able to get our car back in 1.5 hours and she works just as she did before we poisoned her with diesel haha! We were explained our charges and it matches with everything we were told at the beginning!

THANK YOU FOR THE GREAT SERVICE!

+ their dogs on site are super kind and sweet! Thanks for the dog therapy 🫶!

reviews.author: Natalie Jobe
reviews.text:
I don't usually leave reviews, but this company has been so awful I feel I must. I have used Waste Connections for my area (Blind Bay, BC) for a few years. 2 issues.
1. You pay with autopayments that you setup through their site and it allows you to set a maximum they can pull from your Credit card, ie I set my first limit to $90. This covered my payments for quite a while. Then I started getting notices that my payments were failing due to my limit being set too low. They upped my monthly fee without telling me, multiple times. I must have increased that limit 4 or 5 times to finally having it set to $130. A lot of money for garbage pick up.
This leads me to issue number 2!
2. They miss A LOT of pick ups! This year alone they have missed easily 7-8 pickups. No auto refunds, only giving us a notification of the no pickup half the time (get home and garbage is still there), and nothing really to show they realize how much this impacts their customers.

Having this happen multiple times this year is already not great, but in the middle of summer, when it's hot out and you have garbage that sits for 2 weeks is gross and awful.

I literally cancelled and switched my services a week ago after them not picking up my garbage again (have pick up until the end of this month) and they left me a message today saying they can't pick up again this week!!! So glad I am moving on.

I hope this review saves someone else from dealing with this company. Maybe they will get more staff and it will get better, but right now, this year (2024) pretty awful service.

The job was sloppy: the caulking was messy, he didn't take the waste from his job with him, instead leaving it in a bucket on our kitchen floor. In the middle of the job he informed us we needed 2 new strainer assemblies. We took his word for it and paid him to travel to his shop for the parts, plus paying for the parts. A week later when we were disposing of the box the sink came in we found 2 strainer assemblies had come with sink. We had asked him to check the box when he was doing the job. Upon discovering these parts we texted the gentleman who installed the sink with photos of the parts and questions about the extra amount we had to pay. We have received no response. We have not received any refunds and don't expect to.

We understand this gentleman is in demand in the community, which is great for his business. But if you want a plumber who pays attention to detail, I would suggest looking elsewhere for service.

reviews.text: Dropped by the shop last week to look at items for upcoming fixture replacements and a shower renovation in my home. In the end, I found several items that suit my needs and offer sound quality and good features for a reasonable cost.  Thanks Graeme!

reviews.author: Grant Wolkosky
reviews.text:
A few days ago myself and wife were looking for a plumbing store in Salmon Arm. EMCO came up on our phone. We googled this store and followed directions. We went to the front counter and we were greeted by a Mr. Ken Stump. Another employee also came out and introduced herself and she showed genuine interest in our 2 small dogs. We were looking for a bathroom sink plumbing part which Ken was able to find. Both staff had the following attributes:

- friendly
- helpful
- honest
- spoke highly of EMCO and the new boss
- encouraged us to return to EMCO in the future

Ironically we now need a new toilet and we will definitely return to EMCO in Salmon Arm for assistance this coming week.  Great store, friendly and  helpful staff and we definitely recommend a trip to this store.

Grant & Kim

reviews.author: Tim Gallant
reviews.text: Extreme Exercise in Frustration. I have purchased a number of items from Emco over the years, so when it came time to renovate my bathroom, that's the first place I went. I was looking for a drop in tub, and all the bathroom fixtures. I was helped by a nice young lady, that I could tell was quite new to the business. I asked her if they had any drop in tubs on display, and was told no. I then started to look at shower and tub faucets. If you have ever been in the store, the first thing you will notice is there are no prices on anything. If you are like me, and not a billionaire, prices effect my buying decisions. I liked a particular line of shower heads and faucets, but none of them had prices on them. I asked the young lady if she could get back to me via email with the prices for the shower heads (about 6 types), and 5' drop in tubs. I left her my card, and left. About a week later I had not heard from her, and phoned back on the status of my prices. She said she had been busy, but would get back to me. I then received a condescending email from a Brian gentlemen whom, I would guess is the manager. He stated that they were not in a position to "price everything in the store". I hardly asked for everything, I merely want to make an informed decision on about 6 to 8 items. I guess business is so good that they don't have to bother with customer requests, it just walks in the door and buys things without asking about the price.

reviews.author: J
reviews.text: Yikes. My experience with this company was less than pleasant. Damaged goods, wrong sizes/quantities and a fair share of obnoxious employees. Normally I'd chalk it up as bad luck or off days but three out three times now this company absolutely blew it. My apologies to the competent people that no doubt work there. I must have missed them.

Employee needs to grow up.

Rode my bike to the recreation center to hit the gym. It was raining and i wanted to keep my bike dry so i parked it beside a wall where there was an overhanging roof. Didnt know that it was emergency parking but regardless the bike was out of the way of all 3 doors and parking for any emergency vehical. I went inside to pay and i was met with probally the most ignorant and power trippy women ive met. As i was paying the lady came up to me told me i couldnt park there and that i needed to move. I was fine with this as i have no problem moving my bike. I told her i would move it after i was done paying. She then decided to get sassy with me and tell me i needed to move it before i even came in and to move it right then and there. I dont know why she felt the need to try and educate me. i responded with "k cool ill move it" as i was getting upset with the way she was talking. I told the front desk lady that i was going to put my stuff down in the gym as it was already all taken out of my bag so i could move my bike. As i went to do that the same sad and power tripping employee came back to tell me to move it now or shes calling a tow truck. This all happened in a matter of 30 seconds so no i wasnt taking my sweet time. I was infuriated and told the employee to calm down and that it is not that deep and im going to move it. She then finnaly proceeded to leave me alone. I find it sad that she felt the need to harass and girlboss an 18 year old boy 3 seperate times about an issue that could have been handled very nicely and easily but i guess maybe working at a pool just isnt for her. I have multiple friends and family who work at that pool and as i live close by thought id use it in support of that. The 2 blonde ladys at the front counter have always been nice to me i dont know how any of the other staff deal with someone like that in the work place so they my respect goes out to them. I thought the pool would be happy that someone under the age of 65 would be using there very run down and very out of date gym but from the way i was treated i dont think the staff care. To that employee i hope you can eventually grow up and learn not to harrass 18 year old boys.

reviews.text: Such a great place to take your kids to burn off energy. They even sell swim diapers for your little one so you don't have to worry about not going through a whole package by the time they outgrow swim diapers. The front desk ladies are lovely and the family change rooms are great too.

reviews.author: Alli
reviews.text: First time there with the inflatable obstacle course,  so much fun for adults and kiddos!

reviews.author: Bobbi Bradley
reviews.text:
Great facility. I stopped in on a Public Swim looking for a hot tub soak, and a sauna sit.
They were near capacity on a Saturday night swim. Matter of Fact if a Family of 3 hadn't just left I wouldn't have been allowed in. So it was up there, but they were doing a good job of keeping track and they had plenty of helpful staff inside the pool area, too. Nice Vibe. A Birthday Party Table was set up, and one part was just those people. It was great to see so many people out enjoying the water. I liked the pool. The Rope was popular, but when the rope was down it was the perfect time to flop into the deep end and do some stretching and floating other deep water play.

I got into the sauna 2xs. It was a good space, that was the right hot. Wasn't sure if the hot tub was gonna be an option, it was near capacity the whole time. But then around 40 minutes left to go, the hot tub nearly emptied out, so a soak I did eventually get. 😁

No photos to add, simply because, no cameras in the bathroom, and I don't do cameras with public pools, cause I'm usually IN the pool. LMFAO. It was a good place with a nice clean washroom, 2 private showers plus 4 or 5 private change stalls, sorry can't recall exactly how many.
There is a No Fragrance Policy, so bring non fragrance shampoos and body washes or you will have to use their product. They do provide a product for washing. I used it to enter the pool, it was good.

Anyhow 50 cents for a locker token, and $6.75 for an Adult Swim.  I think it was more than fair. I will go back.
5 out of 5 for sure.

reviews.author: Brad Madu
reviews.text: Staff is friendly and helpful at the front desk and breakfast room. Rooms were clean an met the expectations of a budget friendly hotel. My lower review comes from several things that went wrong during our stay. The pump for the hot tub broke, the ice machine broke, and we lost water to both the rooms that we booked (I think the latter 2 were connected). Without room water, toilets included, we were required to move our things late one night. I would have said the proximity of the train was a non-issue if we hadn't needed to switch rooms, but the second set of rooms was closer to the tracks and on the upper floor making the trains disruptive to the light sleepers in our group. On checkout we were reimbursed 10% on the day we had to move, but on a 3 night stay this adds up to 3.33% off our bill which was not very noticeable. Certainly less noticeable than the late night move, and lack of amenities. Hard to give a bad review when the people were nice, but it wasn't a great stay and I expected better compensation. Ending on a positive, Breakfast was above my expectations with the usual continental style PLUS the hot foot which was scrambled eggs, sausage, and a waffle station. (Side note to policy makers, if the hot tub had been open, we would have liked to start or end our day with a nice soak. 9am to 9pm doesn't really allow either one to occur.)

reviews.author: Stacey Markin
reviews.text:
Rooms were filthy.  The first room we got put in had hair all over the bed so the staff moved us to another room that didnt allow pets.  This was not better.
Bathroom floors were covered in hair, shower had mold, carpets didnt look like they have been vacuumed in months. Dead bugs in the room. Ants crawling around.  Nothing was wiped down properly.
I would have changed hotels if it werent for our Girls Hockey team having to stay there for a tournament.
I expressed my concerns and was told they would look into it.
If anyone has any respiratory issues, I highly advise NOT staying here.
Never staying here again.

Second night people moved in next door and since there is a door between rooms with a 1 inch gap at the bottom I could hear everything going on next door. Hear their conversation hear their music. Every can opening. When you book a hotel room you should expect privacy. Terrible hotel

reviews.author: Zarley Zaremba
reviews.text:
The room and bed were nice enough. As was the place, and the location next to the Starbucks was good. I was happy with the cleanliness of the bed and for the most part the cleanliness of everything else, but the place has a major problem with Elder Boxbugs.
We killed or threw out of the room at least 20 of them, and I'm sure there were at least twice that number still in the room. I also saw through the windows in the other rooms plenty of the bugs there too. Otherwise I might have ashed for a different room but I didn't think it would help. Thankfully they aren't harmful to people, nor are they looking to do more than hide from the cold, but its just far too many of them. My fiancee stepped on two with her bare feet by accident, when she went to the washroom.
This place needs to reseal their windows and doors and whatnot and try some serious pest control.

reviews.author: Kat Clarke
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here overnight on a road trip and were warmly greeted by the front desk staff. However when we went into our room, we discovered hair all over the bed sheets. We called the front desk and were moved promptly to a new room (which we appreciated and the front desk staff did apologize). However our new room wasn't much better, it wasn't sparkling clean and the bathroom needed some repairs. The exterior hallways were lined with dead bugs and overall we just couldn't wait to leave in the morning. Won't be staying here again: to management, please make sure your rooms are clean before having guests enter or at least offer a refund or lower the room price for poor service.

reviews.author: Denise Butler
reviews.text:
Vella Radio has been an incredible community partner and sponsor of our Ride Don’t Hide fundraiser at Larch Hills for the past two years. Their generous support played a vital role in ensuring the safety and success of our bike ride and walk for mental health.

Vella Radio supplied all of the radios used by our route marshals, allowing our team to stay connected across the trails throughout the event. This reliable communication was essential in creating a safe, well-coordinated, and enjoyable experience for every rider, walker, volunteer, and family member who participated.

Beyond their technical expertise, Vella Radio demonstrates what it truly means to be a community-minded business. Their willingness to support local mental health initiatives shows a genuine commitment to community well-being and collaboration. We are deeply grateful for their partnership and highly recommend Vella Radio to any organization looking for professional service paired with strong community values.

— Canadian Mental Health Association (CMHA), Shuswap–Revelstoke Branch

reviews.text: Tony and his team are 100% top shelf good people! When I arrived it was like being greeted by an old friend. Tony laid out a plan and his team built me a trailer hitch that was perfect in every way! They used bigger better materials, put beautiful gussets in the possible stress points, added beautiful chain rings and the welds were beyond perfect. When everything was said and done the bill I was handed was way less than I was expecting for the highest level of professionalism and craftsmanship I received. Thank you Tony and your great team at Rupp metalworks for saving our butts and turning a bad situation into an amazing experience! And Thankyou Vita for letting me scratch you behind the ears! reviews.author: Bonita Randall
reviews.text:
3 years ago, we made the decision to move from Vancouver to Summerland and build our dream retirement home. We chose to build in Hunter’s Hill development and began to interview recommended builders.

A friend who is an interior designer gave us one piece of advice when we started looking for a builder: “Choose a builder who will build in the style of home you would like to live in”. As soon as we walked into Brandon and Marina Chamberlain’s home (office), we saw first hand a modern home design that we loved. As we viewed other projects that they had recently completed, we realized that they were a team who built in many styles; modern, contemporary, traditional and no matter what the style, the end result was always beautiful. We were always so impressed with each of their past home builds.

Brandon and Marina have an excellent working reputation with clients, sub-contractors, suppliers and local businesses. No matter who we asked, they were well respected in the industry. With all their past custom home experience, they were great planners, scheduling subtrades and Brandon’s crew, and the flow of work was constant. As a result, the house was built on time and on budget.

As it was our first time building a custom home, we sometimes asked them to change something mid build, or add extra’s after plans were finalized. If they could accommodate us, they would. Brandon and Marina had a balanced approach to guiding us and they found ways of finding cost savings without compromising quality. And most importantly, there was always discussion and consolation prior to making changes. We had a running account of our budget which gave us peace of mind.

Brandon only builds quality and takes great pride in his work. If he was not happy with something, he would ask the trades to redo it. He never settled for sub standard work. We’ve been in our home one year now and we experience how well built our home is every day. If there is ever a small adjustment to be made (as there always is in a new build), he is on hand right away and it is fixed. No questions. Only customer satisfaction.

Marina is the behind-the-scenes organizer that give’s life to their projects. She was invaluable to us when it came to offering design ideas, choosing fixtures, lighting, cabinets, colours, flooring, tiles…the list of design choices was never ending. But at each point in the schedule when it came time to ordering, she was there to guide us. Marina is professional, patient, and thoughtful, with a talent for design. She listened to our ideas, offered not one but often additional alternate suggestions, and then would allow us to make final decisions. As a result, our home is stunning and everyone who sees it agrees.

We would highly recommend Chamberlain Builders to anyone who asked. They are a great team and we are so happy we chose them to build our home!

reviews.author: Richard
reviews.text:
Building our retirement home at Hunters Hill in Summerland, BC.

We have been very pleased with our business partnership with Chamberlain Builders.  After interviewing three home building companies, my wife and I had no difficulty selecting Brandon and Marina Chamberlain to build our home.  Chamberlain was one of the builders recommended to us by Hunters Hill development.  Our meetings with Brandon and Marina were very informative about their building process and we could see right from the beginning their commitment and passion about home building.

Each stage of our home building was well explained to us and they kept us informed on the construction progress.  We were also impressed with the professionalism of their construction team and the quality of their sub contractors.

We have now been in our home for one year and we can say that we really appreciate the quality of our home.

We have no hesitation in recommending Chamberlain Builders.  A matter of fact is, that friends of ours upon our recommendation are currently building their home with Chamberlain.

Thank you again Brandon and Marina for all your hard work.

reviews.author: Doris & Kevin Grieve
reviews.text:

He asked careful questions on-site before taking time to digest the design plan, access points and geotechnical requirements to inform the approach and timeline to efficiently complete the retaining wall and set us up for success for future phases. Despite several challenging aspects (i.e. access, condition of the site on arrival, size of the wall, etc.), the crew finished on schedule with no surprises or stress - seamlessly passing our geotechnical gates and final inspections, while also delivering a truly magnificent retaining wall. Dave's attention to detail and foresight also means that we are well set-up to seamlessly roll into the next phase (i.e. landscaping, railings, irrigation).

Working with Rocks in Stones was a complete pleasure from start to finish - we couldn't be happier with the outcome and will definitely working with them again.

reviews.text: I usually dont write a review but I had to for this one so you know its a gooder!! 😊 I needed to take my family here after experiencing it for ouselves.. (my fiance proposed to me here 2 years ago) my brother and sister in law are from new zealand and knew we had some big scene shoes to fill lol and La Punta did not disappoint!! First off everyone was incredibly kind and accommodating to us.. we booked 2 rooms for 5 adults and a chihuahua so we were in a pet friendly room which was adorable! Mexican themed.. very comfortable bed.. very clean.. incredible view.. spacious.. private hot tub on each deck with table and chairs.. enough room for the 5 of us (6) to visit.. other room had 3 adults.. mil slept on an extremely comfortable cot.. she was impressed.. my sil swam everyday in the pool cause it was perfect temp for her and very clean.. we even napped on the comfy chairs around the pool.. so relaxing.. ☺️ a walk around the property was so beautiful and gazebo was stunning.. we went into summerland peachland and penticton as everything is extremely close to the Inn! Loved that we were left alone to our holiday unless we needed something.. cant wait to go back! Even some wedding planning talk cause there's nowhere else id rather spend our special day 😊 (July 2025)

reviews.author: Lis
reviews.text:
I can sum up La Punta Norte in one word: peculiar. First the pros. The location is ‘hidden’, private, peaceful and presents an unobstructed, absolutely stunning view of Okanagan Lake. The place is constructed and designed In a rustic, Mexican hacienda style. The vibe is casual, and you can feel as if you’re alone in a Nevada desert, with the entire place to yourselves – which we did, for a time – it is so quiet.

Now, onto the cons. First, there is no service nor any amenities at La Punta Norte; no housekeeping, no concierge, check-in, or information services, no cooking facilities, no dining area, no convenience or grocery stores, restaurants or shops of any kind nearby. The rooms were clean, but very rundown, dark and dingy, with sparse furnishings (just a bed and wardrobe) and tacky, mismatched decor.

The bed was comfortable enough – but the linens were old and worn, and the four towels looked like they’d been around for a decade or more. There were no toiletries at all except for a bottle of ‘Life’ brand body wash and hand soap. But worst of all was the water. There was a foul odor coming from the bathroom faucet, each time it was turned on. We figured something was stuck (maybe dead?) in the plumbing and so we used bottled water to wash, as there is no other running water available in the room.

The outdoor area was especially neglected, with just two dilapidated, old lawn chairs next to a small, badly stained, unheated pool. There was a dirty, broken old washing machine, an ancient-looking bbq, and a loud generator in the covered ‘lounge’ area, and four or five large, empty flower boxes half-filled with dirt and weeds.

It was clear that La Punta Norte has been derilect and poorly managed to the extreme. It’s sad and unfortunate, as we could imagine its once-upon-a-time splendour, along with that majestic view….

reviews.author: Donna Kowbel
reviews.text: My husband and I got to spend one night at this magical place. We loved having our own private hot tub on our own private deck looking over the lake. Our host, Kelly was lovely. Upon arrival, she greeted us so quickly and showed us around. She took us to our room, and then left us alone to enjoy our beautiful evening, and let us know that if we needed anything or had any questions, she was there to help. We felt right at home and the room was so clean and cozy. We headed in to Penticton for dinner, but the Inn has a BBQ area if you'd prefer to stick around and make your own meals. reviews.text:
After reading the most recent review of this business, my experience makes a lot more sense.

I called to ask about having my windshield replaced, and the woman who answered said, “Depends if and when I can get one brought in.” I waited, expecting her to tell me the next steps, offer a rough timeline, or even book a tentative appointment—but she didn’t. Instead, she said, “Umm, hello?” like she thought I had hung up. I replied, “Okay, let’s do it” and she took down my vehicle information. She said she’d contact her vendors to see when she could get the glass and would call me back—but she never did.

There was no indication of how long it might take, no offer to book anything in the meantime, and overall, the interaction made me feel like my business wasn’t wanted. She genuinely sounded annoyed to even be answering the phone.

reviews.author: Frank Martens
reviews.text:
I took in four old basement windows that needed glass replacement and left them outside in the truck.  The only people in the place were two ladies, who weren't even at the desk in front, obviously hiding in the coffee room.  I asked one of them to    take a look at the windows to see if they could replace the glass.  One small dirty window was on top of the other so needed to be lifted up to see if the lower window needed some new glass.  When she hesitated, I said "It's only dirt."  She huffed indignantly and said, "I'm not doing that.  Take them someplace else," and stomped back into the shop.
I suggest the shop owner should seriously think about replacing some help.

Update to this review: Over a month after posting this review, the manager did reach out to me and said he would be glad to trade out any of the boards I didn't like, and would even send a truck with an exchange (it is over an hour drive and we had rented a car carrier to transport our order that included 20 foot boards.) Unfortunately it was too late, as I had already spent many hours sanding, filling and then finishing the boards which were mostly installed by then. (Our previous purchase of fence boards had been during Covid and access to the yard had been limited limited so they had packaged them for us and we had picked them up already on a pallet.) We went back for some additional boards and they allowed us to pick through the piles this time. I did find that some board sizes had better quality than others and the fence boards seemed to be the most consistantly free of major blemishes and distortion.

Original review:

So incredibly disappointed. I wrote a 5 star review for them 2 years ago (which I have since deleted) after we bought the material for our fence. It was high quality and very consistant. I didn't do any sanding to make it ready to finish.  So much better than the box stores. Customer service was excellent. Two years later the fence still looks great.

So I talked my husband into doing a cedar deck instead of a "plastic one" and ordered 2 x 6 boards in 12', 16' and 20' lengths (500 SF). You don't get to pick your boards, they just load them for you. I feel like we got the reject pile. As this is a deck, only one side has to be "good" but when you inspect each board and can't decide which is the "good" side, that isn't good. Ends of some of these boards were so ragged, but they are true to size, so you will lose at least 1/2 inch off to make them usable. There are so many defects on each side. I was going to use an expensive tinted oil finish on them, but when I did 2 test boards they looked horrible even after I hand sanded with 220 grit. (See photo - board at top is 5/4 board which was much better than the other two are 2x6x12.) I just realized I will need to sand extensively over 100 boards with my orbital sander and 120 grit to get them just decent to finish. Side edges are splintered on both sides in some cases, lots of knots and manufacturing gouges , scratches and burns. I am looking at another 20 or more hours or so to get these board to a decent level,  but still not what I expected from Cedar Solutions. I will be changing my finish choice to at least a semi transparent to hide a lot of the flaws. Wow, so disappointed and discouraged!  They got 2 stars because I know the big box stores would have been worse but I would have sorted through the sad piles.  I looked whistfully at the "plastic" decking as I went to buy sand paper at Rona today. Apologies to my hubbie for insisting on real wood!

I have some kitchen cabinets from Kekuli.
There was off-gassing from the melamine lining inside the drawers and cabinets. It wasn't strong, but it was noticeable.

I thought over time the off-gassing would dissipate like a paint smells do. Unfortunately, after a reasonable time, the off-gassing continues.

I contacted Kekuli and asked them if the off-gassing was a health issue and what can be done to remove it.

It took them a good week to reply, and what they replied with was a "Google search result", and a page copied from some regulations that refer to allowable off-gassing.

Essentially, they tried to evade accountability to their product, and tried to pass it off to some no-name person on the Internet that had no experience in cabinet making. This also showed they are clueless to how to deal with off-gassing, yet they use the melamine product regardless.

After all the years they have in the business and using melamine, one would think they would have established a solid reliable protocol to deal with persistent off-gassing. Obviously, they haven't, and that shows me they don't care because their attempted reliance on a Google search was very unprofessional.

The legal document they sent showed me they want no responsibility to their product, using it to justify their use of the product.

In short, I was being brushed off and never got answers for legitimate concerns about their products.

Kekuli Cabinets do not stand behind their products.
They are not professional, have zero customer service, and are clueless to any home managing methods to issues created by the material they use.

That is what their response to my legitimate concern had shown.
This also shows their attitude toward their business, which says the products they make are not reliable because they won't stand behind them and be professional about it.

If it was possible to give No Stars, I would have done that.

reviews.author: AbHobbyist
reviews.text:
This Review is for Mike at POLYGUARD for the coating of our new-construction garage and Shop floor coatings.

Mike presented the product (both Pro’s & Con’s) was comprehensive and easily understood.  The work and installation/application of the product was excellent, timely and on budget.  My wife and I are very pleased with the final product and thus I would not hesitate to recommend Mike!!  Our experience with him and Polygard.Ca goes something like this....

Upon completion of our new house in Mid November we knew that we wanted something better then standard sealed concrete floors in both in the garage and the shop working areas.  On discussing this with our builder Mike & Polygard were recommended to us.

A few days after our first contact, Mike personally visited us at our new home, had a look at the area to be coated and took some measurements.  We then spent the next hour going over the different coating options and Mike patiently answered all of our questions.  We settled on a Polyurea Coating for both the garage  and the shop areas which amounted to 1,225 square feet.  We did have an issue in that the shop area was currently being used for storage.  Mike has a easy solution in the he would coat the garage floor first, give it about 36 hrs to cure, and then we could move all the “stuff” from the shop to the garage, and this way we would not need to store anything out side and worry about weather conditions.  We really appreciated this accommodation on Mikes part.

So we Scheduled the first round for Tuesday November 14, with round 2 for Friday November 17, 2023. Both Day Mike and his Two man crew arrived 10 minutes early, and were finished by about 1:00 pm.  The finish was excellent and it really elevated and made both spaces much more attractive and functional. The prep-work (including a couple of minor concrete repairs) and application of the coating were efficient and expertly done!!

So again I would not hesitate to recommend Mike and the POLYGUARD crew!!

Thank you for taking the time to read my review.

Regards

AbH

reviews.text:
These guys are as good as it gets in Vernon. I’ve used them for all my HVAC, plumbing, and heating needs for the past five years. Early on, I unfortunately tried Aslan and Fox on two separate occasions and was left disappointed, which only reinforced how solid Vernon Air Conditioning, Plumbing & Electrical Services really is.

Their technicians consistently deliver top-notch work, act professionally, and go above and beyond. They’re friendly, knowledgeable, and clearly take pride in what they do.

That said, their quoting process is confusing — and, in my case, misleading. I requested a quote for a job and received one promptly, only to discover after all the work was completed and invoices submitted that the quote covered only “stage one” of a two-stage job. This wasn’t made clear upfront as a second quote for “stage two” was never provided. No one has been able to adequately explain how or why this happened, and the owner openly acknowledged that their quotes can be confusing and that their quoting system may need improvement moving forward.

Unfortunately, this left me with over $2,000 in unexpected charges for “stage two” of a job I reasonably believed had already been quoted. Who quotes only half a job?

Bottom line: the work is excellent, and I genuinely like and respect this company. I hope to continue using them for years to come. However, I won’t rely on their quotes again — I’ll treat pricing as a gamble and hope it works out better than a weekend in Vegas.

reviews.text: I have 20+ years as a Purchasing manager and Jason is one of the most honest contractors I have ever dealt with. In ending I would simply re-state what I said in the beginning of this review, should you need work done in connection with your deck / patio areas of your home or need work done on a railing system you would be hard pressed to find a better company than VinDeck Service to use for your project.

reviews.author: Marion da Ponte
reviews.text: We were so impressed by Mike Sochan of Vinyl Valley Deck and Rail. We had been wanting to have our old vinyl decking replaced and did not know where to turn. We are located at Big White and it can be challenging to have certain work done due to our location. I posted our query to the community Facebook page hoping someone could make a recommendation. Within 15 minutes Mike had reached out and we arranged for him to see our project the very next day. He was punctual, communicative, knowledgeable and personable. He provided a quote on the spot and he was able to accommodate our timing and he began demo/prep work on Labour Day.  He returned the next day to finish and our new deck looks great. We are very happy with Mike’s workmanship and professionalism. It was a pleasure to have Mike execute our project and I would use him again in a heartbeat for any future decking or railing needs. Thank you Mike!

reviews.author: K M
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a new deck, make Mike your first call! As a local, second-generation vinyl expert, he knows exactly how to navigate a construction project from start to finish. Mike is friendly, attentive, and quick to create custom solutions when needed. He recommended what's best for us and our situation. His craftsmanship is unmatched, and he works with a skilled group of other local trades to ensure every aspect of your deck is handled with professionalism and expert care.

reviews.author: Jim Wilson
reviews.text: Meeting up with Mike was a very positive experience. He was quick, on time and very professional. He explained the process as he was doing a quick fix for us. He was doing the repair to get us through winter before replacing the whole deck. I would not hesitate to recommend Mike.

reviews.author: Shari
reviews.text: I can’t express enough how grateful we are for finding Mike. We reached out to several businesses in Kelowna and no one got back to us. We happened to be driving behind a Vinyl Valley Decks truck and took a chance reaching out. Not only did Mike get back to us promptly, he set up a time to come check out our issue right away. Mike travelled from Vernon to Kelowna just to have a look at our deck. Mike didn’t pressure us to replace our deck but instead gave us options to extend the life of our deck to save us money. From the time we reached out to Mike to having our deck patched and good to go was less than a week! There is no doubt we will be using this company when it’s time to fully replace the vinyl on our deck. A million thank you’s Mike!!!!

reviews.text: I use Mike  as a subcontractor on all my vinyl installations. I've gone through a lot of vinyl deck installers in 10 years, Mike's eye for quality is second to none.

reviews.author: K M
reviews.text:
Our experience with Dave was outstanding. Before contacting him for an estimate, we reached out to several larger companies in the area. They sent sales representatives with polished pitches and elaborate samples, but none took the time to inspect what we already had in the house, and all quotes came in at the high end.

After a friend recommended Dave, we gave him a call. He arrived promptly, walked us through our existing setup, listened carefully to our goals, and proposed a solution that fit our budget. With his lower overhead and strong supplier relationships, his pricing was extremely competitive.

When the work was scheduled, there was a slight delay due to a previous project - which happens. Dave communicated the updated timeline as soon as it was available and kept us informed every step of the way.

My wife and I found Dave to be professional, detail-oriented (including matching new frames to existing ones elsewhere in the house), friendly, and reliable. We would confidently recommend his services and plan to call him again once we’re ready to replace a few remaining windows.

His attention to detail, quality workmanship, and positive attitude made a lasting impression. Whether you need flooring, deck repairs, or new installations, I highly recommend Dave—he’s the one to call. Five stars all around, and I’ll definitely be working with him again in the future.
