reviews.author: Rob Quon
reviews.text:
We have been in our Brentwell home for about 8 months now. I wanted to truly get a feel of it before this review.
After the relationship with our initial builder ended due to an RDCO investigation, we found that we were back at ground zero and our possession plans were at risk of being delayed.
We had learned about Brentwell while visiting the area and finding out that they had already completed several homes in the subdivision. A call to Matt and he confirmed that he would be able to take on our project and could start within the month. He thoughtfully was able to accommodate us with compassion to our negative experience.
Because we resided 3 provinces away much of our communication was done through email and we had to trust that the finish product would meet our expectations. The entire office staff worked with us to deliver updates and finalise finishes.
During the build any misunderstandings were quickly corrected keeping the customers' happiness as a top concern.
We couldn't be happier with the outcome and finishes of our home. The project was completed on time and under budget which was money in our pocket.
I would recommend this builder. They have a solid reputation in the Okanagan area.

reviews.text:
Dressel Built Homes truly restored my faith in a flawed industry. We found Kalib through a recommendation from a close friend who has worked with dozens of builders over the course of his life. Even with that referral, we were hesitant. At that point, we genuinely felt that all builders were the same.

We were coming off a horrendous experience and had fired our previous builder after extensive errors and repeated crises early in the project. Every builder we met with afterward raised red flags. They profit on making the build more expensive or prolonging it, and after what we had just been through, we weren’t willing to “just trust” that someone would do the right thing. That mindset had already burned us once and cost us an incredible amount of time, money, and stress.

What set Kalib apart immediately was that Dressel Built Homes operates on a fixed management structure and had incredible references. There was no financial benefit to increasing costs or slow-rolling the build- something we did not encounter with a single other builder.

Kalib is consistently available, present on site, and communicates based on what you ask of him- no pressure, no vague answers, just clarity and follow-through. He works hard to obtain multiple quotes, advocates for fair pricing, and has saved us money in countless aspects of our build without ever sacrificing proven quality work.

I’ve always believed that good people do well in contracting when they act with transparency and integrity, and Kalib is the epitome of that belief. He is honest, accountable, and deeply committed to doing things the right way. I wouldn’t hesitate for a second to recommend him, and I will choose Dressel Built Homes for every home I build in my lifetime.

Thank you for everything!

reviews.author: Mathias Fellenz
reviews.text:
Over the last winter we contracted All Pro to do the snow clearing for our long gravel driveway.  Even after showing the driver where to place the snow he would often push the snow into areas where we had garden plantings or grass.  The driver always came in the dark as we were low priority on their schedule and we would wait from 10-18 hours for the driveway to be cleared.  Probably because of the dark the driver dislodged numerous stones that lined our garden bed.

The real challenge came in springtime when the snow melted and we discovered the driver had set his snow blade too low.  We found the gravel of the driveway was now spread out over the adjacent lawn.  The company was slow to respond and a man was sent over only today to try to rectify the situation.  Within a minute of arriving he yelled at me and insisted that his company had not caused the problem.

I would not recommend this company for snow clearance for the issues noted above.

The price came lower than quoted as they worked fast and efficiently! Rick is very kind and professional! We will work with them again. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gord Nixon
reviews.text:
To prevent heavy rains washing away our driveway several times a year I had Bear Paw Earthworks install a concrete dry well with an overflow pit and resurface the driveway.   Glen was the project manager who came on site and spent the time with me to determine the scope of the project.  He was very attentive with follow up questions as we finalized the project details.  Luke was the operator who installed the dry well and overflow pit.  Once that work was done, he spread the new top coating on the driveway. I always appreciate contractors like Luke who show up on time, work a full day and are good communicators. Happy to report that about 10 days late we had a wicked rainstorm and that everything worked as planned with the dry well and overflow pit dissipating the heavy rain with no washing away of the driveway.

The office staff was also friendly and helpful to complete the project paperwork.

I selected Bear Paw Earthworks because they are a family owed business that has operated since 1979.  Their price was fair, and the workmanship was exceptional!

I would highly recommend them for all residential services and would agree with the statement on their website “Hire Us To Get the Job Done!”

reviews.text: We found Evan when we were looking for a contractor to rebuild a retaining wall across the front of our property. He listened to our ideas and was able to provide us with a solution that both fit our budget and our vision of the project. Evan’s communication throughout the project was excellent. He met us on site for consultation and throughout the project he regularly updated us with pictures and video calls to show the progress. We are extremely happy with the end result. It turned out much better than we anticipated. We would highly recommend Evan and Dirt Nerd Contracting and will definitely call him back for our next project.

reviews.author: Glenda Lavallee
reviews.text:
Rave for Dirt Nerd Earthworks: we had a window well outside our basement window that was threatening to let go and crash through our basement window at any time. Thanks to Evan, the Dirt Nerd and his crew who took it all apart, block by block, and rebuilt it, block by block. Having carefully taken it apart, they saved and re-used the same blocks, saving us a bundle of money. The excavator operator (Quinn) operated his machine with the precision of a surgeon. He didn't damage a single block or make a single scratch on our house.
Rob, the block guy, re-installed the blocks and did a great job. He explained to us why the wall had failed and what had been done wrong when it was initially built. Having watched the daily progress of the project, we are very impressed by the professionalism of the Dirt Nerd team, and we are very confident that this window well and pony wall will be here long after we are gone. We are completely satisfied with the price we paid for this project and the peace of mind it gives us, knowing that this time it has been done right and won't crash through our basement window. A great big thank-you to the Dirt Nerd team, Evan, Quinn, and Rob for a job well done! Below is a picture of the before and 2 pictures of the after.

reviews.text: Elke is a wonderful landscape designer and consultant and is extremely knowledgeable, listens to what you are looking to achieve and takes it to the next level. reviews.author: Renee Riopelle
reviews.text:
Excellent experience with Elke.  Being new to the Okanagan, I had no idea what to plant and no gardening experience.  All I knew for sure was I had a big pile of dirt!!!  Elke assessed the area, direction of sun, sprinkler system, took measurements.  She also saw the interior of my home and decided what look would 'flow' from the inside to outside...like art.  Then she hatched a plan.  We met at a nursery, she went over all the plant options/varietals and allowed me to be part of the decision making process.  I loved it!  AND (a big AND) she stopped me from overplanting!

After all selections were made and plants delivered, Elke placed each and every 115 potted plants to match her design vision.  Because I wanted to plant myself, she guided me through the planting process.  Hole depth, veggie mix, fill, then mulch.  I watered and loved per her instructions and voila! It only took two summers to have a fabulous front yard!

Look out back yard...Elke and I are coming for you summer 2021!!

Thanks Elke, renee and david

reviews.text: Elke was wonderful to work with.  We recently moved into a new house whose front and back yard was a blank canvas.  We didn't really know what we wanted, just what we didn't want! reviews.author: Sonja Ogden
reviews.text:
Our friends highly recommended Peacock Landscaping to fix our botched backyard patio that had been done by a previous landscaper 2 years ago.
From the initial meeting with Allyson to completion was a breeze!
The patio needed a retaining wall to hold the pavers in place. The first landscaping company used rocks which caused the pavers to crack and slip away.
We originally discussed to remove half of the patio pavers and build it up with the retaining wall and reuse the pavers.
Turns out all the pavers had to be removed because the ground was never prepped properly by the first landscaper.
Curtis went over the errors in detail and explained exactly how the ground should be prepped.
The pavers that the previous landscape company used was from Rona and it wasn’t a high quality product so we chose to upgrade to a 4” paver with a high design look.
The guys worked full days (which is very rare in the Okanagan) and the job was completed in 6 days!
We are so incredibly happy with our new beautiful designed patio & everyone at Peacock Landscaping

reviews.text:
I called the plumming service for a water leak from my bathroom on Wednesday. They come to fix, it gets better but still leak. I called them back after a day, they told us to come the next day, but cancelled and rebooked on the following Tuesday. Then I waited until 1pm on Tuesday and they called to rebook on Wednesday but we have to delay to Friday as our schedule is pretty tight with work and children. It is the first time I gave a bad review for a local service like this. Very disappointed!
Couple hours after the review, I got a call from a lady from the company. She told me the review was unfair for them as the miscommunication between me, the receiptionist and my husband. After a while, the lady blamed me that I misunderstood her, another man jumped on and said that I didn’t listen to them, talked to much and I didn’t communicate as human being. How fun the story is! They hung up my phone with the last sentence “we’re done the service with you”. I would like to laugh as human beings provided incompleted service, called and discussed with non-human being. It was such an interesting phone negotiation! Good luck for all!
This is my last post about your response.
I understand your business should build the trust to client. However, you miscomunicated with clients twice, the first time was when I booked the service, and the second time was when I called to ask you come back. Today, after my review, you called and kept blaming us about missing communication. I remembered on the phone you told me you would come on Monday, I gave you my husband’s phone to call him to contact when your crew came. It was end up that you left a message to him that you couldn’t come on Monday. He called you back on the same day, and you asked him to come on Tuesday noon. We agreed with the appointment and I waited until 1pm, then my husband got a phone call from you at 1pm saying that you couldn’t come.  How good communication you gave the client! you told me rude on the phone but you and your cowooker kept fighting back to me on the phone, gave me the best phrase of “not communicate as human beings”. Thanks for your clarification and definition about rudeness and human being’s communication!
If your call after the review was more reasonable and negotiable instead of blaming, using impressed phrases, the matter would be less stress for both.
I end this game here. Thanks again for an interesting experience!

Making sure that what we were billed for had been completed, and he pretty much talked to me like I was an idiot. Our contents were put in boxes, tons of things missed off the contents list. It has been 2 months, and no one has contacted me except to get the remainder of the payment, which is being held back due to complaint and concerns that the work hasn't fully been completed. I would NOT recommend Stutters, and if I could go back to February, I would not choose Stutters. The amount of back and forth to them regarding our contents list was ridiculous. Review update:
I received an email from James Vogan on July 20 2022 that said himself and the franchise owner had reviewed our situation and that they had agreed to make it right. After a couple of more emails to make arrangements James and another gentleman were here on July 28 and spent the entire day. They did an amazing job! A complete opposite of our first experience. This time we were expecting just another spray but they did the job exactly as the website describes, maybe even better, the moss was completely removed, the gutters were vacuumed, the roof was cleaned and sprayed, they even cleaned all the debris from the driveway and I’m sorry if I missed anything else they might have done.The job really was excellent and exactly what you would expect from professionals.
This has now turned into a great experience and I would have no problem at all highly recommending James and team. Thank you guys, this was very appreciated!!!!
Original review:
We had Troy from Gorilla Property Services in Vernon quote our strata for moss removal expecting the job to be done as illustrated on their website, moss removed with before and after photos. After the job was done we were surprised to see that the moss was in fact not removed but instead Troy said that they don’t do that anymore and that they only spray for moss because that’s the best thing to do. The moss was supposed to dry up and fall off on its own and not to worry there is a one year warranty anyway. Well almost a year later and I had to try four times, two emails, left a phone message, and left a message on the Gorilla website before James Vogan replied in an email that literally only said “Troy no longer owns the business” when I replied asking if that means Gorilla won’t honor their warranty he answered with
“Unfortunately I cannot help you out with this as I was not the person responsible for applying the product. You would have to reach out to Troy regarding this matter.“ so that was super helpful ( NOT). Very disappointed with Gorilla and all the promises of great customer service, now we are out $1400.00 still have moss on our roof. Thanks for nothing Gorilla that’s just f….n fantastic!

reviews.author: Ray Dobson
reviews.text: Brought my motor home in to have a new windshield installed.  After paying the bill, I got halfway to the vehicle when the employee who did the work came along side me and said "you need a new driver's side mirror".  I thought I misheard him, so I replied "what was that?".  He repeated "you need a new driver's side mirror".  I then responded "why would I need a new mirror".  He then said "I moved the vehicle and hit a post".  He then proceeded to the mirror and literally ripped off the broken piece of mirror.  He then said "get it fixed and bring us the bill and we will reimburse you".  He then walked away, but when he was about 10' away he said, over his shoulder, "if I have time I"ll see if I can find the part".  This is the total conversation between us.  Not once did he apologize or say he was sorry, and the whole time he acted with attitude towards me, as if it was my fault.  I had to drive the motor home home with no side mirror, obviously very dangerous.  I removed the mirror and discovered that the plastic housing that the mirror attaches to was also damaged (not just the glass).  I went online but realized I had better phone the manufacturer of the mirror because it was a little ambiguous as to the product I should order.  I placed the order and then a week later the same OK Glass employee phoned me to say "I've got you part, bring in the unit and I'll install it".  I responded "You told me to fix it, so I have already ordered the part".  He then said "ok, by the way, how much did it cost"?  I said "I don't know the exact cost, but I think a little over $200".  His response was "woh"!  I knew from his response that he had only ordered the glass.  I have since found a fairly large grease stain on the driver's floor mat that I will have to deal with.  I have dealt with OK Glass a number of times over the years, but never again.

reviews.author: CS
reviews.text:
We initially had Stenno,a Carpenter from Total Restoration fabricate our bathroom vanity,but he built it 8 inches higher than the standard height for a bathroom vanity height.Add the thickness of the countertop and it was way too high for kids and shorter people.We rejected the unit Stenno built and we went to Home Hardware on Springfield Rd and spoke with Candace Jean and she ordered us up a beautiful hardwood vanity in the shade we wanted and it was perfect!She initially had us set up with Colonial Countertops to build our countertop but they have a very poor reputation and very old machinery so we would never support them.They treat their employees very poorly as well.We had our Project Manager contact Norelco Cabinets 4 times by phone and email but they never responded.They prefer to only deal with large jobs and businesses.They won't bother with small residential jobs.We found out this information from other people so we would never support this business either.They don't care about customers who have small jobs to be done,they won't bother to help you.
Candace suggested we talk to Antonio Infanti and he fabricated our countertop through Canada Cabinet and it was absolutely perfect!We couldn't have asked for a nicer looking or better fitting countertop.He was extremely fast,professional and efficient.Extremely skilled and was so concerned about building us exactly what we wanted.Just the most awesome person,he is just fabulous!My family and I are extremely impressed with how quickly Antonio fabricated and installed our countertop.We could never have asked for a better person for this job!Thank you Antonio and Canada Cabinet for your extreme professionalism,speed,quality and customer service!We would never go anywhere else for the services you provide!
It was really a shame that Stenno built such a poorly designed custom built vanity and supplied us with a kitchen countertop from Home Depot in Kelowna.It was so embarrassing when other contractors and friends and family members saw what Total Restoration had initially supplied us for our bathroom rebuild.
We are extremely happy with Candace Jean from Home Hardware ordering us exactly what we wanted and referring us to Antonio and Canada Cabinet.We are extremely happy with how our bathroom rebuild went.
Customer First Plumbing did all our Plumbing and HVAC work and installed our bathroom toilet,sink and drain piping as well as our laundry room wash tub and drain piping,replaced our hot water tank and rebuilt our furnace ductwork after having Alif from Ready Set Flow severely damage our hot  water tank and furnace ductwork.It was a real nightmare having Alif as our initial Plumbing/HVAC technician.
We weren't happy with Walter from Twinstar Contracting as he took an extremely long time doing the painting of of walls at our residence.He is an extremely slow worker.He doesn't care about his customers,his quality is not as good as other companies,especially when paying good money for a quality job,in which he didn't do.Stay away from this company.
We are extremely happy we had such great contractors and only Alif from Ready Set Flow,Stenno from Total Restoration and Walter from Twinstar
Contracting who were terrible at their jobs.
We will definitely be supporting Antonio and Canada Cabinet for future work done on our home.Thank you to everyone!

reviews.author: Anton “Tony” Piwek
reviews.text: We contacted Okanagan Ceiling Refinishers for a quote regarding a hairline crack in our great room ceiling. Brad promptly returned our inquiry and through a review of detailed pictures was able to give us a reasonable quote on what the repair would cost but more importantly instilled confidence that their team would do it properly.  Within a few days, the work was scheduled and their team (Jonathan and Julius) arrived early to complete the work. Jonathan and Julius were absolutely outstanding from the moment they arrived at our home. They were meticulous in how they approached their work; carefully isolating the area below and around the ceiling repair to contain dust and/or debris. The repair itself was completed to the highest standard to ensure there would be no further issue (cracking due to poor taping). Once the ceiling repair was completed, the area had to be resprayed and blended to match the rest of the ceiling (with 2-3 days to dry properly). This is where Jonathan and Julius demonstrated their artisan skills by making it impossible to see where the repair work was completed - blended perfectly with the rest of the ceiling! They exceeded our expectations. I highly recommend Okanagan Ceiling Refinishers for any ceiling repairs.

reviews.author: Keith Meldrum
reviews.text: Okanagan Ceiling Refinishers was referred by our painting contractor. We are doing a full kitchen renovation and the new layout differs significantly from the old one. When the house was built, architectural bulkheads were constructed at the ceiling to define the kitchen layout. As the new layout is completely different, we needed to remove the bulkheads and have the ceiling repaired. Complicating this issue is the fact that the entire main floor of the house was finished with a knockdown texture finish. Due to the change in the texture material used, it was not possible to patch the ceiling as it would always be noticeable and as the kitchen area is open to the family room and an open hallway, there was no way to delineate the kitchen area for a different type of ceiling finish. Therefore, we had all the textured ceiling finish removed and then redone. Now that it is finished, it looks like it was always this way and the new knock-down finish matches the rest of the rooms in the house. Before undertaking the kitchen, family room, and hall we had the ensuite done as well as it is also renovated; it turned out perfectly. During the work, the floors were fully protected, the walls were fully draped in plastic, and they were able to keep the mess and dust to a minimum. After they were done they did a thorough cleaning. Their workmanship and skills were excellent; they paid close attention to detail, and they were very polite and professional.

I don't understand why this company only has 11 reviews. Alex and his team are one of the most competent, professional, and hard working crews I've ever dealt with.

Our water mainline had burst. I called for someone to come out to take a look. Alex showed up right away to come give us a quote. Right out of the gate, he knew what needed to be done and broke down the price ranges depending on different variables that could happen while the work was being done.  He spoke with confidence that reassured us that we would be taken care of.

During that visit he explained to us how to get water to our house temporarily and even provided us with a inspection report to give to the insurance company, before we even agreed to have the work done by them. He gave us a price, we shopped around, and ultimately found that they were the route to take.

They pulled all the permits needed to get the work started, organized the home inspection after the work was completed, installed all the necessary hardware so our water system was up to code, and cleaned up the mess that ultimately comes from a job like this. It was a very seamless operation. Unfortunately our site proved to be difficult, and the bill was at the top of the spectrum, but it wasn't anything we weren't prepared for after the initial visit.

The crew worked hard, didn't mind me watching or asking questions while the work was being done, and were actively problem solving when things weren't going right. Kudos to them.

I will confidently recommend them to anyone in need of their services.

Steve's entire team came out and they had dug out, replaced the line, and moved the water meter all in one day. They came the next morning to backfill in the excavated land. reviews.author: Katy Wilson
reviews.text:
Unfortunately I have to update my 5 star review based on my recent experience here.

I previously gave Car Key Pro 5 stars, but unfortunately my last visit was beyond disappointing. I took my truck in with squeaky brakes, figuring it needed new pads. I was called that afternoon and told it had wheel bearing issues on both rear tires, and that they didn’t yet know what the squeaking was but they needed to keep it until the next afternoon to fix the bearings. I mentioned that I needed it for work the next morning, but he was insistent that it was a safety issue as a wheel could come off, and as it was already on the hoist they wanted to keep it and start work on it. The only reason I agreed to leave it overnight was because I was worried about the wheel safety issue. I let him know I would have to rent a uhaul to work the next morning.

The next day he called me mid morning to tell me he had made a mistake and mixed my car issue up with another similar car. The other car had the wheel bearing issue and mine just needed all the brake pads replaced. When I went to pick up the vehicle I asked about a discount on account of the fact his mistake had cost me $100 for a uhaul. He argued that he wasn’t going to give any discount as he had just mixed up the cars, that mine was cheaper than he quoted as it wasn’t the wheel bearings after all, and that I had needed to leave it overnight as I had no brake pads anyway (I would have booked in for another day for the brake pads, they were not at emergency/safety issue level).

He also told me that the brake pads had been put on incorrectly previously. I reminded him that they had in fact replaced my pads less than 5 months ago, so he went to talk to the mechanic and when he returned, he stated that the right side was clipped so it must be a caliper issue and they need to be replaced. Why wasn’t this caliper issue picked up on when they were replacing the pads?? Shouldn’t that be the first thing checked if you see uneven wear? I find that very concerning, and it just topped off an already horrible experience. Now I will likely have to get the brake pads replaced again in a very short time, along with the caliper, costing me even more money unnecessarily.

Mistakes happen, I get that. It’s not about the mistake, but what the business will do in response to that. If you make a mistake that costs your customer money, any place with decent customer service would try to rectify that. Instead I was met with a rude, dismissive response and won’t be returning here.

Previous review - 5 stars
I've had issues with my ignition previously - the key struggles to turn sometimes so I can't turn the car on. A few months ago, I took it into Nissan after having the problem all week - that morning it took 30 minutes for me to even be able to get it started and over to Nissan. They were very quick to tell me they couldn't find an issue ( it has been off and on, but as I use the truck for work everyday, not an issue I can afford to risk happening again and again). reviews.author: ROLI
reviews.text:
I lived in Skyline rental buildings for 2 years, and from the very beginning it was nothing but problems.

Initially, we were promised a different building, a ground-floor unit, and one year of free parking. However, at the last moment, Tina changed the plans and moved us to another building where the rent was higher and underground parking was paid. We were not informed in advance about any of these changes. Tina assured us that everything was the same and all prices were identical, which turned out to be false — we ended up paying more.

After living there for two years, the rent was increased to $2000 for a one-bedroom apartment, which is absolutely unreasonable for the condition of the building.

In December, my car was damaged in the outside parking, even though it was parked directly under security cameras. No video footage was ever provided. The manager only said that she saw the car, but refused to give any evidence or explain who caused the damage.

There were ongoing issues with water billing. We did not use much water, yet were charged as if we had very high usage. The water meter readings never made sense.

The hallways were constantly dirty, and the apartment itself was also dirty upon move-in. Maintenance and cleanliness standards are very poor.

The elevator barely worked, realistically only about 15 days per month, which was extremely inconvenient.

Another major issue was neighbors smoking marijuana inside their apartments. The smell was overwhelming and constant, making it very uncomfortable to live there.

Would I recommend renting from Skyline? Absolutely not.

reviews.author: S N
reviews.text: useless management does not know how to properly vet tenants. apartment was not cleaned upon move in and tina was condescending when it was brought to her attention and told me to clean it myself. sandra the higher up manager is also condescending and useless. we had to deal with constant partying from other tenants and were harrassed by the neighbours as you can see by the lovely vandalism on the fence outside our back door, tina did not make them wash it off either when brought to her attention. the neighbours who were harrassing us told us that they were selling black market cigarettes to management? you cannot make up this nightmare 😖

reviews.author: Meesh Morgan
reviews.text:
Giving two stars because despite the massive distrust and shadiness of staff, the rest was good.

I moved in here July of 2023 and all was well, was extremely happy with everything.
The first issue I had was minor, however, in hindsight should have been a foreshadow of my future as a tenant. That is, the closing of the one elevator available, at least weekly, if not 2-3 times weekly for move ins and move outs. Having lived in several apartments before I hahe never seen that be so frequent.

Unfortunately I was a victim of  crimes ( stalking, violence, etc) prior to me moving in. I chose not to mention any of this as I didn’t wish to make myself look like a risky tenant, and Im not… ( 2 years + 3 month tenancy, 0 complaints, full deposit returned). Had I mentioned it, it wouldn't have changed anything.

In approx. April of 2025 I returned home one day to my internet not working, something I hadn’t yet experienced. I messed with the modem a bit, forgetting that there was another box located in the wall, under the braker box. With no luck, I called in to my internet company and we tried troubleshooting via video chat for quite some time, me having to search for said second box as I had no idea where it was/ forgot it existed. It was determined that whatever the issue was was not my fault and a free tech was dispatched for thr following day.
Upon the tech’s investigation he told me with concern, that my internet wire was cut completely in half. Well… I didnt know the box existed, I live alone, and no one had ever been left unattended there ever. He fixed it, and I dissociated it for a while between a combination of fear and denial, wishfully thinking this was some wild mistake, but knowing it couldn’t be.
Time went on, and other issues began arising… such as broken glass near my cats food dish when I didnt break anything… an outlet frying $800 in hairtools, one screw missing from each furniture item, never to be found. Tedious things.

It wasn’t until July that I happened to discover on my interior surveillance recordings, undeniable evidence of my stalkers access to my surveillance app and my entire phone. Now, I’m aware that this was the purpose of the cut internet wire in April.

The culprits are people of “ status” and “ power” and the right price must have been agreed upon between them and the building manager, for them to allow access to my unit and do this.
I finally decided I had to bring it up, and did so professionally, peacefully, and included all necessary detail.
The guilt was immediately apparent when despite me directing the email to the main manager, I was passed off to another employee, who only responded to an unrelated topic in the email, ignoring the important part. I was then given a vague response of “ we don’t know what your talking about”. This was when I began searching for a new unit.

This, as well as the wild rent increases that took me from $1750 a month to $2K , was enough for me.
I found a place and put my notice in, and further issues arose, such as a clear participant in my stalking being moved in directly across the hallway. Furthermore, this man was assigned the parking stall right beside mine in the parkade, when the previous 2+ tenants in that unit did not have that parking stall. Said tenant immediately began strange harassment strategies.

The staff here are unfortunately corrupt and lack morals and respect.
Additionally, the “ wyse water meter” bill of ridiculous proportions here seems to be a partnered scam where the company collects a premium from imposing it on tenants, allowing a return for both the Wyse company and Skyline. Never seen it before despite living in multiple apartments throughout town, and still after only moving ten minutes away. They never called me or sent me to collections… indicating the obvious.

reviews.author: Jacquelynn North
reviews.text:
We lived at Orchard Walk for 3 years and I would definitely recommend these units.

Pros: 1. Great building managers, both Allison and Joe before her have been great!  Allison is very friendly, diligent and fair.  Any issues or concerns are dealt with promptly.

2. Great location on city and school bus routes.  Easy walking distance from grocery stores, good restaurants and Upick orchards.

3. Area feels very safe and is a good place to raise kids or walk around, even at night.

4. In three years the fire alarm was never triggered or pulled by anyone except the fire department during routine tests once a month.

5. In three years we never once had a package stolen.

6. For an apartment, the noise isolation is quite good.  We rarely heard our neighbours.

7. Well maintained exterior, green spaces, and common places.  My son loved the playroom on the fourth floor!

8. Underground parking felt very secure, never had issues.

9. Janitors always seemed to keep the place clean.

10. Internet is very stable and the air conditioner kept the whole place cool during even the hot Okanagan summers.

11.  Great apartment for cat lovers, most people seem to have kitties instead of dogs! 😻.  The complex across the road is unfortunately a dog house and their yellow lawns and poopy grass show it!

Cons: 1. Occasional issues with the hot water boiler, the company that built the complex seemed to cut corners there.

2. Wash machine and dryer are half sized, takes getting used to but overall they work decent.

reviews.author: Dale Mullings
reviews.text:
My wife and I explored various contractors to install a pool, and glad we went with Tuff Top Pools. Due to the retaining walls in our yard, we were limited in the size of pool we could install and the options were unique and worked well for our family. Ultimately, cost was a factor for us, and unlike other contractors, Rick allowed us to work with and pay subcontractors (e.g. gravel, electrical, etc.) directly to control costs removing overhead. We are fortunate to have worked with Tuff Top Pools, because they allowed us to manage our budget and work with contractors directly. It absolutely meant more project management and time for us, but I am confident we saved considerably. Contractors are very busy in the region, so Rick was incredibly helpful in connecting us to a geotechnical engineer who could review our project when we hit a snag with the city, and he helped us get an affordable and quality concrete deck contractor lined up, for example.

I know a number of friends that have installed pools in Kelowna, and no installation has gone perfectly and one constant is challenging communication; and yes, we experienced this Tuff Top Pools too. I will say, I appreciate that I was able to mange much of much communication by text directly with Rick. Email and text did make the process much more direct and if we needed information immediately, we were able to get him immediately.

We love our pool, it's been amazing. It was a lot of work, and had it's challenges, but the end result made it all worth while. If we were to do it all again, we'd work with Tuff Top Pools again.

reviews.author: Josh Bergsteinsson
reviews.text:
When my wife and I built the home of our dreams in 2023, we knew a pool was an absolute must. I've worked with trades for 2 decades now, and you learn to ask for recommendations. Rick came with a glowing recommendation from our builder, and after researching types of pools, we knew that fiberglass was the way to go.

Installation started about 2 weeks behind schedule, which for anyone that has built a home, is about 4 weeks ahead of schedule. Once it started however, we didn't run into any snags. Things progressed through prep, pipe layout, pool installation and backfill.

When we were finally ready to fire up, Rick and +1 were on site to fire up, check chemicals; you name it. A few weeks later, our CoverStar auto cover arrived (this is a must in my opinion). About 3 weeks after that, I wasn't head over heels about how the lights and the pump were scheduled. Rick had the guys from Hayward (manufacturer of things like the brains of the pool monitoring, pump, etc.) and they got everything hooked up to my phone. Now I can schedule everything from heat, to lights, and pump through Wifi.

Reading through other reviews, I'm not sure what people expect. Pools are a massive investment that take time, patience and involvement. As someone who has worked with literally hundreds of trades, manufacturers, laborers, and equipment operators over the years, I was very happy with the service Tuff Top did, and continues to provide a year later. He wants to be able to show your pool off as much as you do. That's pride of product and installation.

Rick would be installing my next pool if I was building another home.

JB

Too bad I have to give one star. Took my truck in to have the rear berings serviced. The owner told me upon picking the truck up that he did an unconventional repair stating "I've always done it like that". A few months later, the repair failed and they booked an inspection which I waited a week for, stating it was busy tire season. Upon the inspection, they found that I had brake lines and calipers installed by another shop, and they refused to touch the unrelated bering parts.
As well as twisting words from a phonecall i had about the hubs overheating, and the tech suggested the brake caliper was sticking, which it wasn't, it was the failing hub. Didn't even bother to check the diff oil to see if the berings had failed. When I asked them to fix it and gave the gohead on the fix. They told me to come pick it up since they wouldn't work on someone else's work. After telling me they never intended to fix it that day and I would have to come back a week and half later. After threatening going to the consumer protection board they offered to repair the truck after refusing warranty, stating that if I brought it in, I could never bring it back. Of course this caused uncertainty in their ability to not spitefully work on my truck since they didn't have to back up their work the second time so I refused to bring it back. Since getting my truck back, I've taken it to another shop and they informed me that the procedure was done wrong (greasing an oil bathed bering) as well as the axle nut not being torqued properly. Supposed to be 50ft/lbs with forward rotation. Then backed off to finger tight. This was not the case as the axle had half an inch of play on the spindle and this was solved by CORRECTLY torturing the nut. So it was their own incompetence that they refused to own, which they would have found if they actually inspected the axle when I brought it in, rather than taking pictures of my shiny new calipers. Repairs cost me $1800 from their shop to not repair anything and left me stranded. Then an additional $350 to fix their mistakes. I know there's going to be a response to this, because these guys love to defend their shotty work and belittle their customers. Don't take your vehicles here. I won't let my friends or family either. Cheers.

reviews.author: Carrie Pelletier
reviews.text:
Hello there. If you are reading this, that means you are looking at customer reviews for Alchemy Landscaping. They did a project for us in the fall of 2025, so we will share our experience with you. FYI, we were on a tight budget and trying to maximize it.

Customer contact. Alchemy answers their phone calls and emails. It was difficult to get landscaping companies in Kelowna to return our calls and emails. Never mind showing up to give you a quote.

Quoting. We finally had three contractors show up for quotes. The first company (listed high in the Google search engine ) was at the house for about 10 minutes, chucked a measuring tape around a few times and threw us out a number that seemed insanely low for the scope of the project, and they were not able to do irrigation work. The second company was thorough to a degree, but had things listed like 1 irrigation zone for that front and back yard ( which aren't connected ) and a vague material list. Then Alchemy came by, and I will tell you, the breakdown of the quote was amazing. All of the materials, sprinkler zones, and retaining walls were listed to the foot and laid out in a way we could understand. It was more expensive than the second quote, so we asked the second company to refine their quote, adding some details that were given to us by Alchemy, I.E, number of sprinkler zones, etc. After receiving that revision, what we had in our hands from Alchemy was still more informative.

Our Decision. We decided to go with Alchemy even though their quote was a little higher because we felt there would be fewer hidden costs that we would have to find money for.

The work was amazing. Julien looked after us, and his crew were friendly and hardworking. They were also conscientious of how the scope of the work would affect our neighbor's yard. They came in on time and on budget. They also made sure we knew how to use everything and that we had a plan to look after our new turf.

Overall, we are very pleased with our new front and back yard setup, and how far our money went. If you are looking for a contractor like we were, give these guys a shot!

The place is even nicer now than when we got married as a beautiful enclosed portion has been added with bathroom facilities.
The landscaping and natural beauty of the area have been lovingly thought through to create a magical and memorable setting. Uninterrupted views of the lake and mountains. So magical!
We enjoyed some wine and cheese we had brought and although it was very windy outside, enjoyed a beautiful walk down memory lane.

reviews.author: Bill Tillapaugh
reviews.text:
Burton Marine recently completed a 22 slip Marina for our owners and I wanted to provide a review of our experience.

From the outset of the project, Burton was actively involved.   Mike, Nick and Kevin were all involved in helping to come up with a concept and design for our Marina.   They all provided good insight and opinions to maximize the design in our allowed space.  Mike also provided the names of some consultants for us to engage to help us with environmental studies and ultimately the approvals process with the various levels of government.

Once we had our approvals in place, Burton was very quick to begin construction.   The team they had construct the Marina was professional, hard working and polite.   The quality of work provided was top notch and the finished product is exceptional.   Burton has a high attention to detail and they do not cut corners during the construction process.   Mike and Kevin are attentive and organized during construction and they completed the project on time and on budget.

I would highly recommend Burton Marine and Pile Driving.   They were actively involved during the 3 years process to get our Marina built and we could not have done it without them.  If you are considering completing a project or need help to get started you should engage Burton to ensure your project gets completed and that you have a Marina or Dock that you can enjoy worry free for many years.

Well done Burton, very impressive product, team and process!

reviews.author: Diandra Vinek
reviews.text:
We hired Gary to refinish our 10-seater “live-edge” dining table top, but unfortunately the overall experience was disappointing and we would not recommend working with his company.

From the first communication after he had the slabs, he seemed disinterested in the project. When we picked up the “finished” slabs and set them up on the iron base, we quickly realized the cut ends had not been properly refinished (they were wrapped at pickup). We had shortened the table to our desired length before dropping it off, and instead of sanding and finishing the ends to match the rest of the table, the saw marks were simply stained over and stain dripping.

When I reached out to Gary about this, his response was, “Well, did you see what it looked like when we got it?” Yes, we did — and that was exactly why we hired him to refinish it properly.

We carefully wrapped both slabs in moving blankets and returned them to be corrected (his shop is only four minutes from our home). I did not receive a reply to my message that day, although his worker was present to help unload. The next communication came two weeks later, stating they were ready for pickup. At that time, he also mentioned there had been damage during transport two weeks prior. The damage shown was on the end of one slab — in a highly visible area where it would have been handled while being moved it into the shop. Despite this, he insisted on additional payment to “repair” it. Unfortunately, the damage remains visible and does not appear properly repaired.

The reality is, we simply wanted the job done correctly and were prepared to pay for quality workmanship.

At the final pickup, we asked what it would cost to refinish the tops again to properly address the mark, he responded that he was “done with this table” and repeatedly told us he had to go — at least six times — rushing us out.

We obtained three estimates before choosing Gary’s company, and his was the highest but we felt with 35 years experience, the higher cost would have reflected professionalism, attention to detail and good communication. Unfortunately, that was not our experience.

Photos of ends not finished after initial pickup - last photo of our table with damage he “repaired”.

Exceptional Crack Repair by ORCA Asphalt Maintenance!

I recently had ORCA Asphalt Maintenance address the cracks asphalt at Ambrosia Tower, and I couldn't be more impressed with the professionalism and quality of their work. On May 5, 2025, their team tackled 272 feet of cracks, including some substantial ones that required extra attention and material.

What truly stood out was their meticulous approach. They didn't just fill the cracks; they ensured proper cleaning first, utilizing wire wheels, sweeping, and blowing out debris. This attention to detail, which they explained is crucial for optimal adhesion of the crack filler, truly set them apart. The commercial-grade hot pour crack fill they used looks incredibly durable and has seamlessly blended with the existing asphalt.

ORCA Asphalt Maintenance lead by Braden  delivered on their promise of quality and precision. If you're looking for a company that takes pride in their work and goes the extra mile for a lasting repair, I highly recommend them!

Ray Timbers

I went to Emco with my mom to pick out a kitchen sink and faucet for her new kitchen. Our cabinet installer recommended we go there for good quality options. We entered through the side and spent about 20 minutes browsing the showroom while staff were busy, which was fine.

Eventually, a staff member came out and seemed surprised we were there. From the moment we spoke with her, she was dismissive and rude. When I mentioned we were looking for a smaller sink, she asked if we had a wholesale account and made a comment implying we’d want a “cheap” sink because the kitchen was small—my mom definitely did not.

When I asked what size sink would fit a 30” cabinet, she rolled her eyes and reluctantly said she’d check. My mom saw a faucet she liked and asked about the price, and we were told it was “too much” for us—without even hearing our budget. I ended up Googling it myself and found it was well within budget.

She offered to take our email and phone number to follow up, but never got back to us. We ended up going to Bartle & Gibson instead, where the staff were incredibly friendly and helpful—we had the perfect sink and faucet picked out in under an hour.

Disappointed with the service at Emco. We were ready to buy and felt dismissed the whole time.

Very disappointed in this company. My mom and dad (86 and 92) used them last year for fall servicing of their furnace. They were pleased with the job and were handed a nice, detailed checklist of what was serviced/checked, and a clean bill of health for the furnace.

So based on this service, they called them again this year. This time, my dad was told verbally that there was an issue with the furnace and that they should think of replacing it due to a rebate of some kind. There was no detailed report in writing this time. Since they're likely to be selling their property within the next year and likely to a developer, I tried reaching out to them to find out what the issue was. I emailed and did receive a call from their office and was promised a more detailed response after she spoke with the tech. I got none. But she did email an invoice to me which had no details at all.  I tried emailing a week later, and after getting no response again for several days, I called the office. She explained that the tech said their were "fluctuations in the carbon dioxide levels", but the levels were still in the "normal range".

So as a layman, I asked is this a dangerous situation. Or is it something we can live with safely until we sell. We do have multiple carbon dioxide detectors. I also asked for a the same detailed report that we had been given last year. And also asked if the same issue was detected last year. She promised me she would again speak with the tech, and send another invoice to my email by the end of the day, with all the details that I requested. That was a week ago now. And nothing. So, my parents are full of anxiety. My son, their grandson, stays here with all of us every other week, and they're afraid to run their furnace.

We tried multiple times to resolve our concerns with them before getting to the point of having to write this negative review. If they QUICKLY resolve our concerns, I'll be happy to revise the rating and the review to reflect that. Otherwise, I hope this serves as a warning to others.

reviews.text: We called King Rooter when we disc our water service line had ruptured. They responded quickly to assess the situation, provided a clear quote and scheduled the work to be done quickly. I was in contact with their dispatcher to confirm logistics, but when I had additional questions about the work, I was able to speak multiple times with their,  clearly very experienced, lead plumber. As this was a big problem, we also had to work with our house insurance, and these guys provided everything needed to make that process as smooth as possible. On the day of the work, they showed up first thing, ready to go. With repairs and retrofit work there is always a good possibility for unforeseeable issues. In our case this looked like needing to move where the waterline enters our house to meet modern code, as well as some irrigation repairs. This was done skillfully, with new line cleanly entering the house and the old hole in the foundation repaired well. The trenchless work was very successful and the crew worked extremely hard, staying late into the evening (night?!) to get the work completed. They were respectful of our home, did an excellent job completing the necessary work, and even after such a long day, they left the site clean and tidy. We are extremely grateful for Tristan, his team and their efforts that went very much above and beyond. Thanks again Tristan! Under age children were going in and out of the steam room, there were many unsupervised children in the hot tub playing with toys, splashing people, blocking the disabled ramps (while disabled people were trying to exit) and just being general nuisances with no supervision. reviews.author: Dennis Gane
reviews.text: Every summer for the past 10 years I spend time at my brother/sister in law's place in West Kelowna. Over the last few years they have been talking about replacing their pool liner. He checked around with various companies and decided to go with this one. He indicated they charge for a quote which is applied to the total cost once installation is completed. Their decision was based on other companies indicating they wanted the whole amount up front and installation was significantly down the road. The liner was installed very well, they gave him a small discount on a light that needed replacing and did some minor cement repairs. The one thing I will point out about my brother in law, he's a bit of a perfectionist. He was very pleased with the company. The project was completed on time and on budget.

reviews.author: Ben Cheng
reviews.text:
We contracted King Pool & Spa (2021 08 05) to replace our pool liner. I CAN NOT recommend that anyone use this company. Poor communications, internal coordination, and extended timelines for service will result in frustration. Insult to injury, they have a sign up behind their service desk "To Our Customers This Business Operates on the Basis of Service. If you are satisfied, Please tell others, In you're not ... Please tell us" I'm not satisfied. DM me for details.

2023 12 13. King appears out of business. Their storefront is now taken over by a window and door store. Looks like their poor service caught up to them.

reviews.author: Brian Johnson
reviews.text:
Not shocked this business closed its doors because the service and service was disgraceful.I had left a very positive review a couple of years ago for this company when they replaced our pumps supporting local business as I always try to do.
I liked Jerry the owner and I hate being negative now.
However I now have a completely unusable hot tub due to what my family and I believe was negligent service last winter and we can not afford to replace it.
We had replaced our main heater for the tub with them and it stopped working during the beginning of the winter season but long before low temperatures.
We booked them to come out three times on a row and each time they cancelled or bumped us so that by the time they did come out the temperatures dropped and our hot tub froze!
We put a plug in space heater inside at their suggestion and waited for them to come only to be bumped again on the  day because someone with a pool took priority over us we were told for blowing out.
So when they finally winterized it the pipes had cracked and now we don’t have our tub which we can not afford to replace.
I really wish they had done the right thing and offer to repair the cracked pipe or pipes which may have been relatively easy but sadly there was no offer to repair the pipes we were just told it was weather and old tub.
The brand new heater they installed just weeks before  was still under warranty and caused the original problem by shutting off but that was never addressed.
Had they diagnosed the heater issue when I booked them prior to the temperature drop none of this would have happened.
Can not recommend this business to anyone and that’s very disappointing to say but my $17000 hot tub is broken due to them canceling on us four times over many weeks in winter!!!
It takes a great deal for me to be negative about any local business as I have one myself but in this case their customer support caused hardship for my family.
I even recommended them prior to this to my friend who then purchased a brand new tub from them only to have months of issues themselves which they told me was also not handled well.

reviews.author: Shane O'Neill
reviews.text: We are new customers to King Pool since 2019 and they did a great job for us on shutdown including some service features (duck plugs) that saved us a bunch of time (and water). Recently I had an issue with my 13 year-old pool heater and spoke with Ivan from Service. He was super knowledgeable and talked me through options to resolve my issue without a service call. His advice was spot on and 30 minutes later I was up and running. I can't thank Ivan and King Pool enough for their help. I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Jaime C
reviews.text:
This company doesn't even deserve 1 star. We had them come close our pool. The tech missed a jet and when we asked them to come out and re-do the closure he couldn't find the missed jet without direction. (he's the professional!?) After explaining where the jet was that was missed he called back and said it was done. We had all the chemicals they needed to close the pool and when I received the invoice they had billed us for chemicals we had sitting there. I called to have them removed from the bill which they did.
I was not feeling confident in this company so I hired another company to come make sure it was done correctly. That company found that the last jet plug was not installed correctly and wasn't sealed. I tried to speak with the owner but the wife (Debbie) wouldn't let me speak to him. She's very rude and told me to go elsewhere if I had issues. I wanted my money back because I now had to hire 2 companies to get the job I hired them for done correctly.
They could have ruined our pool and have chosen to deny any wrong doing and take no responsibility.
I'm thankful I went with my gut and had the pool re-winterized by a more honest and reliable company. DO NOT HIRE THIS COMPANY

reviews.text:
I’ve had the pleasure of providing my services to Candace many times, and both she and Max are genuinely wonderful people. They are kind, professional, and incredibly easy to trust, which says a lot about how they run their business.

It’s clear that Empire Pool & Spa Repair is built on strong values, attention to detail, and genuine care for their clients. If you’re looking for reliable, honest pool or spa repair work from people who truly take pride in what they do, I would absolutely recommend them.

reviews.author: J & K Piros
reviews.text:
Max is awesome. Had a leak in my Coast Spa and he fixed it perfectly and fixed it fast! I know that my Coast Spa is mediocre at best and the quality is not that great. Before Max fixed it, it was leaking and loud as heck. My spa is only 4 years old and it turned out that the seals on the pump needed replacing resulting in a massive water leak. Max took out the unit and had it rebuilt in a day. The  loud vibration was another matter and it turned out that it was assembled with no sound deadening feet on the pump motor, it had deck screws and washers attached directly to the wood frame - bush league - the whole house vibrated!! Max added rubber feet and it is now very quiet. Thanks for making my less-then-perfect spa good!! I really love Max's work ethic and dedication to the customer!!

WARNING don't do what I did, and buy a crappy spa, I recommend investing in a good spa!!

reviews.author: Darlene Pappas
reviews.text: Although Candace and Max have never done any work for me I have talked with them extensively about pools and hot tubs for I want to purchase one  and their personalities and knowledge you got to understand is nothing short of amazing.  They know what they are doing, they upgrade all the time, bring in products that their customers need and go over and above what is expected from what I hear.  When its time they will be the business I call for the help.

reviews.author: Steven Roderick
reviews.text:
If I could give 10 stars, I would.

We recently had the pleasure of working with Max and Candace at Empire Pool & Patio for a complete pool liner replacement, new main drain installation, and a skimmer replacement — and I honestly can’t say enough great things about them. From start to finish, the experience was outstanding.

Candace was incredibly professional, organized, and proactive. She communicated every step clearly, kept us updated on scheduling and weather impacts, and genuinely cared about making the process smooth for us. It’s rare to find someone so responsive and detail-oriented — she made us feel confident and cared for every step of the way.

Max is an absolute expert in his craft. Watching him work was like watching an artist at work. His attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and work ethic are second to none. He took the time to explain what he was doing, answered every question with patience and clarity, and ensured the final product wasn’t just good — it was flawless.

The end result? Our pool looks better than brand new. The liner is perfectly fitted, the new main drain and skimmer are seamlessly integrated, and the water has never looked more inviting. Empire Pool & Patio didn’t just restore our pool — they gave our backyard a whole new life.

If you’re considering any kind of pool work in the Okanagan area, do yourself a favour and call Empire Pool & Patio. Max and Candace are the real deal — trustworthy, talented, and truly passionate about what they do. We couldn’t be happier. Thank you both for going above and beyond!

reviews.author: Roxanne Sewell
reviews.text: We encountered an unforeseen problem with our pool pump that Max installed, he was quick to respond and get the problem resolved, standing behind the work he had previously done. Efficient and friendly service, thank you Max!

reviews.author: Michele Lewis
reviews.text: We purchased a Jacuzzi tub as we had one in our previous home and had many years of enjoyable use.  We've purchased the smaller version (J-315) this time around as we still want the quality of Jacuzzi but do not need the larger size.  The two men who came to install the tub were professional and did the job perfectly, working in sync with the crane company and the electrician to ensure it was all in place and the area cleaned up within 90 minutes.  My only negative remark would be that Jacuzzi needs to work with a crane company on the west side of the lake so that they can give timely and reasonably priced service to customers outside of the Kelowna area.  We had to track down our own crane service in order to save the several hundred dollars more than would have been charged by Jacuzzi's go-to company.  Now off to enjoy the relaxation in that hot tub!

reviews.text: Service has been 1st rate since the moment we walked through the front door of the West Kelowna store and met Chris Woods to the delivery and installation. We love the Jacuzzi hot tub and have used it every day since it was installed. We are so pleased with the Jacuzzi product and the service we have received from Premium Pool and Spa!

We would highly recommend Glenda and staff at Premium Pool and Spas to anyone needing a hot tub moved!

Would recommend Jeff Carroll, the instillation team and Mike the electrician, to have a flawless hot tub experience.

reviews.text: Nick took phenomenal care of my '06 Subaru Forester. He assessed the condition & came up with a great package to really bring this thing back to near-new condition! Heck it's almost better than new! Gonna bring all my vehicles to him, especially with that "de-icer" they spray on the roads now. Ceramic is one of the few things that will actually stop your car from being eaten away! Thanks Nick!

reviews.author: William
reviews.text: We brought Monty's our 1996 Bronco Eddie Bauer for CO2 blasting and undercoating.  BC road de-icer was beginning to dissolve it.  Nick was very helpful, keen on OBS Broncos and an older vehicle enthusiast.  He was very easy to deal with and we would have no hesitation about taking another vehicle to him.  The work seems very thorough with blasting and undercoating in every nook and cranny.  The undercoat is evenly applied and the overall aesthetic effect is very good.  From what I have read, the undercoating product Nick is using is one of the best. The Bronco looks ready for whatever caustic the BC Ministry of Highways throws at us.  In addition, Monty had the truck rubbed out and polished so that it looks practically brand new. People in Southern BC who don't believe in disposable vehicles are very lucky to have a shop like Monty's in the area. Thanks Nick.

reviews.author: Devon Galloway
reviews.text: I purchased a new vehicle 2 years ago and was concerned as I already noticed rust forming. I was happy to find a solution with Monty’s Auto Works. Appreciate Nick’s attention to detail and professionalism. Stoked on the final result and would recommend Monty’s for any dry ice blasting and undercoating services.

reviews.author: Dakota Poole
reviews.text:
Recently had Monty’s Autoworks revive my 1969 Toyota FJ40 Land Cruiser with a complete dry ice treatment, rust converter/inhibitor, and undercoating.

Was a great way to knock off the surface rust, and was also a really useful process to identify and deal with any rust spots and areas of concern. As far as classic cars are concerned, an absolute must in ensuring the life of your investment/baby!

I knew the truck would look better than before but wow, I really did not expect such a drastic improvement, the truck looks like a brand new 69!

reviews.author: Alan Sen

Cars are getting so expensive and really wanted to protect my investment, as I like to keep my cars in good shape. If you’re looking for undercoating services in Kelowna okanagan nicks your guy. I think him being a vehicle enthusiast he’s really good go the extra mile with his work.

If at all possible, avoid using this company. Our project manager, Georgia, has stopped replying for over a month. We are waiting for her to complete her reports and quotes to move forward on making our home inhabitable again.

The lack of professionalism is flabbergasting. From showing up unannounced on more than one occasion, to sweeping nails under my personal belongings instead of into a trash can, I'm not even sure where to stop.

There has been a toilet in my living room since November,  baseboards and closet doors in my bar since then as well. Instead of taking down artwork, DKI decided to tape plastic over them, pulling off paint when the tape was removed.

My house looked better flooded than in the hands of DKI. And honestly,  I don't have any faith it will even be rectified.

We are currently going through a fire claim at our place. DKI has been so wonderful and has really gone above and beyond. Georgia, Amber, Olivia, and Richelle have shown such an amazing care for us and our belongings.

Without their hard work and their willingness to do whatever it takes to get things done, we would have been completely overwhelmed and unable to deal with our situation.

If all the other employees were even half as good as these four, it would be an amazing and unstoppable company. Keep these girls happy, they are what make a company great.

A door and a vanity have been damaged. This home had just recently been totally renovated. The worst part is that Winmar was advised that my son has pets but left one day and left his door open, not unlocked but actually open. As well the underbelly of his trailer was not properly secured and now we believe animals may have gotten in and caused more damage. At one point my son asked his insurance adjuster to tell Winmar he did not want them to continue because he was afraid they would cause even more damage. He was then offered a payout by Westland insurance which would have fixed everything. Then Westland, with no credible explanation, rescinded the payout and have to date denied offering it although we have the payout offer in writing. Winmar Kelowna has not responded to my sons attempts to rectify this situation and insurance will not cover anything now that is not original claimed damage. So six months in my son sits in a home that is in worse shape than when he started. These are just a few pics of Winmars work. Help!

Contrary to the answer below, my son asked his adjuster to ask Winmar not to return fearing more damage to his home. I never said they abandoned the claim. reviews.author: Steve Marcoty
reviews.text:
Beware of Home Depot's  Free Water Testing "Service" – It's a Scam Setup! Total rip-off and misleading from the start!
I recently went to Home Depot thinking I'd get a legitimate water quality test through their referral program. Big mistake! They handed me off to some third-party outfit that slaps the Home Depot logo all over their materials to make it look official. Spoiler: It's NOT affiliated with Home Depot at all – just a shady front to push expensive sales.
The "technician" they sent was a guy named Patrick Duchownik, and if you Google him, you'll see he's got a well-documented history of scamming homeowners across multiple provinces Complaints everywhere about high-pressure tactics, fake test results, and aggressive upselling. Do NOT let this individual anywhere near your house – seriously, lock the door if he shows up!
They run these bogus "tests" that always show your water is "contaminated" (no matter what), then hit you with a $5,000+ pitch for their proprietary water filtration system. It's infuriating how they waste your time and try to fleece you. Save yourself the headache: Skip this entirely. Head to Amazon or any reputable retailer – you can get the exact same high-quality reverse osmosis or whole-home filter system for under $400. Do your own simple test kit (also cheap online) and install it yourself. Home Depot, own up to these partners and cut the crap – you're enabling fraud!
Stay safe out there, folks. Don't fall for it.

If you are looking for solar, I would highly recommend SkyFire.

The installation team, Cory and Owen, were true professionals—their expertise and attention to detail were evident throughout the three-day installation. They also made a point to answer all our questions and their workmanship was excellent.

If you're considering solar for your home, we highly recommend reaching out to SkyFire Energy!

reviews.text:
I brought my truck in about 4 weeks ago to have my window fixed (the glass is not in place and when rolled up you have to pull the glass back and hold it to roll it up into place) after having my truck for 4 hours they called to let me know what part needed replacing. Few days later drop my truck off have this part replaced, took another 4 hours, problem is 40% improved I still have to push and hold my window into place after spending $350. They told me the motor keys are worn and needs to be replaced to fix the issue wanting me to spend another $250 for the part plus labour. My dad and I pulled the motor ourselves come to find the keys are not worn at all, to prove a point we replaced it with a new motor. Problem is the exact same. Took the truck back to them the issue was still there, they said so long as I took the door apart, again, they would look at it again. After having it for another 4 hours today I go to pick my truck up and they tell me the window is fine. I’ve had my truck with all the new parts for 3 weeks now, the issue is not ‘fine’ I still have to pull the window into place. I wouldn’t recommend a business who won’t stand by their work, who tell you it’s this, replace a part, it’s not fixed, well put this part in, still not fixed and proceed to tell me the window is ‘much better’? Not impressed at all. No refund was offered even tho the issue was not fixed. If you can’t do a job, say so, don’t waste people’s time and money.

Update: It's been 6 months since I was put into contact with the regional manager, Ryan. After I reached out to their social media manager I let him know I was uncomfortable dealing with Ryan as well as the fact that the issue was still not resolved after 6 months he put me in contact with Steven the BC manager. I just finally received a cheque from them, not covering the cost spent at their location with was promised to me (They refunded me $100 of the $450 I spent...). After 6 months of ignoring my emails and calls, pretending not to have my phone number when they've called previously. I emailed AGAIN for the full refund not a partial refund but no luck still. They like to ignore their clients and wait them out hoping they'll drop it. Very unprofessional and unpleasant to deal with. I can't believe this has gone on for 6 months.

reviews.author: James Jamieson
reviews.text:
My garage door spring unexpectedly broke on December 23, 2025—an inopportune time right before the holidays. I reached out to several local companies for assistance, but Energy Overdoor was the only one to respond promptly and professionally. After discussing the situation with Marty, we determined it was not an immediate emergency, and given the holiday season, we scheduled the repair for the new year.
In early January 2026, I contacted Marty, who arrived first thing the following day. In an era where reliable and punctual service is increasingly rare in the Okanagan region, his responsiveness stood out. Marty provided exemplary professional service: he efficiently repaired the broken springs, thoroughly inspected the hinges and replaced two that were cracked to prevent future issues, and adjusted a loose guide cable on the left side for optimal functionality. His attention to detail and expertise ensured the job was done right the first time.
Based on this experience, I see no reason to look elsewhere for garage door services. Marty from Energy Overdoor exemplified top-tier professionalism and craftsmanship.
James

reviews.author: hipmamabc
reviews.text:
We hired Wolf Creek Windows 2 years ago. After 2 winters and summers, I can give a proper review.
We have a unique 55 year old house. It was cool in winter and warm in summer AND noise from the outdoors was loud and clear inside!
We had the curved windows replaced 15 years ago (they were single pane!), but the glazier who custom cut them, were no longer available for small custom jobs.
We had searched for 2 years to find a window company that would replace the rest of the square and rectangle windows. Because they're in a wood frame, we didn't want to insert vinyl as this would take away from the cozy design of this house. Finally, we received a referral from one of the window companies. I wondered if they would show up, like the ghosting we received from a few other companies.
A few days later, Tyler and his associate, showed up at our house (WOW!)! They checked out all of the windows we wanted replacing, made measurements and presented us with our options. They could do all of the windows we wanted, including the awning ones that opened below the curved windows (these needed a custom wood frame).
The cutting of these double glazed windows didn't take long (we had 20+ windows). Over a few weeks in the frigid cold, the old one taken out, and the new ones installed. We had a miscommunication with 2 of the largest windows ( we wanted a different thickness). Tyler worked with us, without attitude, and the windows were done.
The difference in temperature and noise is REALLY noticeable! The heat does not cycle on and off as often, and the A/C unit doesn't have to work as hard.
Our bedroom is on the street side, and the noise of cars or pedestrians (and the barking dog 2 houses away) is barely noticeable now. It's amazing how much sound leaks through old windows like, weather, birds, cars, lawn mowers etc.
I recommend Wolf Creek Windows for quality, look, efficiency and service. PLUS - supporting a local business is always ideal!
Thank you Tyler!
Gaby Knodel

reviews.author: S. E. Kee
reviews.text: We used this wonderful company for replacing some windows and doors in conjunction with the CleanBC program for energy efficient retrofits. Every aspect of dealing with Tyler and Brittney at Wolf Creek was above expectation - communication, quality of product, friendliness, knowledge of the rebate program, good suggestions for window replacements, and consideration for working in and about our home. Highly recommend.
